title: Projektipäällikkö, korjausrakentaminen
description: Oletko kokenut korjausrakentamisen asiantuntija ja mietit uusia uramahdollisuuksia? Etsimme nyt Ouluun vakituiseen työsuhteeseen projektipäällikköä vaativiin korjausrakentamisen hankkeisiin. Mitä tehtävä sisältää? Projektipäällikkönä työskentelet monipuolisissa korjausrakentamisen hankkeissa omien vahvuuksiesi ja osaamisesi mukaisessa roolissa. Taustastasi riippuen tehtäväsi painottuvat esimerkiksi rakennusteknisiin tutkimuksiin, rakennesuunnitteluun, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Sinun ei siis tarvitse olla kaikkien osa-alueiden asiantuntija, vaan tehtävänkuvaa rakennetaan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi pohjalta. Toimit asiakkaidemme asiantuntijana ja vastaat oman roolisi mukaisesti hankkeiden koordinoinnista ja ohjauksesta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä yli toimialarajojemme, asiakkaiden, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaen, että hankkeet etenevät sovittujen tavoitteiden, aikataulun, kustannusten ja määräysten mukaisesti. Kulttuurimme kulmakiviä on tutkitusti ystävällinen työyhteisö ja matala hierarkia. Toimit osana monialaista korjausrakentamisen tiimiä, josta saat työkavereiksesi eri alojen asiantuntijoita. Vahva paikallinen yhteishenki ja tekeminen yhdistettynä valtakunnalliseen yhteistyöhön eri toimistojemme välillä tuo toimintaamme ketteryyttä, jota nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissakin tarvitaan. Päätökset teemme siellä, missä se on nopeinta ja kulloinkin järkevintä – tiimit on asetettu meillä päätöksenteon keskiöön. Talon sisäinen yhteistyö ja osaamisen jakaminen mahdollistavat sinulle pääsyn myös muiden alueiden hankkeisiin. Oulun toimistomme sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella keskustan kupeessa, jossa meillä on modernit toimisto- ja neuvottelutilat sekä viihtyisät taukotilat. Työsi on liikkuvaa ja kohteet sijaitsevat Pohjois-Suomessa, pääosin Oulun seudulla. Avaimia tehtävässä menestymiseen Odotamme sinulta vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta vaativista korjausrakentamisen hankkeista sekä näyttöjä onnistuneesta asiakastyöstä. Sinulla on kokemusta pitkäjänteisestä yhteistyöstä asiakkaiden kanssa ja kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita sekä tunnistaa asiakkaiden tulevia tarpeita. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto, kuten rakennustekniikan insinöörin (AMK/YAMK) tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto tai muu soveltuva koulutus. Kokemuksesi painottuu kiinteistöihin ja voi painottua esimerkiksi tutkimukseen, suunnitteluun, projektinjohtoon, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Tärkeintä on vahva osaaminen omalla alueellasi sekä kokemus vastuullisesta roolista korjaushankkeissa. Arvostamme kykyä hallita kokonaisuuksia ja viedä hankkeita tavoitteellisesti eteenpäin yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja muiden hankkeen osapuolten kanssa. Arvostamme myös RTA-, RAP-, RAV- tai KHK-pätevyyksiä. Meille on tärkeää asiakaslähtöinen, yhteistyökykyinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen työskentelytapa. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja vastuullinen ammattilainen, joka kuuntelee muita ja tuo samalla rohkeasti esiin omat näkemyksensä. Haluat oppia uutta, kehittää osaamistasi ja jakaa sitä myös muiden kanssa. Mitä lupaamme sinulle - Transforming society together. Swecolla olet mukana luomassa tulevaisuuden kaupunkeja ja kestävämpää yhteiskuntaa – olet oikeasti vaikuttamassa.- Maailma avoinna. Swecolaisia on yhteensä 23 000 ympäri Euroopan, ja Suomessa meitä on 28 paikkakunnalla 3 300 henkeä. Kansainvälinen ja laaja organisaatiomme tarjoaa mahdollisuuksia työskennellä eurooppalaisten kollegojen kanssa – tai vaihtaa toimipistettä Suomessa elämäntilanteesi mukaan.- Oma urapolku ja koulutusmahdollisuudet. Meille on tärkeää, että pääset kehittymään ja suunnittelemaan omannäköistä urapolkua ja tässä me kuuntelemme sinua. Monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksia sinulle tarjoaa oma Sweco Akatemiamme - Monipuolinen ja kattava henkilöstöetukokonaisuus, jonka sisältöön pystyt itse vaikuttamaan. - Työnantajana olemme joustava, ja työsi ja yksityiselämäsi kestävä yhteensovittaminen on meille prioriteetti. Haluatko tutustua vielä tarkemmin työkulttuuriimme? Sehän onnistuu täällä: https://www.sweco.fi/ura/tyontekijalupaus/ Tulisitko työkaveriksemme? Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja tapaamme tehtävästä kiinnostuneita jo hakuaikana, joten ethän suotta odottele viime hetkeen asti. Mikäli mielessäsi on kysymyksiä tehtävään tai meillä työskentelyyn liittyen, tiimipäällikkö Anssi Pöllänen juttelee mielellään kanssasi lisää. Anssin tavoitat numerosta 040 596 2740 tai sähköpostitse anssi.pollanen(a)sweco.fi. Huom! title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Independent Sales Representative – SaaS Software (Commission-Based, Remote)

title: Datakeskussiivooja (Data Center Cleaner)
description: CSM Service Oy is seeking experienced and skilled Data Center Cleaners (Datakeskussiivooja) to join our cleaning operations at data center construction sites and technical facilities in Myllykoski, Kouvola.The work involves professional cleaning, deep cleaning, construction-phase cleaning, post-construction cleaning, and final cleaning. Employees are responsible for maintaining high cleaning standards, controlling dust and contamination, and ensuring safe and organized working environments.We are looking for reliable, hardworking, and detail-oriented professionals with relevant experience in data center cleaning, construction site cleaning, industrial cleaning, or similar environments.Main Responsibilities- Perform daily and scheduled cleaning at designated data center construction sites and facilities. - Carry out construction-phase cleaning, deep cleaning, post-construction cleaning, and final cleaning. - Clean technical rooms, corridors, floors, and designated work areas, including server rooms only when authorized. - Remove construction dust, fine particles, debris, and approved waste materials. - Use professional industrial vacuum cleaners, including HEPA-filtered equipment where required. - Follow dust-control and contamination-prevention procedures. - Use approved cleaning chemicals, tools, and materials safely. - Follow ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) precautions where applicable. - Maintain cleaning equipment and keep work areas clean and organized. - Follow workplace safety regulations and site-specific cleaning instructions. - Report hazards, damaged equipment, and unsafe conditions to supervisors. - Cooperate with site supervisors, construction teams, and facility personnel. Cleaning near sensitive electrical installations, IT equipment, or restricted technical areas must only be performed with appropriate authorization, training, and instructions.Required Work Experience and QualificationsApplicants must have:- At least two years of relevant professional cleaning experience in construction sites, industrial facilities, data centers, or similar environments. - Practical experience in deep cleaning, construction-phase cleaning, post-construction cleaning, or final cleaning. - Experience using professional cleaning equipment and industrial vacuum cleaners. - Knowledge of dust removal, professional cleaning methods, and workplace safety. - Ability to follow detailed instructions and work safely in technically demanding environments. Previous data center cleaning experience is strongly preferred but is not mandatory.Language Requirements**English – Working Proficiency (Required)**- Ability to understand workplace instructions, safety procedures, and cleaning documentation. - Ability to communicate effectively with supervisors and colleagues. **Finnish – Basic Proficiency (Required only if necessary for the actual worksite)**- Ability to understand simple workplace instructions and safety signs. - Ability to communicate in basic Finnish during everyday work situations. Technical Skills- Construction site cleaning and final cleaning. - Deep cleaning and industrial cleaning methods. - Industrial vacuum cleaning and dust removal. - HEPA-filtered cleaning equipment. - Dust and contamination control. - Safe handling of cleaning chemicals. - Occupational health and safety procedures. - Ability to follow cleaning schedules and work instructions. Additional Qualifications Considered an Advantage- Valid Finnish Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti). - Previous experience working on data center construction projects. - Professional cleaning qualification or relevant vocational training. - ESD awareness training. - Experience working in technical or controlled-access facilities. - Experience with construction-phase and handover cleaning. Personal Requirements- Reliable, punctual, and responsible. - Strong attention to detail. - Physical ability to perform cleaning duties safely. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. - Positive attitude and strong work ethic. - Commitment to workplace safety and cleaning quality. - Flexibility regarding working hours. - Ability to follow instructions and meet cleaning schedules. What We Offer- Full-time, permanent employment. - Opportunity to work on data center construction and cleaning projects. - Professional and safety-focused working environment. - Job-specific orientation and training. - Appropriate cleaning equipment and personal protective equipment. - Employment conditions in accordance with Finnish employment legislation and the applicable collective agreement. - Opportunities to develop professional skills in specialized cleaning. Who Can Apply?We welcome applications from qualified candidates with relevant professional cleaning experience.Applicants must have the legal right to work in Finland before employment begins. title: HR Manager, Scandic, Tukikonttori Espoo
description: JOIN SCANDIC'S HR TEAM!We are looking for an HR Manager to support our Finnish hotels and contribute to Scandics continued success.This is a broad and hands-on HR role, closely connected to our hotel operations. You will work as a trusted advisor to the managers, supporting leaders and teams across the district in day-to-day HR matters like labour law, occupational health care, leadership, staffing and recruitment.This position is located in Finland, with the office in Espoo, Tapiola. At Scandic we believe that strong collaboration, as well as learning and development are best supported through regular in-person interaction and therefore we primarily work from the office.WHAT WE OFFERWe offer you a versatile working environment within a major hotel chain, providing countless opportunities for professional growth and development. Our employee benefits include; food and beverage discounts in our restaurants, ePassi, health care benefits and insurance. Scandic Academy also offers a comprehensive training program, and all employees receive additional job-related training whenever needed.YOUR MISSIONAs HR Manager, you play a key role in supporting both people and business. You are the go-to HR expert in your own field and work closely with managers in people-related matters as well as to ensure great leadership and operational excellence.In this role, you will: - Act as a key HR partner to leaders in hotel operations from daily coaching to complex HR matters. - You support correct application of Finnish labor law and collective agreements (MaRa). - Coach and support managers in matters related to sick leave and work ability, including long-term absences, return-to-work situations and workplace adjustments, working closely with occupational health care and other relevant partners. - Support and develop managers in all people-related areas like performance, recruitment (including co-operation with our outsourcing partners), culture and leadership. - Ensure implementation, compliance and continuous improvement of HR processes, based on local needs. - Promote a healthy, safe and sustainable work environment together with managers and stakeholders. - Act as a culture ambassador and ensure Scandics values are reflected in leadership and everyday behavior. - Share insights from your district to help shape the wider HR agenda and ways of working. - You report to the HR Director Finland and are part of both the country HR team and the larger Scandic HR network.WHO YOU AREIn this role you represent our values Be Caring, Be You, Be a Pro and Be Bold in the following manner:Be Caring – you are open-minded and enjoy collaborating and building trust on all levels of the organization, while helping managers to grow and succeed.Be You – you bring your own wonderful warm and friendly personality in everything you do.Be a Pro – you are structured and proactive and thrive in a high-paced and people-intensive environment.Be Bold – you are confident in your role, bringing strong integrity, self-awareness, drive and clear communication. You are empathic, but also confident enough to challenge others when needed.WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of broad HR experience, with strong understanding in labor law and occupational health care. - Proven track record in developing work ability management and related KPIs. - A strong business mindset and the ability to support leaders in aligning people and operations. - Strong ability to collaborate and build trust on all levels of the organization. - Support and challenge leaders in a bold and positive way. - Relevant academic background or equivalent practical experience. - Full professional fluency in both Finnish and English.Salary: The salary will range between 4500eur-5500eur. The salary offered will be determined based on the candidate's previous experience, qualifications and how well their skills and competencies align with the expectation and requirements of the role.For more information about the position, please contact: HR Director Pia Tuomi 0403549996 during the following times: 16.11.2026 at 16.00-17.00 and 19.11.2026 at 8.00-9.00.Interested? Fantastic! Please apply through the link above. Feel free to send your application in either Finnish or English.Scandic is the leading hotel company in the Nordics. We want to be like a friend in town for people on the road – and friends know what friends need. We believe that great hospitality starts with us, in every role and every interaction. What you do here makes a real difference. A warm welcome, a thoughtful detail or support for a colleague – your actions shape the moments that matter for our guests, for each other and for the world around us. At Scandic, you can be yourself, use your strengths and let your passion create experiences people want to return to. Together, we make everyone feel welcome and at home – just like friends do.

title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student), Vibration and Control (Energy Technology)
description: The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.The position is offered initially for two (2) years starting as earliest possible date as agreed mutually agreed between both parties. The position is located in the School of Technology and Innovation, in Efficient Powertrain Solutions (EPS) Research Group, within energy technology discipline, with close co-operation with the VEBIC Research Platform.https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/Your roleYou will be part of an international team working in multiple challenging projects, at the forefront of research and development of novel combustion engine technologies. The focus is on developing and implementing powertrain control solution to support our cooperation with industrial partners in conforming to straightening emissions regulation in marine and off-road sectors. Our goal is to have ultra-efficient, silent large-bore gas engines meeting restrictive Tier III/Stage V emission norms demonstrated in a relevant environment by 2026. We realize this goal by heavily relying on model-based hardware and control development verified on state-of-the-art experimental facilities. To this end, we are seeking motivated researchers with experience in the listed fields:- Advanced Vibration and NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness),- Advanced Control system design and implementation,- Signal Analysis and Processing,The following skills are highly desirable and will be considered a strong advantage:- Engine/Powertrain Control Commissioning, Testing, and Troubleshooting,- Engine/Powertrain Control Design and Implementation.All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.Requirements- You have a Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant field.- Strong knowledge of advanced vibration and control theory is required.- You have very good Skills with MATLAB /Simulink. Develop and test control system.- Systematic know-how of control development routine and laboratory testing.- High-level expertise in NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness) would be a significant advantage.- Demonstrated experience in signal analysis and processing is required.- Very good analytical skills in addition to good academic writing skills are highly advantageous for your candidature. A proven track record in relevant projects and high-quality journals/conferences/projects, on the topics related to the position, is an additional advantage.- You enjoy developing innovative solutions to technically challenging problems and have the right mix of intellectual curiosity and practical pragmatism.- You have good communication skills and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are open to sharing your knowledge with colleagues and ambitious to develop yourself as a researcher.- Specialization in powertrains/automotive industry is seen as an advantage, such as applications of diesel pressure control, injection control, combustion phasing control etc.- FPGA and Model-based control design experience are seen as a plus. Knowledge of different sensor techniques and AutoCAD electrical design are a bonus.- Experience with rapid control prototyping is seen as a plus.Fluent written and spoken English language skills are mandatory in the position.To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required later to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)Inspirational work environmentThe position is situated in the School of Technology and Innovations within the team of Energy Technology, Efficient Powertrain Solutions (EPS) team.EPS is an innovative team, focused on modern technology that has a high level of significance in international business operations. We need open-minded, creative and skilled individuals to explore and develop the future energy solutions, decentralized electrical energy distribution systems, smart electricity grids, flexible hybrid energy production, modern fuel combustion engine technology and related bio fuels, energy storages and power electronics. We continuously develop all of our operations in cooperation with companies and other partners. We are strongly networked and responsible actors in research, education and public relations. As a work community, our team is diverse, international and encouraging. The cooperation and support of colleagues promotes well-being and inspires working. [More information about the School and the team](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/university/organisation-and-management/school-technology-and-innovations).Our team works in close cooperation with the VEBIC Research Platform. At the University of Vaasa, we conduct combustion engine research focused on advanced energy concepts and alternative fuels. We have a special focus on large bore-marine and stationary engines, for which we have unique, state of the art, research facilities at Vaasa Energy Business Innovation Centre (VEBIC). In close collaboration with industry, we are transforming the energy sector by bringing cutting-edge technology to real-world application. We welcome you to join one of the most fascinating energy innovation centers in the Nordic region as a researcher in combustion modelling and control. For more information about the facilities see: [More about VEBIC](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/research-platforms/vebic).We offerWe have a great value to both your personal and your professional development. Many opportunities exist for you to develop: conferences, courses, workshops, coaching, mentoring and international internships.The

title: Kunnossapitäjä, Katsa Oy
description: **Haemme Katsa Oy:lle Tampereen yksikköön kunnossapitäjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen****Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?** Kunnossapitäjänä huolehdit Katsan toimitilojen ja taloteknisten järjestelmien toimintavarmuudesta sekä tuet tuotannon kunnossapitoa. Työstäsi noin 70 % painottuu kiinteistöjen ja talotekniikan ylläpitoon ja noin 30 % tuotannon kunnossapitoon.Arjessasi huolehdit kiinteistöjen teknisten järjestelmien toiminnasta, huolloista ja tarkastuksista sekä reagoit vikoihin ja poikkeamiin. Työskentelet monipuolisesti mm. LVI-järjestelmien, paineilman ja rakennusautomaation parissa sekä teet yhteistyötä ulkopuolisten huoltoyritysten kanssa. Tuotannon puolella osallistut koneiden ja laitteiden ennakkohuoltoihin, korjaustöihin ja käyttövarmuuden kehittämiseen.Pääasiallinen työpaikkasi sijaitsee Ilmailunkadulla Tampereella, mutta työskentelet tarpeen mukaan myös Katsan muissa toimipisteissä Lakalaivassa, Sääksjärvellä ja Ikaalisissa sekä ensi keväänä valmistuvassa Pirkkalan toimipisteessä.Tällä hetkellä työ on päivätyötä klo 7–15.30, mutta lähitulevaisuudessa siirrymme kaksivuorotyöhön. Tällöin työskentelet pääosin päivävuorossa ja joka kolmas tai neljäs viikko iltavuorossa klo 14–22.**Mitä me odotamme?** Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää soveltuvaa teknistä ammatillista koulutusta esimerkiksi sähkö-, automaatio-, LVI- tai kunnossapitoalalta sekä aiempaa kokemusta kiinteistötekniikasta tai kunnossapidosta. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen rakennusautomaatiosta, teollisuuden kunnossapidosta sekä paineilma- ja LVI-järjestelmistä. Myös voimassa oleva SFS 6002 -sähkötyöturvallisuuskoulutus, työturvallisuuskortti ja tulityökortti ovat plussaa.Etsimme ennen kaikkea käytännönläheistä ja oma-aloitteista kunnossapidon osaajaa, joka tarttuu teknisiin haasteisiin rohkeasti ja on motivoitunut kehittämään osaamistaan. Tehtävässä tarvitset suomen kielen taitoa turvalliseen työskentelyyn sekä valmiutta kaksivuorotyöhön. Lisäksi sinulla tulee olla B-ajokortti, sillä työ voi sisältää käyntejä myös Katsan muissa toimipisteissä. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi.**Mitä me tarjoamme?** Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen, monipuolisen ja vastuullisen kunnossapidon tehtävän, jossa pääset työskentelemään sekä kiinteistötekniikan että tuotantoympäristön parissa. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen ja tueksesi kokeneet kollegat, joiden kanssa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi pitkäjänteisesti.Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja alkaa vuokratyösuhteena Biisonin kautta. Kuuden kuukauden jälkeen tehtävässä on mahdollisuus siirtyä Katsan omille kirjoille. Palkka määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.Katsa tarjoaa vakaan työympäristön ja mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäjänteistä uraa teknisessä kunnossapidossa. Tässä tehtävässä pääset ottamaan vastuuta toimitilojen ja tuotannon toimintavarmuudesta sekä tekemään työtä, jonka vaikutus näkyy konkreettisesti arjen sujuvuudessa.

title: Palveluesihenkilö, terveyspalvelujen keskitetyt palvelut, Espoo

Päätoiminen työpisteesi sijaitsee Tapiolassa, mutta työ edellyttää myös liikkumista eri toimipisteiden välillä. Mahdollisuus oman auton käyttöön on toivottavaa.Etsimme työyhteisöömme henkilöä, joka on kiinnostunut ja innostunut johtamaan ja kehittämään yksikön toimintaa yhteistyössä moniammatillisen tiimin kanssa. Tehtävä on tarkoitettu sinulle, jonka vahvuudet ovat ihmisten ja toiminnan johtamisessa sekä kehittämisessä. Lisäksi tarvitset hyviä organisointitaitoja ja kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia johtaessasi yksikön toimintaa.Tarjoamme sinulle perehdytyksen työhön, esihenkilön ja kollegan tuen, mielenkiintoisen ja vaihtelevan työn, hyvät koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet sekä suuren työnantajan henkilöstöedut.Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Terveyspalvelujen keskitetyt palvelut, Ahertajantie 2, 02100 EspooTyöaika: 38 h 15 min / viikkoHaettava tehtävä on virkasuhteinen.Tehtävä on määräaikainen.Kelpoisuusvaatimukset: soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto, soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi osastonhoitajan pätevyys sisältäen tai täydennettynä riittävillä johtamisen opinnoilla, sekä oikeus toimia laillistettuna terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilönä (laki 559/1994).Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito sekä ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen taito.Tehtävässä edellytetään myös tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa.Virkaan valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.Tehtävään valittavalle luetaan eduksi kokemus esihenkilötyöstä, lean-johtamisesta, potilastietojärjestelmä Lifecaren ja puhelinjärjestelmä Telia Acen käytöstä. Odotamme hakijoilta itsenäistä, aktiivista ja vastuullista työotetta, erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä ja halua kehittää monialaisia palveluita.Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. title: Fukt- och skadekartläggare
description: Vi söker en fuktkartläggare till vårt växande team. Vi söker i första hand en byggnadsingenjör (YH) eller byggmästare (YH) som är i början av sin karriär och som vill lära sig nya saker och utvecklas till en yrkeskunnig inom skadesanering.Tidigare erfarenhet av fuktkartläggningar är inget krav. We place great emphasis on personal qualities and will be happy to hear from you – a curious person with a positive attitude and a passion for industrial digitalization, willing to take the next step in your career. We at Etteplan love to hire innovative and skilled people with a passion for creating smart solutions to tough challenges. We are a growing international technology service company with decades of experience partnering with companies in a wide range of industries.Your Role As a Senior Sales Manager, you will drive sales by discovering relevant customer needs, leading and developing opportunities, and building offers for existing and new accounts. You will focus on Finnish and international industrial manufacturing companies, helping them to advance their R&amp;D, production and aftersales processes through industrial digitalization solutions ranging from consulting to turn-key projects and continuous services. You will work together with our other sales managers, delivery teams and global organization consisting of service-minded professionals. - Drive sales growth through value and solution-based sales approach, rooted on strong understanding of customers business needs and objectives - Develop and execute customer sales plans to penetrate strategic accounts, engage multiple stakeholders, and leverage internal resources to drive sales - Participate in sales campaigns at both regional and global levels - Accountability of your sales targets.The preferred location is Helsinki area, Finland – you will be part of our Espoo office. Up to 20% of travelling will be needed in this role, mainly in Finland and Central Europe.Your profile and way of working We expect you to be passionate about building customer value centric growth and business solutions in teamwork with talented experts. You get energy from working with customers, and act as an example to inspire your colleagues to meet customer expectations. - A minimum of five years of proven success in international business solution sales within the engineering or technology services industry, specifically in selling to industrial customers in manufacturing, production, and R&amp;D environments. - Proven B2B sales track record in industrial platform and software solutions. Demonstrated success in selling industrial digitalization, data&amp;AI solutions and tailored SW solutions to industrial customers, particularly in manufacturing, production, R&amp;D and aftersales process environments is a must-have. Scope includes ERP, MES, MOM, PLM, and SCADA systems, industrial data platforms, IIoT solutions, smart factory and production system integrations, as well as industrial AI and analytics solutions. Scope of platform and SW offering ranges from initial concept and roadmap development to full deployment, integration, and lifecycle management. - Wide network of contacts among industrial manufacturing companies. We value particularly your professional network among manufacturing companies operating in defense, energy, mining, heavy machinery and autonomous vehicles sectors. - Strong end-to-end sales capability covering the full sales lifecycle; Building and actively managing a healthy sales pipeline, driving proactive customer engagement and consultative dialogue, leading and coordinating bid teams across disciplines, shaping competitive, value-based commercial and technical offers, delivering compelling executive- and technical-level presentations, and leading contract negotiations and closing agreements. - Strong domain expertise in industrial software and platform technologies as foundation for industrial digitalization. Solid understanding of industrial IT/OT environments and platform solution domains, enabling credible, value-driven engagement with customers. Ability to translate technical capabilities into business value, positioning solutions in the context of customers production strategies, aftersales processes, digitalization roadmaps, and competitiveness goals. - A natural relationship builder with a proactive, hands-on, analytical, and customer-centric approach to work - Masters degree in technology or economics or other relevant academic degree - Fluency in both Finnish and English is a must-have, proficiency in German or Swedish appreciated.Your way of working is best described as proactive, working well under pressure and being eager to achieve successful sales results – you work with integrity, transparency and trust. - An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for new solutions - A motivated person able to energize others in a positive manner and create solutions - Creative and open-minded with skills to work across boundaries with the sales team and the operative organization - A self-starter with the initiative to make things happen.What to expect This is a great opportunity to work in an exciting, international growth company with nice colleagues. You will have the opportunity to work at a company with an inspiring and coaching way of leading that challenges traditional ways of working in the consulting service business. A strong network of contacts as well as extensive experience from various industries await you, giving you a unique opportunity to develop yourself further. You will gain rapid personal development in value-adding sales through coaching, training and exchange of experience.We are an open organization with a flat hierarchy. Whats more, we are an organization in transition to find new ways to do things better, bringing value and efficiency to our customers.You will report to the Software and Embedded Solutions Finland Sales Director and be a part of the global sales team.At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of worki

title: Financial Controller
description: **About the Role**We are looking for a **Financial Controller** to join our finance team in Tampere. This is a full-time, permanent position.In this role, you will be at the center of our revenue, fixed asset and working capital processes, working closely with our local Financial Manager, our global accounting team and both local and global colleagues across Sales, Supply Chain and Procurement.With us you will learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company working in an interesting field.**Location:** Tampere, onsite**Key responsibilities**- Coordinate sales invoicing and accounts receivable. Making sure invoices are accurate, follow up on payment terms and advance payments, and support collections. - Ensure correct revenue recognition and cut-off, reconcile sales revenue, and prepare sales-related accruals and provisions. - Maintain the fixed asset register for tangible and intangible assets, including additions, disposals, write-offs, transfers and depreciation plans. - Work with the Financial Manager on capitalization decisions, assets under construction, capitalized development costs and impairment testing. - Monitor capital expenditure against budget and run physical fixed asset counts and controls. - Prepare financial reporting, payment claims and audit documentation for publicly funded projects, including cost eligibility checks and personnel cost calculations, together with project managers and auditors. - Monitor and report on net working capital, especially inventory, together with Sales, Supply Chain and Procurement. Spot improvement opportunities and escalate them where needed. - Support the purchase process by developing the process flow, monitoring payments and maintaining the purchase approval tool. - Contribute to month-end and year-end closing, including reconciliations, and support our global accounting team. **What we require**To succeed in this role, you should have:- A degree in accounting, finance or business administration. - Around 3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience, including month-end and year-end closing. - Solid knowledge of Finnish accounting standards (FAS). Familiarity with IFRS, especially revenue recognition, fixed assets and impairment. - Experience with accounts receivable, revenue cut-off, accruals and reconciliations. - Understanding of fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation and assets under construction. - Experience with ERP systems (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central is an advantage). - An analytical, accurate and well-organized approach, with the ability to handle several deadlines at once. - Good communication and cooperation skills for working with Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, managers and auditors. - Fluent English and Finnish language skills. **What we see as a plus**- Experience in international / multi-entity structures **What We Offer****Paid Time Off**You are entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the start **Health & Wellness Package**- Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the tax-free limit as a fringe benefit. - Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies. - Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage and other wellness support. - Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care. - Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time. - Business Travel Insurance: coverage for work-related travel. - Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks. **Work Model**- Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00. - No-Crunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed. - Meeting-Light Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings. **Growth & Innovation**- High-End Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals. **Travel & Mobility**- Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation. - Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum tax-free Vero rates. **Impact & Culture**- Low-hierarchy, engineering-driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement. **Culture Statement**Don't meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us.Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology.**Some questions?**If there is something in your mind, you can send your question to careers\_finland@sineeng.com. Please note that we don't accept applications via email.

title: Supercell: Audiovisual Support Intern
description: **Type:** Full-time, fixed-term (8-month internship)**Location:** Jätkäsaarenlaituri 1, 00180 Helsinki**Application deadline:** 27.11.2026Become the go-to audiovisual support at one of Finland's most creative workspaces – join Supercell as an Audiovisual Support Intern!**What will you be doing?**Supercell is looking for two enthusiastic Audiovisual Support Interns to join its in-house IT-Collaboration team for an 8-month full-time internship starting in February 2027 and September 2027. In this role, you'll support hundreds of live and hybrid events at Supercells headquarters, especially in the auditorium, collaborating with game teams, leadership, external partners, and handling a wide range of daily operations. You'll be part of a small in-house team of ten collaboration professionals, working closely with consultants and the wider IT-Organization.You'll get hands-on experience with digital signage, live mixing, equipment management, troubleshooting technical issues, and user guidance in digital tools and meeting rooms. You'll also have the freedom to explore opportunities for projects aligned with the team's broader goals. The role gives you a front-row seat to some of Supercells highest-profile internal and external events and to how technology enables company-wide collaboration. Were looking for someone who thrives in dynamic situations and doesn't shy away from grabbing a mic (or helping someone else wear one right).You'll also contribute to digital tool development, service documentation, and internal projects – whether that means piloting a new video platform or documenting our digital infrastructure.**What makes you a great fit?**You'll do well in this role if you're curious about event technology, interested in how audiovisual systems work, and keen to learn through doing. Confidence, self-reliance, and professionalism are essential: you'll interact daily with people across the company, including leadership.**What Supercell requires from you:**- A genuine interest in technology, live events, and how things work behind the scenes - 2–4 years of relevant studies in AV technology, IT, event production or similar fields - Some previous work experience - Good IT skills and a basic understanding of IP networks - An independent, proactive and curious mindset with solid problem-solving skills - Good social skills and an ability to communicate clearly under pressure - Full working proficiency in English **What Supercell considers an asset:**- Experience with digital/live events or technical support - A genuine interest in games (experience of Supercells games is a big plus!) Don't meet every requirement? No worries! We encourage you to apply even if your background doesn't tick every box. We're open to different backgrounds and value your motivation and willingness to learn.**Why you will love it at Supercell:**- Dive into a high-tech environment with hundreds of events annually and a strong support team - Work with cutting-edge equipment and see your impact in daily operations and high-profile events - Learn by doing – get involved in digital installations, vibecoding, tool improvements and documentation - You'll be surrounded by an international work environment; you'll hear chatter in different languages from all over the world around the office - You'll get to work with the newest tools and technologies. Supercell will offer you everything that you need to succeed in your role - the rest is up to you! **Practicalities:**This is a full-time, fixed-term internship for 8 months. We are looking for two interns, one starting in February 2027 and the other in September 2027. In this position, you will be employed directly by Supercell. Your main work location will be Supercells headquarters in Helsinki, and we expect you to work mostly on-site given the nature of the tasks. Flexibility is required, as events occasionally take place outside of office hours or on weekends. Please note that you need to have a valid work permit in Finland. Unfortunately, we do not offer any relocation support for this position.**Recruitment process timeline:**- Application period ends: Friday 27th of November - Phone interviews with aTalent: week 49 - Interview rounds with Supercell: week 50 – week 51 - Final decisions and selections: week 1 at the latest Does this sound like the next step in your career? Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by the latest 27th of November via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/397409/create/. Please apply for the position as soon as we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to also use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email.To familiarize yourself with Supercell, please visit http://supercell.com/en/. For more information about the position and recruitment process, contact aTalent's Recruitment Consultant Sofia Hyvärinen (+358 503 613288, sofia.hyvarinen\[ät\]atalent.fi). For any questions regarding the position, I will be available by phone 25th of November at 13.00 - 14.30. If I'm unable to answer your call, please leave me a message, and I'll call you back.

title: Service Operations Team Leader, Siemens Osakeyhtiö
description: Siemens Digital Industries on automaation ja digitalisaation edelläkävijä. Tuet myyntiä tarjousten valmistelussa ja työmääräarvioissa. - Ohjaat palvelutöiden toteutusta yhdessä Service Execution -organisaation ja kumppaniverkoston kanssa, koordinoit resursseja ja kapasiteettia sekä toimit yksikön esihenkilönä. - Kehität kyberturvallisuus-, haavoittuvuudenhallinta- ja elinkaarenhallintapalveluita sekä uusia digitaalisia palvelukonsepteja yhdessä asiakkaiden ja myynnin kanssa ja vastaat päämiehen palveluiden lokalisoinnista Suomen ja Baltian markkinoille. **Etsimme sinua, jolla on:**- **Koulutus:** soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tekniikka tai liiketalous) tai vastaava kokemuksen kautta hankittu osaaminen. - **Kokemus:** useiden vuosien kokemus teollisuuden palveluliiketoiminnasta, palvelusopimusten hallinnasta tai palveluiden toteutuksesta. - **Esihenkilökokemus:** kokemus tiimin tai yksikön esihenkilötyöstä, resurssien ja kapasiteetin suunnittelusta sekä toimintatapojen kehittämisestä. - **Toimialaosaaminen:** ymmärrys teollisuusautomaatiosta ja teollisuusasiakkaiden palvelutarpeista. - **Yhteistyötaidot:** kyky toimia asiakasrajapinnassa sekä yhteistyössä myynnin, toteutusorganisaation ja kumppaneiden kanssa. - **Kielitaito:** erinomainen suomen ja hyvä englannin kielen taito sekä suullisesti että kirjallisesti. - **Henkilökohtaiset ominaisuudet:** aloitteellisuus, asiakaslähtöisyys sekä kyky hallita useita samanaikaisia kokonaisuuksia. **Eduksi katsotaan**- Kyberturvallisuus-, haavoittuvuudenhallinta- ja elinkaarenhallintaosaaminen: osaaminen näiden alueiden palveluista ja ratkaisuista. - Liiketoimintaosaaminen: kokemus tarjousten valmistelusta, työmääräarvioista sekä palvelusopimusten hinnoittelun ja kannattavuuden seurannasta. **Muuta tietoa**- **Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian - **Kesto:** Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva työsuhde - **Sijainti**: Ensisijainen sijainti on Espoo, mutta myös Tampere voidaan huomioida. - **Matkustus**: Työhön kuuluu matkustusta asiakkaiden tiloihin pääasiassa Suomessa sekä mahdollisesti joskus Baltiassa. **Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**Terveys – Kattava työterveyshuoltoLiikunta ja hyvinvointi – Kuntosali- ja hierontaetu sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- jalounasedutModernit toimistotilat , maksuton pysäköinti sekä sähköauton latausmahdollisuusPitkän aikavälin uramahdollisuudet kansainvälisessä teknologiayhtiössäTyön ja vapaa-ajan tasapaino – Joustavat työajat ja hybridityömalli**Hae mukaan!**Luo itsellesi henkilökohtainen hakijaprofiili ja lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään **30.11 mennessä**. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten suosittelemme hakemaan mahdollisimman pian.**Taustaselvitykset**Osana rekrytointiprosessiamme voimme tehdä tehtävästä riippuen taustaselvityksiä. Tarkistukset toteutetaan aina voimassa olevan lainsäädännön mukaisesti ja ainoastaan tehtävän edellyttämässä laajuudessa. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa turvallinen ja luotettava työympäristö.**Siemens Osakeyhtiö**_Siemensin kansainväliset huippuinnovaatiot ja paikallinen osaaminen rakentavat asiakkaiden, teollisuuden ja yhteiskunnan menestystä Suomessa. title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Electrical Engineer
description: Join Beneq as an Electrical Engineer – Shape the Future of ALD Research Tools!Many breakthroughs in materials science, energy and microelectronics begin in a research lab, on an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool. Those tools have to be flexible, safe and electrically reliable. At Beneq, we build them.Were looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the Spatial product team in our Advanced ALD Business Unit. Youll design the electrical systems behind our Spatial ALD equipment, used by leading semiconductor and optics manufacturers, world-class technology companies, universities, and research institutes around the globe.This is a hands-on engineering role. Youll take designs from schematics and customer-specific modifications all the way to certified, fully documented deliveries, working closely with mechanical and automation engineers along the way.As a global leader in ALD solutions, Beneq offers the opportunity to work on technology that enables the next generation of thin film innovation. Many of our deliveries include customer-specific configurations, so youll regularly solve new design challenges. Youll also see the direct impact of your work on equipment used at the forefront of science.If youre an Electrical Engineer who enjoys variety, thrives in cross-disciplinary collaboration and is always looking for ways to make things work better, wed love to hear from you.Your Key Responsibilities * Design, develop and maintain electrical structures, schematics and related documents for Beneqs Spatial ALD equipment. * Prepare product purchase structures for customer deliveries and design customer-specific modifications. * Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards (CE, UL) and related requirements. * Support certification processes and maintain the technical documentation needed for regulatory compliance. * Work with software/automation and mechanical engineers to ensure seamless system integration. * Support internal teams on electrical performance questions, both in Spatial and across other Advanced ALD product teams. * Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and new technology adoption, and contribute to new product development.What Were Looking For * 3+ years in electrical system design, including low-voltage and high-power systems. Close-but-not-exact experience is worth a conversation. * A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * Proficiency in EPLAN and AutoCAD or a similar electrical design tool. * Working knowledge of electrical safety and CE, UL, EMI/EMC and IEC certification requirements. * Familiarity with PLC systems, especially Siemens S7. * Understanding of functional safety systems in relation to electrical design. * A detail-oriented, quality-focused approach, plus strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills.Bonus Skills That Set You Apart * Qualification for conducting electrical installations. * Ability to design electrical systems and connections for vacuum equipment, covering both vacuum-side and atmospheric-side applications. * Experience in thin film processing equipment (ALD, PVD, CVD or PECVD). * Knowledge of ERP and PDM systems such as SAP and Aton.Why Join Beneq?Youll work with one of the worlds top ALD teams at the forefront of thin film innovation. Our environment is collaborative and supportive, and the hierarchy is flat enough that your work is visible. We offer a competitive salary, strong work-life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning in a high-tech, international company.How to ApplyAre you ready to take the next step in your career? Submit your application and CV by 13.12.2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may start the interview process during the application period.For more information, feel free to contact Johannes Wesslin, Engineering Manager at johannes.wesslin@beneq.com [johannes.wesslin@beneq.com] or by phone +358404142431 on 20.11. or 27.11. 13.00-14.00 (UTC+2).Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

description: Sales & Business Development ManagerAffix Scaffolding Europe Oy – Hyvinkää, FinlandPosition: 1Location: Hyvinkää, FinlandStart: As soon as possible, with operations expected to commence by the end of 2026 at the latestEmployment & compensation: Negotiable based on experience and profileAbout the roleAffix Scaffolding Europe Oy is a newly established Finnish business preparing to launch its operations in Hyvinkää for the import, sales, rental, storage and logistics of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.Our Finnish operations are currently being established and are expected to commence by the end of 2026 at the latest.We are looking for an experienced Sales & Business Development Manager to take a key role in building Affix's commercial presence in Finland and supporting further growth in selected European markets.This is a newly created role in a new business operation, offering significant responsibility and the opportunity to shape the company's sales approach, customer acquisition processes, CRM setup and go-to-market activities from an early stage.The successful candidate will be expected to actively develop new business, establish customer relationships, build and manage a sales pipeline, negotiate commercial terms and, most importantly, successfully close sales and rental agreements.Main responsibilitiesIdentifying and developing new B2B customers and business opportunities.Building relationships with construction companies, scaffolding contractors, industrial companies, equipment-rental businesses and other relevant customers.Managing the full sales cycle from prospecting and first contact through meetings, quotations, negotiations and deal closing.Developing and maintaining a structured sales pipeline and sales forecast.Preparing commercial offers and actively following opportunities through to a decision.Understanding customer requirements and proposing suitable scaffolding systems, equipment and commercial solutions.Developing long-term customer relationships and identifying repeat-sales and cross-selling opportunities.Supporting the company's market-entry and growth strategy in Finland and selected European markets.Monitoring market developments, competitors, pricing and commercial opportunities.Participating in customer visits, trade events and other relevant sales activities.Coordinating with Affix's international manufacturing, sourcing, technical, operational and back-office teams.Helping establish scalable sales, CRM and growth-management processes for the Finnish business.Required experience and skillsApplicants should have:Proven B2B sales and business-development experience.Demonstrated experience in negotiating and successfully closing commercial deals.Proven direct sales experience in Ringlock and Tube & Fittings scaffolding systems.Ability to independently develop new customer relationships and manage the complete sales process.Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-management skills.Experience using leading CRM platforms, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive or comparable systems.Experience using modern sales, prospecting, pipeline-management or growth tools to support lead generation, customer development and sales performance.Ability to establish structured CRM practices, maintain high-quality pipeline data and use sales information for forecasting and decision-making.Good understanding of quotations, pricing, commercial terms and customer account development.Professional-level Finnish and English communication skills.Ability and willingness to travel for customer meetings when required.A proactive, target-oriented and highly independent approach to work.Language skillsAs Affix is developing an international European business, applicants should preferably speak at least one additional European language in addition to Finnish and English.German or French is particularly valued. Other relevant European language skills are also considered an advantage.Considered an advantageExisting network within the Finnish construction, scaffolding, industrial or equipment-rental sectors.Experience selling or renting scaffolding systems or related construction equipment.Technical knowledge of Ringlock and Tube & Fittings scaffolding systems.Experience launching or developing a new market, business unit or customer portfolio.Experience building sales processes and CRM structures for a new or rapidly growing business.International B2B sales experience.Experience in outbound sales, account-based sales, lead-generation platforms or other modern growth-management approaches.Experience working with manufacturing, sourcing and back-office teams located outside Finland.Experience in Nordic, German-speaking or French-speaking markets.What we offerThis is an opportunity to join Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy at the beginning of its Finnish operations and play a central role in building the company's commercial foundation.The successful candidate will have significant influence over customer acquisition, sales processes, CRM practices, commercial strategy and future growth.The form of cooperation and compensation package can be negotiated according to the candidate's experience, track record and preferred level of responsibility. Possible arrangements may include:full-time employment with a fixed salary;fixed salary plus performance-based commission or bonus;another performance-oriented employment structure; orfor a particularly suitable and experienced candidate, a broader business-partner-style role may also be discussed.The final arrangement will be agreed mutually based on the candidate's background and the needs of the business.

title: Asennus/huoltohenkilö konevuokraamoon (Turku)
description: Reilumpaa ja palkitsevampaa työnvälitystä! Vuonna 2018 perustetun yrityksemme tavoitteena on tarjota mielenkiintoisia työmahdollisuuksia Uudellamaalla sekä Varsinais-Suomessa. Kauttamme löydät eri pituisia tehtäviä niin raskailta aloilta kuin toimistoympäristössä. Kurota siis hunajapurkkiin ja löydä uusi työsi!Meidät löydät livenä sekä netistä. Tule moikkaamaan!TehtävänkuvausEtsimme asiakkaallemme käytännönläheistä huoltoasentajaa asiakkaamme konevuokraamolle Turkuun. Työ sopii sinulle, joka viihdyt koneiden ja työkalujen parissa ja pidät kädet mieluummin kiinni tekemisessä kuin toimistotuolissa. Tehtävä alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja sinulla on mahdollisuus työllistyä suoraan asiakkaamme kirjoille.Toivomme sinultaHakemamme henkilö on jo kartuttanut kokemusta kone- ja laitehuollosta tai vastaavista korjaustöistä. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja huolellisesti ja turvallisuus on sinulle itsestäänselvyys. Autoalan tai muun teknisen alan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, samoin kokemus rakennuskoneista tai varastotyöstä. Tarvitset B-ajokortin, ja C-kortti on plussaa. Asiakaspalvelutaito ja halu oppia uutta vie tässä työssä pitkälle.Tarjoamme sinulleTyötehtäviisi kuuluu vuokrakaluston tarkastus, huolto ja korjaus sekä kaluston lähettäminen ja vastaanotto. Tarvittaessa teet myös asennus- ja huoltokäyntejä asiakkaiden työmaille.Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?Hae tehtävää heti, tai vinkkaa kaverillesi! Täytä lyhyt hakulomake, ja muista liittää mahdollinen CV ja muut liitteet. Lisätietoja tehtävästä voi kysyä lähettämällä meille sähköpostia (niklas.remmer@contiopalvelut.fi), tai soittamalla arkisin (9-15) 0407205545. Hakuprosessista vastaa Niklas Remmer.Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!Contio HenkilöstöpalvelutPuhelin: +358407205545 Sähköposti: niklas.remmer@contiopalvelut.fi Sijainti: Käsityöläiskatu 5 B, 1 krs

title: Hiihtokeskustyöntekijä
description: Porin Slalomseura ry hakee määräaikaisia hiihtokeskustyöntekijöitä tulevalle talvikaudelle 2026-2027. Tarjolla on monipuolisia työtehtäviä mukavassa ja rennossa työympäristössä talvisen harrastamisen ja liikunnan parissa.Hiihtokeskustyöntekijän pääasiallisiin työtehtäviin kuuluvat hissien päivittäinen valvonta ja toiminnan varmistaminen, asiakaspalvelu ja ohjaaminen hissijonoissa, turvallisuuden valvonta ja asiakkaiden avustaminen hissin käyttöön liittyvissä asioissa sekä muut hiihtokeskuksen työt, kuten vuokravarusteiden vuokraaminen asiakkaille.Edellytämme haettavilta henkilöiltä täysi-ikäisyyttä, asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä, oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua oppia uutta. Aikaisempi kokemus vastaavasta työstä katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä, työhön perehdytetään.Työajat painottuvat pääasiassa arki-iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin. Hiihtokeskus palvelee talvikautena asiakkaita ti-pe klo 17-21 ja viikonloppuisin klo 10-18. Noudatamme Hiihtokeskusalan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus on tuntiperusteinen.Kiinnostuitko?Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja kerro itsestäsi sekä mahdollisesta aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi (CV) osoitteeseen puheenjohtaja@porinslalomseura.fi.Tervetuloa mukaan tekemään mukavaa talvikautta kanssamme!

title: HEAD CHEF / KEITTIÖMESTARI – LEVI

title: Electrician
description: **Experienced Electrician wanted at Nordic Power Finland OY**Want to help build the future of electrical and data center solutions?Nordic Power Finland OY is growing and is now looking for an experienced electrician who wants to be part of the journey from the start and contribute to our continued growth._We work with everything from traditional electrical installations to advanced data centers, automation, and service assignments. With us, you'll have the opportunity to develop together with a company where decision-making paths are short and where quality, responsibility, and teamwork are at the core._**About the role**As an electrician with us, you will, among other things, work with:- Service and troubleshooting - Electrical installations in industrial and commercial properties - Data center projects - Renovation and new construction - Projects throughout Finland, with the possibility of work in the rest of the Nordic region - No two days are alike, and you will get to work in varied environments together with dedicated colleagues. **We are looking for someone who:**- Is a trained electrician - Has a few years of experience in the profession - Is self-motivated and takes responsibility - Has a category B driving license - Speaks Finnish or Swedish and can communicate in English - Experience with data centers, industry, or automation is an advantage, but not a requirement. **We offer:**- Competitive salary - Work phone and computer - Wellness allowance - Opportunity to develop within data centers and advanced electrical installations - A company where you get to be involved and make an impact - Great colleagues and a strong team spirit - Opportunity for overtime work as well as travel assignments within the Nordic region

title: Kahvilavastaava, Kujalan Porotila, Kuusamo, Lappi
description: Oletko sinä etsimämme Kahvilavastaava?Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksellemme, Kujalan Porotilalle, Kahvilavastaavaa upeisiin puitteisiin tulevalle talvikaudelle 2026–2027!Kahvilavastaavana toimit vastuuasemassa porotilan kahvilassa ja tilausravintolassa. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu asiakaspalvelu suomeksi ja englanniksi, kahvilan päivittäinen suorittava työ sekä ruokailujen järjestäminen porotilan vieraille. Lisäksi vastaat tilamyymälän tuotteiden esillepanosta ja myynnistä, catering- ja tukkutilauksista sekä kahvilatoiminnan kokonaisvaltaisesta johtamisesta ja omavalvonnasta. Työskentelet monipuolisissa ja vaihtelevissa ympäristöissä, kuten kahvilassa, tilausravintolassa, kodassa ja leirissä, joissa tarjoillaan ruokaa ja jaetaan tarinoita porojen elämästä sekä porotilan historiasta.Työssä olet osa isoa ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä, jossa saat kattavan perehdytyksen tehtäviin. Edellytämme aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä, myös tuntemus matkailu- tai poroalasta katsotaan eduksi. Etsimämme henkilö on joustava, vastuuntuntoinen ja ystävällinen asiakaspalvelija. Olet kiinnostunut kehittymään työtehtävissäsi ja oppimaan uutta. Siedät hyvin painetta sekä omaat hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja ongelmanratkaisutaidot.Kokoaikainen työsuhde alkaa mahdollisimman pian, sopimuksen mukaan kestäen maaliskuun 2027 loppuun saakka. Työsuhde solmitaan Bondatan ja työntekijän välille. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajanpalveluiden työehtosopimusta.Tarjoamme sinulle:- Monipuolisen työn alansa vakavaraisessa perheyrityksessä- Määräaikaisen, kokoaikaisen työsuhteen talvikauden ajaksi- Hyvän perehdytyksen työtehtäviin- Mukavat työkaverit aina poroista ihmisiin- Mahdollisuuden kehittää itseäsi ammatillisestiToivomme sinulta:- Aikaisempaa vastaavaa kahvila ja/tai ravintola-alan työkokemusta- Joustavuutta ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä- Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja- Itsenäistä ja joustavaa työotetta- EA-1 korttia- Hygienia- ja anniskelupassia- Auton tai jonkin muun kulkupelin käyttömahdollisuus töissä kulkemiseenHakuprosessi:Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, jätätähän hakemuksen mahdollisimman pian. Kerro hakemuksessasi aiemmista työkokemuksistasi sekä koulutuksestasi / liitä CV hakemukseesi palkkatoiveineen. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään sopivien hakijan löydyttäessä.Lisätietoa:Bondata LaplandSaaga Väänänensaaga.vaananen@bondata.fiKujalan PorotilaKujalan Porotila on yksi Kuusamon vanhimpia ja suurimpia porotiloja, joka tarjoaa aitoja elämyksiä porojen kanssa vuoden ympäri. Myyntivalikoimaan kuuluvat korkealaatuiset porotuotteet, lihat, taljat, sarvet, tilan oman käsityöpajan töitä sekä taidetta. Porotilalla sijaitseva taidekahvila tarjoilee maukkaita kahvilatuotteita ja elämyksiä taiteen keskellä. Kujalan Porotila sijaitsee kivenheiton päässä Kuusamosta, porotilalta on upeat näkymät Nissinjärvelle!Sähköposti: lappi@bondata.fi Sijainti: Kemijärventie 133, 93800 Ruka-Kuusamo

title: MYYJÄ ja LIIKENNEMYYMÄLÄTYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ Eepeen toimipaikkoihin Alavudelle
description: Primary location:ALAVUSHae MYYJÄKSI ja LIIKENNEMYYMÄLÄTYÖNTEKIJÄKSI Eepeen toimipaikkoihin Alavudelle!Alavuden S-market sekä ABC etsivät myyjää ja liikennemyymälätyöntekijöitä. Monipuolinen työ useassa toimipaikassa mahdollistaa hyvät sopimustunnit sekä mukavaa vaihtelua työhön.MYYJÄ - vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, työtunnit keskimäärin 20h/vkoLIIKENNEMYYMÄLÄTYÖNTEKIJÄ - vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, työtunnit keskimäärin 60h/3vkoLIIKENNEMYYMÄLÄTYÖNTEKIJÄ - määräaikainen sijaisuus syyskuulle 2027 saakka, työtunnit keskimäärin 15-30h/3vko. Aikaisempi kokemus kaupanalan tehtävistä on plussaa, mutta positiivinen asenne ja aito halu tehdä asiakaspalvelutyötä ovat tehtävässä menestyäksesi kaikkein tärkeintä.👍LIIKENNEMYYMÄLÄSSÄ tehdään monipuolisia ravintola-alan työtehtäviä - ravintolasalissa, -keittiössä sekä Hesburgerissa. Toivomme saavamme sinut työkaveriksemme mahdollisimman pian, sopimuksen mukaan. Sekä S-marketissa, että ABC:lla sinua odottava mukavat työkaverit , iloinen huumori sekä kunnon perehdytys tehtäviisi.Mitä tarjoamme:Tervetuloa meille Eepeelle ihan tavallisiin töihin, poikkeuksellisen monipuolisten työtehtävien pariin! Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia!Erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.Koko henkilöstöämme koskevatulospalkkiojärjestelmäKattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan, kulttuurin ja hyvinvoinninEpassi-edutPoikkeuksellisen paljon erilaisia mahdollisuuksia urallesi ja työkokemuksen kartuttamiseksi💡Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta tai tiedät tehtävään sopivan kollegan, käy jättämässä hakemus tai vinkkaa mahdollisuudesta eteenpäin!Haku on avoinna 25.11.2026 saakka - käsittelemme hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana, joten laita hakemusta reippaasti tulemaan.Lisätiedoissa voit olla yhteydessä Jonnaan tai Mikkoon:S-market Alavus, marketpäällikkö Jonna Harju-Panula, p. 0107646391 // jonna.harju-panula@sok.fiABC Alavus, liikennemyymäläpäällikkö Mikko Lakaniemi, p. 0504483652 // mikko.lakaniemi@sok.fi***********************************************************************Etelä-Pohjanmaan Osuuskauppa on monipuolinen työpaikka!Eepee on osuuskauppa,jonka omistavat sen yli 95 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle 71 toimipaikassamme.Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit. Tutustu meihin paremmin ja kurkkaa, mitä tulevat työkaverisi kertovat työstään – ehkä seuraava tarina on sinun.
