title: Field Project Manager, Sweden
description: ROXON specializes in demanding bulk material handling solutions. We design and deliver conveyor systems, modernizations, maintenance services, and spare parts for material handling equipment. Our comprehensive solutions and world-class lifecycle support serve industries including mining, energy, pulp and paper, and process manufacturing. At ROXON, decades of engineering expertise meet innovation. Our success is built on the passion, dedication, and professional excellence of our people. Trust, technical expertise, and the capability to take on even the most challenging projects are the core values that drive our project business.We are now looking for a Field Project Manager to join our team in Malmfälten.As a Field Project Manager, you are responsible for ensuring successful project delivery from planning & designing through completion. Your role includes managing schedules, budgets, customer communication, and on-site activities while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and to the highest quality standards.You will lead equipment delivery and modernization projects, coordinate installation work and subcontractors, and act as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project life cycle. The role requires close cooperation with sales, service, engineering, purchasing, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution and excellent customer experience. You will support site operations when needed and promote a proactive, customer-focused, and solution-oriented way of working.Based in Gällivare, this position offers a hands-on opportunity to work with industrial and material handling projects in a dynamic mining environment, where strong leadership, practical problem-solving skills, and a "get things done" mindset are highly valued!Qualifications:- Technical understanding of mechanical systems, industrial equipment, conveyor technology, or material handling solutions /equipment- Strong leadership and coordination skills.- Ability to read and understand technical drawings.- Self-driven and capable of working independently while taking ownership of project activities, customer relationships, and business development initiatives.- Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in both Swedish and English.- Willingness to travel frequently within Sweden; a valid driver's license is required.The ideal candidate is passionate about building long-term customer relationships, developing successful partner networks, and driving product performance and market growth. You thrive in a hands-on environment where you can combine strategic thinking with active customer engagement. The role can be tailored to match your skills, experience, and strengths.What We Offer:- A key role in growing a cutting-edge conveyor products in local markets.- The opportunity to take ownership of projects for a strategically important market area.- An international working environment within a strong global industrial group (NEPEAN).- Support from an experienced organization.Why join us?You'll become part of a growing team where attitude matters as much as experience. We offer training, responsibility, and the opportunity to make a real impact on customer success across Northern Sweden and Norway.Interested?Please submit your application in English by December 7, 2026, [via this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/field-project-manager-sweden/ZlE0qd).Please note that we review applications and interview candidates throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.For further information about the position, please contact our recruitment partner: Liena Silen p. +358 40 482 6770 or liena.silen@eezy.fi and Saara Saalo +358 40 183 6260 or saara.saalo@eezy.fiROXON Sweden ABAt ROXON, we are committed to delivering solutions that are truly optimal for our customers' operations. We believe that honesty and transparency create something far more valuable than a few percentage points: trust.Rather than offering standard, one-size-fits-all solutions, we provide tailored systems built on strong process expertise and a deep understanding of each customer's unique needs. We take the time to understand our customers' challenges and evaluate different solution alternatives together with realistic implementation schedules.We call this approach the Nordic Way. It is built on continuous dialogue, close collaboration, and shared problem-solving with our customers.Phone: +358 40 482 6770 Location: Gällivare

title: Internship – Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Energy Transfer &
description: Company DescriptionVattenfall is a leading European energy company with 12 million customers and approximately 21,000 employees. We are convinced that there is a way to build a future in which everyone can choose fossil-free ways to transport, produce, and live.Job DescriptionAre you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you'll have the opportunity to complete your internship close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.About the internshipAs an intern, you will join the Energy Transfer & Environment group within Vattenfall R&D Laboratories, working alongside specialists in fluid mechanics and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). Our work includes numerical flow modelling and experimental measurements for energy applications, including hydropower and nuclear power.During the internship, you will work with CFD on a defined fluid-mechanics problem relevant to the group’s ongoing activities. Proposed tasks include preparing simulation models and computational meshes, setting up and running simulations, evaluating flow behaviour, and comparing results with available experimental data or reference cases, where applicable. The specific application and simulation tools will be agreed with the supervisor.The aim of the internship is to develop practical skills in CFD and contribute to the understanding of an energy-related flow problem. You will document modelling assumptions, assess the quality and limitations of the results, and present your findings in a technical report and a final presentation to the group.Duration: Five months, full-time.This internship is for two students. QualificationsWe are looking for students who are currently enrolled in ongoing studies and are eager to put their knowledge into practice through an internship at Vattenfall. You are also someone who identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive, and Safety. title: Interim uthyrare till fastighetsbolag i Trollhättan
description: Vill du driva uthyrning och skapa nya etableringsmöjligheter i ett växande fastighetsbestånd?Vi på Estatement söker nu en erfaren uthyrare för ett konsultuppdrag hos ett kommunägt fastighetsbolag i Trollhättan. Uppdraget innebär ett brett ansvar för uthyrning av kommersiella lokaler, där du får en viktig roll i att utveckla kundrelationer, driva affärer framåt och skapa förutsättningar för nya etableringar.Uppdraget är ett vikariat under en period då ordinarie uthyrare är tjänstledig.Om uppdragetDu ansvarar för uthyrning av kommersiella lokaler, från den första kundkontakten till färdigt avtal. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och ett nära samarbete med både interna och externa aktörer.I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår bland annat att:    Hantera uthyrningsförfrågningar, visningar, offerter och marknadsföring av vakanta lokaler.    Driva pågående hyresgästdialoger och etableringsprocesser framåt.    Förhandla och upprätta kommersiella hyresavtal samt hantera omförhandlingar, tillägg och uppsägningar.    Ta fram underlag och hyreskalkyler för hyresgästanpassningar i samarbete med förvaltare och projektledare.    Ansvara för uthyrning och etablering inom bolagets utvecklingsområden.    Samverka med kommunens näringslivsfunktion och andra aktörer kring etableringsfrågor.    Rapportera till fastighetschefen och delta i enhetens gemensamma arbete.Vi söker dig somVi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av kommersiell uthyrning och som självständigt kan driva hela uthyrningsprocessen. Du är trygg i hyresförhandlingar, har god förståelse för kommersiell hyresjuridik och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor.Formella krav:    Minst tre års erfarenhet av uthyrning av kommersiella lokaler under de senaste tio åren.    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt förhandla och upprätta kommersiella hyresavtal enligt 12 kap. jordabalken.    B-körkort.Meriterande erfarenheter:    Erfarenhet av uthyrning och etablering i utvecklings- eller etableringsområden.    Erfarenhet av uthyrning av industri-, lager- eller logistiklokaler.    Erfarenhet från kommunalt eller offentligt ägt fastighetsbolag.    God kännedom om fastighetsmarknaden i Trollhättan eller Fyrbodal.    Erfarenhet av hyres- och investeringskalkyler för hyresgästanpassningar.    Erfarenhet av fastighetssystem för avtals- och hyresadministration.Uppdragsinformation    Uppdragsperiod: 11 januari–10 juli 2027.    Omfattning: 80 % (32 timmar per vecka).    Placering: Trollhättan, huvudsakligen på plats.Detta uppdrag sker i samarbete mellan Estatement Group och Bemannia.Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.Är du intresserad? Sök tjänsten via länken redan idag!

title: Säljare SME till Securitas Kalmar
description: FöretagsbeskrivningSecuritas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag. Oavsett om du vill jobba mycket eller lite, dag eller natt så behöver vi bli fler.Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar. Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.JobbeskrivningVill du ta nästa steg inom försäljning och samtidigt arbeta med teknik i framkant? Nu söker vi en säljare SME till region Syd som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för hela försäljningsprocessen - från prospektering till vunnen affär, långsiktig kundutveckling och överlämning till drift.Som säljare är du både affärsdrivande och rådgivande. Du möter nya kunder samtidigt som du ansvarar för att vårda och vidareutveckla befintliga kundrelationer. Genom ett nära samarbete med kunden skapar du en djup förståelse för deras verksamhet både i nuläget och över tid. En viktig del av detta arbete är nykundsbearbetning där du arbetar uppsökande för att knyta nya kunde till Securitas. En lika viktig del är fokuset på våra befintliga kunder där du till exempel genomför Advisor‑analyser för att säkerställa att våra lösningar fortsätter vara relevanta, effektiva och affärsmässiga.I rollen fungerar du som arkitekt för vår komplexa produktportfölj. Du formar helheter som kan bestå av allt från passer-, larm- och kameralösningar, parkeringsövervakning och brandtjänster till personell säkerhet - eller enskilda produkter när det är det som skapar bäst kundvärde.En naturlig del av rollen är också att samarbeta med vår driftorganisation. Ni arbetar som ett team där du säkerställer att affären är tydlig och genomförbar, medan driften tar vid och levererar lösningen i praktiken. Genom ett nära samspel skapar ni både lönsamma avtal och en trygg leverans för kunden. Vi passade på att fråga Jocke Wennberg, en av kollegorna i Syd, om vad som är det bästa med jobbet som säljare:"-Det här är ett jobb som både utmanar och utvecklar mig. Jag har stor frihet, mycket ansvar och ingen dag är den andra lik. Här möter jag både nya och befintliga kunder med olika verksamheter, riskbilder och behov. Jag behöver verkligen sätta mig in i kundernas vardag och kombinera det med vår breda portfölj för att skapa lösningar som håller över tid. Som säljare är jag den som knyter ihop alla delar och ser till att varje affär blir rätt - för både kunden och oss."I rollen behöver du hålla hög aktivitet och ansvarar själv för att nå dina försäljningsmål. Vi arbetar med fast grundlön och en tydlig provisionsmodell, där din insats direkt påverkar din ersättning. Hos oss får du dessutom tillgång till ett starkt varumärke, ett erfaret säljteam och ett gediget tekniskt och operativt stöd i vardagen.Tjänsten är placerad i Region Syd, med fokus på Kalmar med omnejd, och vi ser gärna att du också utgår från kontoret i Kalmar. Du blir en del av ett erfaret och engagerat säljteam i regionen samt en viktig partner till våra driftorganisationer och våra kunder. Vi är trygghet. Vi är Securitas.KvalifikationerFör den här rollen krävs flerårig erfarenhet av nykundsbearbetning och försäljning i fält.Med tanke på att vi jobbar med komplex försäljning där vi lägger ner mycket stort engagemang i varje kund, så ser vi framför oss att du har en erfaren och trygg framtoning som vår representant. Det behövs ett starkt självledarskap och att du har förmågan att leverera resultat över tid. Du tar dig fram med förmånsbil, varför B-körkort är ett krav.I övrigt ser vi att du behöver följande för att lyckas i rollen:Krav:    Erfarenhet av att sälja tekniska lösningar, från offert till leverans och avtal    Erfarenhet av nykundsbearbetning och att driva hela säljprocessen självständigt    Flerårig erfarenhet av uppsökande B2B-försäljning      Erfarenhet av att både knyta nya kontakter och att utveckla etablerade kundrelationer    God geografisk kännedom om området Kalmar med omnejd    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska    B-körkortMeriterande:    Erfarenhet som tekniker, installatör eller projektorienterad teknisk funktion     Bakgrund inom IT    Erfarenhet av att jobba med försäljning mot industrinFör att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är intresserad av både resultat och relation.Du är självgående och ansvarsfull med en affärsmässig och problemlösande förmåga. Då tjänsten innehåller många kontaktytor såväl internt som externt, så är det av stor vikt att du är lyhörd, kommunikativ och prestigelös.Ytterligare informationVi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg. Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så om du är intresserad av tjänsten – skicka din ansökan redan idag! Har du frågor kring rollen kontakta rekryterare Åsa Andersson på asa.andersson@securitas.se    Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning.    Vi arbetar med urvalstester    Vi kommunicerar i första hand via mail    Sista ansökningsdag är 25 novemberFör anställning inom Securitas Sverige AB krävs det att du har godkända betyg från första året i gymnasiet i svenska samt blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i auktoriserat bevakningsföretag enligt Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag (den ansökan görs av Securitas). Beroende på befattning kan även säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585) bli aktuell. För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt respektive författning sker en bakgrundskontroll. Bedömningen avser laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning vid prövning av lämplighet för respektive befattning.Lön och anställningsförhållanden baseras på kollektivavtal mellan arbetsgivarorganisationen Säkerhetsföretagen, Unionen samt Ledarna.

title: Global Incident Manager
description: When critical IT incidents occur, clear coordination and decisive action make all the difference. As Global Incident Manager, you lead the response to major and high-impact incidents, bringing the right people together to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.  You join Service Management and work within the Service Stability area alongside Global Incident Managers and colleagues focused on Incident, Problem and Event Management. About the job You’re the central coordination point during major and critical IT incidents, creating structure, driving progress and ensuring clear communication, escalation and decision support. Your scope covers global Incident Management operations, including major incidents, escalation support and Cybersecurity Incident Management (CSIM) when assigned. Your focus is operational incident leadership, while using hands-on experience and lessons learned to continuously improve our ways of working.  Job responsibilities     Lead and coordinate the end-to-end response to P1, major and other high-impact incidents.     Establish effective command and control, with clear responsibilities, action tracking and decision points.     Bring together resolver teams, service providers, technical specialists and business stakeholders to drive incidents toward resolution.     Remove blockers and escalate when service restoration, business continuity, security or regulatory targets are at risk.     Provide timely and clear communication to operational teams, business stakeholders and leadership.     Facilitate post-incident reviews, follow up lessons learned and improvement actions, monitor recurring issues and contribute to improvements in processes, tools and capabilities.     Take part in on-call duties and respond to incidents outside normal business hours, according to the agreed operational model. Location The position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken. Your profile You’ve built solid experience in Incident Management or a similar operational IT field and know how to coordinate major incidents in complex environments. Working across multiple stakeholders comes naturally to you, and you combine operational IT knowledge with a structured approach to service management. Your background includes:     Experience with IT service-management processes and tools in a global or multi-stakeholder environment.     A relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience in IT operations, service management or a related field.     ITIL Foundation or an equivalent service-management certification.     Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. Experience in process improvement, governance, cybersecurity incident response or crisis management is beneficial. Advanced certification within ITIL, Incident Management, security, process management or crisis management, as well as additional relevant languages, are also considered an advantage. Being calm and decisive under pressure, you create clarity when situations are complex and moving quickly. You communicate clearly with technical, business and leadership audiences, take ownership and persistently drive incidents toward service restoration. You’re comfortable influencing others without formal authority while turning incidents and deviations into opportunities for learning. Our culture Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0099533. title: Functional Safety Engineer
description: We are looking for a Functional Safety Engineer within Automotive. You will work in a team and define concepts and set requirements for the client's platform of electrical vehicles. This is an exciting opportunity to work cross-functionally with innovation defining the future and contribute to the success of our company in the transition to zero emission vehicles.Job description:As a Functional Safety Engineer, you will be leading the functional safety activities starting from early concept development, moving on to defining requirements, and ensuring successful verification of the Electromobility system.• Lead the completion of the functional safety activities including Safety Plan, HARA, TARA,  FSC, TSC, refinement of safety requirements and allocation on components.• Lead development of and verification of the Functional Safety work products• Manage ISO 26262 knowledge and safety culture in the team and coach other system engineers in the team.• Represent the team in functional safety forums.• Support the performance of the verification review (VR), confirmation review (CR) and functional safety assessment.• Continuously monitoring/tracking & documenting the system changes for FuSa related products and execute impact analysis.Experience & skills required: • You have M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Physics or Computer Science, Mechatronic or similar.• Minimum 5 years of documented experience within system development and functional safety deliveries according to ISO 26262, preferably within the automotive industry.• Good knowledge of deployment the functional safety standards in entire product lifecycle from start to start of production (SOP), such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, ISO 13849 etc.-Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and best practices of automotive standards and regulations (ISO 21434, UN R155) is a plus• Hands on experience of safety activities, such as Hazard Analysis, technical safety concept, functional safety concept• Experience of automotive E/E system development. (Including system engineering and/or HW/SW development)• Experience from working in requirements management tools.• Fluent in both written and verbal English.• A driven team player with extensive experience from functional safety engineering along with experience in a dynamic and high paced product development environment.• You should possess an analytical mindset, adept problem-solving skills, and a keen interest in acquiring new technical knowledge.• Effective communication skills and strong networking abilities are essential for achieving success in this role.A plus if you have:• Background in charging system or electrical power take-off in the automotive industry.• Previous involvement in functional safety engineering, system engineering or product development in the automotive industry• Experience in system verification processes.• Experience in System Weaver, requirement management tools.•  Fluent in EnglishPersonal Skills required:• Proactive and self motivated•  Excellent communication & presentation skills •  Flexible and analytical•  A team player who easly can collaborate and network•  Work in a structured and organized way•   Enjoy knowledge sharingAdditional info:We schedule interviews on a rolling basis so do not wait until end date.

title: Software Solution Architect
description: Senior Software Architect – GothenburgWe are looking to extend our team with an experienced Senior Software Architect for an assignment within the automotive industry here in Gothenburg.Work Description:As a Senior Software Architect, you will play a key role in defining and developing end-to-end IT solutions supporting embedded software development processes and systems. You will ensure that technical solutions align with enterprise architecture strategies, business requirements, and existing IT environments.The role combines solution architecture, cloud transformation, and hands-on software development, working closely with cross-functional teams across software engineering, technology, production, and aftermarket operations. Architecture Lead – Strategy & Solution Design    Solution Architecture: Define and develop end-to-end technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture principles and business requirements.    Architecture Transformation: Drive the transition from application-centric solutions towards modern microservices and cloud-based architectures.    Technical Strategy: Evaluate existing systems, identify architectural improvements, and support long-term technology roadmaps.    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with solution architects, development teams, business analysts, project managers, and stakeholders.    Process Development: Support the definition, documentation, and implementation of software development processes and architectural standards. Technical & Software Development    Cloud & Microservices: Design scalable, maintainable solutions using modern cloud technologies and microservices architecture.    Software Development: Contribute hands-on to software development, coding, and technical implementation.    DevSecOps & Agile: Support modern development practices, automation, CI/CD, and secure software delivery.    Embedded Software Systems: Develop solutions supporting embedded software processes, tools, and engineering environments.    Cybersecurity: Ensure security considerations are integrated into architecture and software development. Solution Implementation & Collaboration    Technical Guidance: Support development teams in implementing architectural solutions and resolving complex technical challenges.    Solution Integration: Ensure effective integration between systems, applications, and engineering processes.    Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve software architecture, development efficiency, and system performance.    Stakeholder Management: Collaborate across technology, production, aftermarket, and IT delivery organizations. Required Qualifications & Experience    Extensive experience as a Software Architect, IT Solution Architect, or Senior Software Developer.    Strong background in software architecture, system integration, and end-to-end solution design.    Experience with microservices architecture, cloud solutions, and modern software development environments.    Hands-on programming and software development experience.    Good understanding of embedded software development processes and systems.    Knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD, Agile methodologies, and cybersecurity principles.    Experience in process definition, documentation, and implementation.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.    Ability to work independently and collaborate across multiple technical teams.    Fluent English, written and spoken. Meritorious Qualifications:    Experience from the automotive industry, preferably within embedded software engineering environments.    Experience driving cloud transformation and modernization of enterprise applications.    Experience working in large, cross-functional engineering organizations. Personal Qualities:We are looking for an open-minded, proactive, and collaborative team player with strong technical expertise and a genuine interest in technology. You are a fast learner who enjoys solving complex challenges, sharing knowledge, and contributing to a positive and engaging work environment.Assignment Details:    Location: Gothenburg, Sweden    Industry: Automotive    Role: Senior Software Architect

title: Operations Manager
description: At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. Through our technologies and services, we help customers produce safe food in a sustainable and efficient way.Within Tetra Pak Key Components, we are now looking for an Operations Manager – Separation to lead our operational organization and drive performance across Application Engineering, Order Engineering, Product Support, Technical Issue Management and operational excellence activities.Reporting to the Manager Separation, you will lead a team that ensure efficient execution and high-quality support throughout the product lifecycle. You will be instrumental in creating a responsive, efficient and customer-focused organization.The position is permanent and preferably based in Lund, Sweden. Some international travel may be required.What you will doAs Operations Manager, you will lead the organization responsible for operational performance within the separation business. Driving lead-time, forecasting and sales goals.Main responsibilities:    Lead, coach and develop teams within Application Engineering, Order Engineering, Product Support and Technical Issue Management.    Ensure efficient execution of customer order fulfillment and support activities.    Secure that application know-how is effectively translated into customer solutions, operational excellence and business results.    Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase productivity, quality and responsiveness.    Lead technical issue management and support escalation handling.    Collaborate closely with customers, Sales, Services, Product Management, Supply Chain and Manufacturing.    Drive operational planning, capacity management and resource allocation.    Develop and continuously improve processes, tools and ways of working.    Monitor, analyse and improve operational performance and key business metrics.    Foster a culture focused on customer success, accountability and teamwork.    Manage departmental objectives, resources and budgets.As a member of the Separation leadership team, you will contribute to both operational and strategic decisions affecting the business.We believe you have    Proven leadership experience in operations, engineering, application support, technical support, service or manufacturing environments.    Experience leading customer-facing technical organizations.    Strong business understanding and operational mindset.    Experience driving performance improvements, change initiatives and organizational development.    Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trust and drive alignment across functions, regions and organizational levels.    Experience interacting with customers and translating customer needs into operational priorities.    Strong analytical skills.    Decisive decision making.    Excellent communication and collaboration skills.    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.You are a leader who creates structure, alignment and results. You enjoy solving complex challenges and building high-performing teams that consistently deliver to customers and stakeholders.You thrive in an international and dynamic environment where operational excellence and people leadership go hand in hand. Through strong stakeholder management, engagement and collaboration, you create the conditions for sustainable performance and long-term success.We Offer You    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangementsApply NowIf you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what's good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.30.11.2026For trade union information, contact Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320 and Sweden Engineers Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533.Questions about your application contact Hanna Edström at +46 46 36 5880For trade union information, contact Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320 and Sweden Engineers Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533.Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work.
