title: Sjuksköterskor till vård-och omsorgsboende och resursteam inom HSL 3!
description: Ref: 20262479 Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete där du får göra skillnad för våra patienter och samtidigt vara en del av ett engagerat team? Nu söker vi två sjuksköterskor till HSL-sektion 3 inom vård- och omsorgsboende i Malmö stad. En tjänst är fast placerad på ett våra boenden och den andra som resurssjuksköterska inom sektionen.Hos oss arbetar vi tillsammans för att skapa en trygg, personcentrerad och kvalitativ vård. Vi värdesätter samarbete, engagemang och ett öppet arbetsklimat där vi tar tillvara på varandras kompetenser och erfarenheter.Om tjänsternaFast Sjuksköterskatjänst till ett av våra boendenI HSL 3 ingår följande sju vård- och omsorgsboenden: Apelrosen, Husiegård, Soltofta, Blombuketten, Trevnaden, Jylland och Sjöstaden. Nu söker vi efter en sjuksköterska till ett av dessa boenden.Resurssjuksköterska inom HSL 3Som resurssjuksköterska har du ett omväxlande uppdrag där du arbetar på olika vård- och omsorgsboenden inom HSL-sektion 3 utifrån verksamheternas behov. Du kan komma att arbeta på olika boenden med kort varsel, men även ha längre placeringar vid exempelvis kollegors frånvaro. När du är placerad på ett boende ansvarar du för de patienter som ingår i uppdraget och utför samma arbetsuppgifter som övriga sjuksköterskor inom sektionen.I HSL 3 ingår följande sju vård- och omsorgsboenden: Apelrosen, Husiegård, Soltofta, Blombuketten, Trevnaden, Jylland och Sjöstaden.Vi erbjuder dig    Ett meningsfullt och självständigt arbete där du får möjlighet att påverka patienternas vardag.    Ett nära samarbete med engagerade kollegor och andra professioner.    Introduktion anpassad efter din erfarenhet och dina förutsättningar.    Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling och erfarenhetsutbyte inom verksamheten.Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta som sjuksköterska hos oss? Läs https://malmo.se/Jobb/Verksamhet/Halsa--vard--och-omsorgsforvaltningen/Jobba-som-sjukskoterska/Utveckling-nyfikenhet-och-narhet-till-patienterna-driver-Anna-i-sitt-arbete-som-sjukskoterska.html eller https://malmo.se/Vard--och-omsorgsboenden-i-Malmo/Alla-vard--och-omsorgsboenden.html.ArbetsuppgifterSom sjuksköterska ansvarar du för patienternas omvårdnad och medicinska insatser. Du arbetar självständigt med att bedöma, planera, organisera och följa upp hälso- och sjukvårdsinsatser utifrån patienternas individuella behov.I uppdraget ingår att handleda, utbilda och delegera arbetsuppgifter till omvårdnadspersonal. Du arbetar personcentrerat och involverar patienten i beslut som rör den egna vården. Du har ett nära samarbete med anhöriga, omvårdnadspersonal och övriga professioner för att skapa en god och sammanhållen vård.Du samverkar även med primärvården och andra aktörer inom hälso- och sjukvården för att säkerställa att patienternas behov tillgodoses.KvalifikationerVi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska med minst två års yrkeserfarenhet. För tjänsterna krävs även att du har:    Erfarenhet av samverkan med olika aktörer inom vård och omsorg.    God digital kompetens och vana av att dokumentera.    Kunskap om gällande lagstiftning, mål och riktlinjer inom hälso- och sjukvården.    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.    B-körkort och förmåga att cykla.Det är meriterande om du har:    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med personer med demenssjukdom.    Erfarenhet av arbete inom kommunal hälso- och sjukvård.    Erfarenhet av dokumentation i Procapita.Som person är du trygg i din yrkesroll och har god förmåga att självständigt planera, organisera och prioritera ditt arbete. Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till olika situationer och verksamheternas behov.Du är lyhörd och kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa goda samarbeten med såväl kollegor som patienter och anhöriga. Du har ett pedagogiskt förhållningssätt och känner dig bekväm med att handleda och vägleda omvårdnadspersonal. Du tar ansvar och bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat där patientens behov alltid står i centrum.Information om tjänsternaAnställningsform: Tillsvidare Omfattning: Heltid Antal tjänster: 2 Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse Arbetstid: 38,25h/vecka + tjänstgöring var sjätte helg.Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningstiden. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! OBS: På grund av underhåll är ReachMee stängt från fredag 20/11 kl. 21.00 till söndag 22/11 kl. 00.00. Under tiden går det inte att skicka in ansökningar. Du är varmt välkommen att ansöka före eller efter underhållet.Om arbetsplatsenVi i Hälsa-, vård- och omsorgsförvaltningen är med våra ca 5 500 medarbetare Malmö stads näst största förvaltning. Vi har det samlade ansvaret för Malmös hemtjänst, vårdboende, mötesplatser, hemsjukvård och rehabilitering och dess biståndshandläggning. Tillsammans skapar vi en dynamisk och framtidssmart organisation. En organisation som kan möta dagens behov och framtidens utmaningar. Med engagemang, nyfikenhet och hjärta gör vi vardagen enklare för tiotusentals Malmöbor. Följ vår spännande utveckling på https://sv-se.facebook.com/halsavardochomsorg/ Malmö stads verksamheter är organiserade i 14 förvaltningar. Vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att skapa välfärd och hållbar samhällsutveckling. Tillsammans med Malmöborna utvecklar vi en ännu bättre stad att bo, verka och vara i; olikheter, livserfarenheter och talanger gör Malmö till en smart stad i hjärtat av Europa. Världens kunskap finns här.Läs om Malmö stad som arbetsgivare här https://malmo.se/Jobb.htmlÖvrigtNär du söker jobb hos oss kommer vi be dig att visa upp ett utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister. Utdraget vi vill se är "kontroll av egna uppgifter" och du behöver själv begära ut det via en blankett som du hittar på polisens hemsida: http://bit.ly/polisens-blankettMalmö stad strävar efter att medarbetarna ska representera den mångfald som finns i vår stad. Vi välkomnar därför sökande som kan bidra till att vi som arbetsgivare kan uppfylla Malmöbornas behov.Malmö stad är sedan 2015 finskt förvaltningsområde. Det innebär att kommunen ska informera om finska minoritetens rättigheter, erbjuda äldreomsorg helt eller till väsentlig del på finska samt främja det finska språket och finsk kultur. Det innebär också en rättighet att använda finska i kontakten med oss i kommunen. Eftersom Malmö stad är finskt förvaltningsområde är det meriterande om du kan tala finska. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! / Tervetuloa hakemuksesi kanssa!Läs mer om finskt förvaltningsområde här: https://malmo.se/finsktforvaltningsomrade

title: Head of FX Sales Stockholm
description: Are you passionate about customers, sales, financial markets and leadership? Do you want to lead a highly skilled FX Sales team and play a key role in shaping the future of Swedbank’s FX business? Join us in our mission to help clients grow throughout their lifecycle through proactive advice, strong customer relationships and sustainable business development.Your responsibilities:• Lead a business-driven team focused on profitability, customer value and sustainable growth through proactive client engagement and strong internal collaboration.• Strengthen client relationships through a strong risk advisory and solution-oriented approach.• Develop our FX Services to be the preferred choice for small and mid-sized corporates, as well as selected large corporate clients.• Ensure to be at the forefront of managing customers’ currency flows linked to international payments.• Attract and retain high performing employees who are committed to the One corporate business idea of scaling business and achieving excellence in daily banking support and service.• Maintain a high and healthy profitability and a sound risk level in own portfolio.• Assess and improve the performance of your team members.• Ensure the continuous development of your team and continue to build a team with high level of team spirit and engagement.• Align your work and the team’s contribution to the bank’s direction and strategy. What is needed in this role:• Proven leadership experience with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams.    Extensive experience in Foreign Exchange (FX), including FX sales and advisory services for corporate clients.    Proven ability to drive sales growth, business performance and sustainable results.    Strong relationship management skills, with experience engaging senior decision-makers and key stakeholders.    Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Swedish and English.    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or equivalent relevant experience.    Ability to lead in line with Swedbank's values: Open, Simple and Caring.With us, you can experience:    Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.    Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.    An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.    A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.    Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.This is our team...We are a dedicated and successful team with many experienced professionals. We work with a proactive sales responsibility towards corporate and institutional clients across both Swedbank and the Savings Banks, where we offer products based on the customers' needs. Our work is very much characterized by an analytical way of working to help customers make informed decisions. Internally, we collaborate closely with Client Executives and other product specialists, including Trade Finance and Cash Management, to grow the FX business and deliver the best possible client offering. Together, we work to maximize customer value every day through close collaboration, strong client engagement and a shared commitment to excellence. In our team we value teamwork and we expect you to be a collaborative and engaged team player!As leaders, we trust our people and delegate responsibility, we strive to build a team with an open, positive and transparent environment, where everyone can grow and have the possibility to learn from each other." Cornelia Reifeldt, your future manager.We look forward to receiving your application by 27.09.2026. Location: StockholmRecruiting manager: Cornelia Reifeldt We may start the selection during the application period and welcome your application as soon as possible.We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.We have done our medium for recruitment and therefore decline contact with advertising sellers or sellers of other recruitment services.Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome.#LI-LB1

title: Are you Burger King’s next CEO in Sweden?
description: Be a part of Burger King´s flaming growth!Burger King is looking for a CEO Sweden who wants to set the direction, develop the team and drive growth across the Swedish market, with a focus on guest experience, operational excellence and profitability.Who are we?Burger King is one of the world’s most iconic restaurant brands, known for our flame-grilled burgers and unique flavors. We operate more than 290 restaurants in Sweden, Denmark and Norway and are in strong growth, continuously expanding and upgrading our restaurant portfolio across the region.Close collaboration between our restaurants, our franchisees and our central functions is essential to delivering quality, efficiency and long-term results. Now we are looking for a CEO who wants to take the lead on that journey in Sweden.Your roleAs CEO Sweden, you carry overall responsibility for the business in the Swedish market. You drive the strategy, lead the management team, and drive sales, profitability, and guest satisfaction.You make strategic decisions across operations, people, financials, equipment, guest experience and facilities, and you turn them into clear plans and action. You lead by example and create a culture where high standards and strong results go hand in hand.You are the key link between the board, shareholders, franchisees, business partners and authorities, and you make sure the market and the company’s future are clearly understood at the highest level.Your responsibilities    Own and develop the business strategy for Sweden, including clear goals for sales, operations, guest satisfaction and profitability.    Prepare and implement business plans that combine cost-effective operations with market development and growth.    In collaboration with the COO, create action plans to close gaps in key operational metrics such as speed of service, product quality, friendliness, traffic and sales, and provide strategic and tactical guidance on restaurant operations, standards and guidelines, from service and product preparation to guest relations and Unit Manager development.    Oversee financial performance, investments, and other business initiatives, with full P&L responsibility.    Lead, delegate to and support the executive team, and provide guidance and motivation to drive maximum performance.    Develop and maintain trust-based relationships with shareholders, franchisees, business partners, and authorities.    Make sure company policies and legal guidelines are communicated throughout the organization and always followed.    Analyze challenges and situations as they arise and provide solutions that support company growth.    Give the board strategic advice and an accurate view of the market and the company’s future.Who are you?You are a strong business leader who leads by example and drives results through clear behaviors and high standards. You combine business acumen with excellent leadership and organizational skills.You make quick decisions, handle conflicting priorities, and communicate clearly, both in writing and in person. You are motivated by improving operations, strengthening the guest experience, and developing a culture that delivers ambitious targets.Qualifications and experience    You have proven experience as CEO, Country Manager, or Director.    You have experience in QSR, retail, or the food industry. This is a must.    You have demonstrable experience in developing strategic and business plans.    You have excellent leadership and organizational skills and strong business acumen.    You have knowledge of financial concepts, P&L management, and operations management, as well as a strong understanding of corporate finance and performance measures.    You have a thorough understanding of market changes and the forces that influence the business.    You have excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.    You have outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities.What we offerA multicultural and international organization with many opportunities to learn and expand your experience. The work takes place across Sweden, with a base at our HQ in Stockholm. We offer a strong compensation package including a company car allowance.

title: Finance Business Partner
description: Securitas Risk Intelligence (SRI)Securitas Risk Intelligence delivers actionable intelligence on the global security and threat landscape, creating decision-making advantage and confidence to protect people, property, and assets. As part of Securitas' intelligence-led approach to security, we combine data- and tech-driven insights with expert human analysis to deliver risk intelligence that is accurate, timely, relevant, and actionable.About the roleReporting to the CFO of Security Risk Management (SRM) and being part of SRI Leadership Team - the Finance Business Partner owns business controlling and performance management for SRI and acts as the finance business partner to VP SRI. The role will make SRI’s economics more visible and actionable, while establishing a more rigorous, forward-looking and technology-enabled approach to commercial, financial and operational performance. The role will be collaborating with dedicated financial control and financial shared service.SRI needs stronger dedicated financial ownership and deeper performance insight. The role will improve the speed and quality of decisions, strengthen adherence to the financial model, raise the quality of business cases and create systematic follow-up on expected benefits, supporting sustainable and profitable growth.Responsibilities    Business partnering and decision support: Act as the day-to-day finance partner to VP SRI and SRI leadership. Translate commercial and operational choices into financial implications, alternatives and recommendations. Challenge assumptions constructively and maintain an independent finance perspective.    Performance management: Own the SRI performance view across commercial performance, financial results, operational drivers and forward-looking indicators. Explain underlying causes, identify risks and opportunities early, and convert analysis into clear actions and follow-up. Runs the recurring business reviews.    Planning and forecasting: Own the SRI business-planning cycle, including budget, forecasts and longer-term outlook. Drive timelines, assumptions, quality and consistency with the agreed financial model. Ensure forecasts are robust, evidence-based and action-oriented.    Business cases and benefits tracking: Strengthen the quality and consistency of investment and commercial business cases. Test assumptions, quantify scenarios and risks, and establish disciplined post-decision follow-up against expected outcomes.    Reporting, data and automation: Improve data structures, definitions and controls. Use automation and AI where they materially improve speed, quality, scalability or insight.    Finance team collaboration: Work closely with the SRI Financial Controller, setting priorities for reporting, analysis and finance support. Leverage the Controller's ownership of financial control, data integrity and recurring processes to enable stronger performance management and business decision support.    Support to SRM: While the primary focus is on SRI, the role will provide targeted analytical and ad-hoc support to the CFO of SRM and contribute to broader SRM performance-management priorities and develop towards a wider remit over time.RequirementsCandidate profile    Analytical strength: analytical ability and data literacy. Able to structure ambiguous questions, reconcile conflicting information, identify root causes and form evidence-based conclusions.    Finance foundation: Grounding in business controlling, performance management, financial planning, modelling and business cases. Connecting operational drivers to P&L impact.    Commercial judgement: Understands that finance exists to improve decisions, not only to report results. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders while remaining pragmatic.    Learning agility and potential: Learns unfamiliar businesses quickly, actively seeks responsibility, forms independent views and demonstrates clear capacity to grow into a broader role.    Technology mindset: Curiosity about data, systems, automation and AI. Looks for scalable ways to improve finance processes and insight.    Communication: Able to explain conclusions clearly and focus stakeholders on what matters. Executive polish is desirable but can be developed. Fluency in English.Indicative experience    Experience in business controlling, FP&A, performance management, transaction services, consulting, revenue operations or a comparable analytical finance role.    Demonstrated ownership of complex analysis, planning or business-case work, not only production of recurring reports.    Experience working with/presenting to senior business stakeholders.    Evidence of improving a process, analysis or decision workflow through better use of data, systems, automation or AI.    University degree in finance, economics, engineering, data or a comparable discipline.Personal characteristics    Curious and willing to investigate until the underlying logic is understood.    Independent in judgement and effective in a collaborative environment.    High ownership and pace, with the discipline to finish and follow through.    Comfortable moving between detailed analysis and broader commercial implications.    Ambitious to grow and motivated by building capability and improving the business.Working conditionsThe role is based in Stockholm and involves occasional travelling.Hybrid model applies (with 3 days in the office per week).If this sounds like the right next step in your career, don't hesitate and apply!

title: Kommunikationschef TEKO
description: Om TEKOTEKO representerar textilindustrin i Sverige. Våra medlemsföretag verkar inom områden som teknisk textil, arbetskläder, medicinsk textil, outdoor, konfektion, och luftfilter.Branschen befinner sig mitt i en omfattande omställning där frågor som hållbarhet, innovation, kompetensförsörjning och ny EU-lagstiftning står högt på agendan. Här spelar TEKO en viktig roll genom att företräda medlemsföretagens intressen, erbjuda kvalificerad arbetsgivarservice och bidra till branschens långsiktiga konkurrenskraft.Om rollenSom kommunikationsansvarig har du det övergripande ansvaret för TEKO kommunikation. Du utgör organisationens kommunikationsfunktion och har en bred, självständig roll där du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt. Du ansvarar för att driva och utveckla vårt varumärke, våra budskap och våra kommunikationskanaler.Du blir en viktig del av en organisation, med stort inflytande, där kommunikation, opinionsbildning och näringspolitik går hand i hand. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med kollegor, medlemsföretag, media och andra intressenter, både i Sverige och internationellt som vår europeiska organisation Euratex.Hos oss får du stor frihet, korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt och resultat.Du kommer bland annat att:    Ansvara för och utveckla TEKO:s interna och externa kommunikation.    Utveckla och förvalta teko.se samt våra digitala kanaler.    Planera, producera och publicera innehåll för webb, sociala medier, nyhetsbrev, press och tryckt material.    Ta fram budskap, vägledningar, artiklar, debattunderlag och annat kommunikationsmaterial.    Projektleda och kommunicera kring seminarier, webbinarier och branschevenemang, inklusive TEKO-dagen.    Följa upp och analysera kommunikationsinsatser för att utveckla innehåll, kanaler och arbetssätt.    Stödja kollegor i kommunikations- och påverkansarbete inom TEKO:s fokusområden: kompetensförsörjning, arbetsgivarservice, innovation, forskning och hållbarhet.Vi söker dig somÄr en erfaren kommunikatör med ett starkt samhälls- och näringslivsintresse. Du är en skicklig skribent som kan omsätta komplexa frågor till tydlig och engagerande kommunikation för olika målgrupper.Du trivs i en roll där du får växla mellan strategi och genomförande och där du är bra på att agera självständigt och själv driva ditt arbete framåt.Vi tror att du:    Har flera års erfarenhet av kvalificerat kommunikationsarbete.    Är en mycket god skribent på svenska och engelska.    Har erfarenhet av digital kommunikation och innehållsproduktion.    Är van att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt.    Har ett stort samhällsintresse.    Har god projektledningsförmåga och kan driva initiativ från idé till genomförande.    Har förståelse för näringslivets villkor och hur kommunikation kan bidra till verksamhetsmål.Det är meriterande om du har:    Erfarenhet från bransch-, medlems- eller arbetsgivarorganisation.    Erfarenhet av opinionsbildning, public affairs eller påverkanskommunikation.    Erfarenhet av att planera och genomföra event och seminarier.    Kunskaper i exempelvis Optimizely, Ungapped, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Canva eller Adobe Creative Suite.Som personDu är självgående, initiativrik och resultatorienterad. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och samarbetsinriktad, med god förmåga att skapa förtroende och bygga relationer.Du gillar att ta ansvar, ser möjligheter i förändring och motiveras av att skapa kommunikation som gör skillnad.TEKO erbjuder    Möjlighet att påverka utvecklingen i en framtidsorienterad bransch.    En bred och varierad roll med stort eget ansvar.    Arbeta nära näringsliv, politik och europeiska beslutsprocesser.    Frihet att utveckla kommunikation, arbetssätt och aktiviteter.    Engagerade och kunniga kollegor med stark laganda.    Ett centralt beläget kontor på Östermalm – men räkna med att resa till både Borås och Bryssel.    Flexibelt arbete med delvis möjlighet till distansarbete    Trygga och attraktiva anställningsvillkorAnsökanTycker du att tjänsten låter intressant? Varmt välkommen att söka!Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.Läs mer om oss här: https://www.teko.se/Skicka in din ansökan genom att klicka på länken. Vi samarbetar med People Provide i denna rekrytering.Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryteringsansvarig Jenny Stiernstedt, jenny@peopleprovide.se.

title: Assistant Brand Manager
description: At Beiersdorf, home of Nivea, Eucerin, Hansaplast & Labello we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society. The Assistant Brand Manager will drive the Personal Care categories with support from the Senior Brand Manager. Develop and execute brand strategies to drive growth and enhance brand equity. This role involves handling product launches, managing marketing campaigns, and analyzing brand performance. Identify opportunities to enhance market share and drive net sales growth. This is a Fixed Term Contract for 12-18 monthsYour TasksSupport Brand Strategy Development    Assist in the formulation and execution of brand strategies and marketing plans to achieve business objectives.    Conduct competitive analysis to identify trends and opportunities for brand growth.    Identify opportunities within the global assortment and collaborate with RGM/category teams to propose Nordic/Swedish launches.    Identify opportunities to enhance brand performance throughout the year.    Prepare and present core brand performance meeting presentations.    Occasionally when agreed present brand presentation to retailers.    Identify opportunities to enhance brand performance throughout the year.    Present brand plans to senior stakeholders and secure approval for marketing activities and product launches. Product Launches and Management    Collaborate with the Senior Brand Manager on L/RL initiatives, incl. market assessments and product positioning.    Coordinate the execution of product launches, ensuring all marketing materials and assets are prepared and delivered on time.    Manage brand initiatives from start to finish, executing planned activities and tracking launches. Brand Performance and Development    Proactively monitors and reports on own brand/categories and competitor performance driving interventions to improve results and find opportunities    Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders, summarizing brand performance and campaign effectiveness. Campaign Management    Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across various channels, including digital, social media, and influencer initiatives.    Adaptation of global/regional assets, in conjunction with third party agencies and in agreement with Senior Brand Manager and in alignment with Nordic and regional strategy Cross-Functional Collaboration    Collaborate with sales/supply chain/finance to ensure alignment on brand initiatives and objectives.    Assist in managing relationships with external partners, incl agencies, vendors, and retailers.    Work closely with the supply/demand planner to ensure a smooth supply of NPD and key products International collaboration    Collaborates with team across all Nordic markets    Collaboration with the EUNA (Europe and North America) team to influence assortment needs, development of strategy and communication that fits to the local market    Exchanges with NOE (Northern Europe) colleaguesYour Profile    Degree educated in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline.1-3 years' experience in brand management, marketing, or a similar role.    Experience within FMCG, consumer goods, or retail is advantageous.    A self-motivated individual who thrives in a collaborative team environment and enjoys driving results.    Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions.    Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities. High attention to detail and a commitment to delivering quality work.    Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.    A strong understanding of the social media and digital marketing landscape. Fluency in English and Swedish is essential.    Knowledge of Danish, Finnish, or Norwegian would be beneficial. At Beiersdorf, we see you as a person – far beyond your title or role. Our goal is to provide the flexibility and support you need for your professional and personal success through our work environment. That is why we have a lot to offer! Private health insurance, pension, 30 days vacation per year, Wellness fee, Meal vouchers, discounted product purchases, leave entitlements and wellbeing support to include access to an excellent Employee Assistance Programme. At Beiersdorf, we believe that every individual brings unique perspectives, experiences, and strengths that deserve to be valued and celebrated. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where everyone feels empowered to be themselves, thrive in their role, and work in ways that enable them to succeed. Through flexibility, understanding, accessibility, and meaningful support, we aim to ensure that all colleagues feel respected, heard, and able to reach their full potential. We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment experience and are happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process to support you.

title: Environmental Coordinator
employer: HOCHTIEF Infrastructure GmbH Tyskland Sverige     Filial
description: Environmental CoordinatorOL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, SwedenShape the future of Swedish infrastructureHOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.We are currently looking for a collaborative Environmental Coordinator to join the OL31 railway project in Vagnhärad. This is a role within one of Sweden's most important infrastructure projects, where safety, coordination and collaboration are critical to success.About the ProjectThe OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden.The project involves complex civil engineering works, including tunnels, bridges, earthworks and rail infrastructure. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme while supporting the recruitment and development of a diverse, international project organization.About the RoleAs an Environmental Coordinator, you will support the project organization in the daily management of environmental matters and ensure compliance with project, client, and regulatory environmental requirements. You will act as the environmental team's operational representative within the production organization, providing hands-on support on site and helping to identify, manage, and mitigate environmental risks at an early stage.Key Responsibilities·        Conduct regular environmental inspections, site walks, and environmental audits.·        Provide day-to-day support and guidance to site management and production teams on environmental matters.·        Monitor compliance with environmental requirements from Trafikverket, authorities, permits, and project procedures.·        Support and participate in investigations of environmental incidents, deviations, and non-conformities, and follow up on corrective actions.·        Support production teams with matters related to material and soil mass management.·        Monitor water management activities, treatment solutions, and environmental protection measures.·        Ensure compliance with project chemical management requirements and support chemical handling processes.·        Prepare, maintain, and follow up environmental documentation, records, and reporting.·        Act as the operational link between the environmental function and the production organization.·        Promote environmental awareness and best practices across the project.Your ProfileMandatory Requirements·        2-4 years of experience in environmental coordination within construction, civil engineering, infrastructure, or similar projects.·        Practical experience working closely with production teams on active construction sites.·        Experience with environmental inspections, soil and material management, water management, and chemical management.·        Ability to independently identify, manage, and resolve environmental-related issues.·        Strong communication and collaboration skills.·        Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.·        Good knowledge of Swedish and English, both written and spoken.·        Valid Category B driving license. Preferred Qualifications·        Experience working on large-scale infrastructure or railway projects.·        Knowledge of Swedish environmental legislation and authority requirements.·        Experience working with environmental permits, compliance monitoring, and contractor environmental management.·        Experience supporting environmental investigations and corrective action processes.·        Familiarity with Trafikverket's environmental requirements and project environments.·        Relevant academic background in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field.Language Requirements·        Fluent Swedish, preferably native-level or equivalent proficiency.·        Professional English language skills, both written and spoken. We Offer    The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.    An international working environment within a leading global construction company.    Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.    The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.    Expected start date: Q1 2027 (January or February). Location Vagnhärad, SwedenApplyIf you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se,or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/ Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

title: Risk & Compliance Officer
description: At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. And we need people like you to make it happen.We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.Job SummaryAn important and growing part of the role is to lead the development and coordination of Tetra Pak's contribution to food resilience and civil preparedness in Sweden, translating strategic priorities into an actionable roadmap together with relevant business owners.Risk & Compliance Officer – Resilience & SecurityAB Tetra Pak Site Management safeguards the licence to operate and creates the conditions for Tetra Pak’s businesses in Sweden at all sites to operate safely, sustainably, efficiently and resiliently by providing local governance, compliance, infrastructure and cross-company coordination, as well as managing and coordinating relationships with relevant external authorities within these areas.Our team’s purpose is to enable decisions that protect, strengthen and create value for Tetra Pak. We connect people, priorities and decisions, simplify governance, strengthen compliance and contribute to business resilience.This is a permanent position based in Lund, Sweden.What you will doYou will work across regulatory compliance, preparedness and security, driving assignments from assessment to implementation and follow-up. Depending on business priorities and developments in the external environment, you will:    Independently monitor and assess regulatory developments, determine implications for Swedish operations together with legal and subject-matter experts, and recommend prioritised actions to management    Lead implementation of relevant security and preparedness requirements, translating them into clear responsibilities, plans and controls, and following up on progress and gaps    Drive the development and continuous improvement of crisis management frameworks, plans and exercises    Lead and coordinate initiatives within business and civil preparedness, including Tetra Pak's role in the Swedish food system    Represent Tetra Pak in selected external networks, standardisation activities and public-private partnerships    Build relationships with authorities, industry organisations, academia and other relevant stakeholders    Lead risk, compliance and preparedness workstreams in cross-functional projects, ensuring requirements become operational solutions with clear business ownership    Provide senior management with risk assessments and decision material, including options, trade-offs and recommendations    Challenge unnecessary complexity and support pragmatic, business-oriented governance A particular focus: Preparedness and Food ResilienceAn important and growing part of the role is to lead the development and coordination of Tetra Pak’s contribution to food resilience and civil preparedness in Sweden, translating strategic priorities into an actionable roadmap together with relevant business owners.This work connects business perspectives with government, industry, academia and wider society, and helps shape Tetra Pak’s role, priorities and milestones within food resilience initiatives.We believe you have    A relevant university degree at master's level, or equivalent, in law, engineering, risk management, security, crisis management, civil preparedness or a related field    At least seven years of relevant experience in risk management, regulatory compliance, security, civil preparedness, crisis management or business continuity    Strong experience leading complex cross-functional assignments from assessment to implementation    The ability to interpret complex requirements, develop governance and controls, advise senior management and influence across functions without formal line authority    Experience in areas such as Protective Security, NIS2, CER, crisis management, civil defence, business continuity or critical infrastructure is highly valuable    Knowledge of Swedish regulatory structures and experience interacting with authorities or other public-sector stakeholders is an advantage    Fluent Swedish and English, written and spokenWho you areThe scope is deliberately broad. You do not need to be an expert in every regulation, but you must bring solid specialist expertise in relevant areas and the ability to independently assess unfamiliar issues, recognise the limits of your expertise and engage the right specialists. We expect you to combine analytical depth with the judgement and drive to deliver results in a complex stakeholder environment. You bring specialist depth in relevant areas, combined with the judgement to assess unfamiliar issues, involve the right experts and drive work forward in a complex stakeholder environment. You are comfortable with ambiguity, able to connect people across organisational boundaries, and skilled at turning complex requirements into clear action.You also communicate with credibility and clarity, whether engaging with specialists, senior management, authorities or external partners.We Offer You    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements Apply NowIf you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 2026-11-30To know more about the position, contact Stefan Green at +46 46 36 1090.Questions about your application: Josephine Malalla at +46 46 36 5253.For trade union information: Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533, Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320.Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. title: Quantity Surveyor/Change Management
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you'll doRight now, we are looking for a Quantity Surveyor/Change Management for one of our project areas. In this role, you will report to the Project Controls Manager and sit within the specific area. The team supports the project within its assigned area through cost, schedule and performance control.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following, but as we are a growing company with very little siloing between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Review and validate estimates, quantities and cost calculations for assigned packages.    Assess costs against design information, project scope and contractual requirements.    Review contractor change orders and variations, including quantities, cost build-ups and supporting justifications.    Challenge submissions where evidence or alignment with scope is unclear, and provide documented findings and recommendations.    Assess the cost impact of project changes and contribute to change control.    Coordinate with Project Controls, Contracts, Engineering and package teams to resolve information gaps and document cost assessments.    Support project reviews and follow up on agreed actions.Placement: Boden Employment type: Fixed-term employment (12–24 months)What you'll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking, and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:    Experience in quantity surveying, estimating, cost assurance, or change and variation management on complex industrial or construction projects.    Experience reviewing large or complex packages and coordinating assessments across multidisciplinary teams.    Strong understanding of quantities, estimates, cost build-ups, design information and contractual scope.    Ability to identify gaps or risks, challenge cost submissions with evidence, and make clear recommendations.    Ability to maintain clear and traceable assessments and supporting documentation.    An analytical, detail-oriented and proactive approach, with the confidence to raise concerns constructively.Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.Our Boden Site (Choose one)Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.Boden VideoOur Stockholm Office (Choose one)Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you’ll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city’s energy and amenities.

title: Bidding Assistant
description: About the companyThe company will be presented at the first interview with the responsible recruiter.About the roleAs a Mid-level Bidding Assistant, you will support the full bidding lifecycle. You will help interpret customer requirements, develop high-quality bid documents and coordinate resources across teams. Working closely with project teams and stakeholders, you will make sure every bid is competitive, compliant and delivered on time. The role is customer-facing. title: Technical Supervisor Equipment and Execution (m/f/x)

title: Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner
description: We are looking for a Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner for a global company in Gothenburg (Mölndal). Start is December 16th, 5 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg (Mölndal).Assignment descriptionRetail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner﻿ Background:Our client has established a Retail Sales Job Architecture and Skills Building Framework across its Personal Care and Consumer Tissue business areas. The framework provides a common capability foundation across four Sales Profiles: Commercial Management, Account Management, Field Sales and Sales Enablement.﻿ The framework connects sales roles with functional and leadership skills, future capability requirements, onboarding, and ongoing development. The architecture, skills priorities, and strategic direction have already been defined. The objective of this assignment is not to redesign those foundations, but to translate them into a practical, scalable Retail Sales Academy with role- and skill-based learning journeys delivered through the company's Learning Experience Platform (LXP).﻿ The LXP brings learning resources together in one place and enables employees to discover relevant learning opportunities, career paths, and development experiences aligned to their needs, interests, and goals.﻿ The organization is seeking support to establish a practical and scalable Retail Sales Academy. The Academy will support approximately 1,500 employees across more than 20 markets. The focus is on implementing the existing framework and creating effective learning journeys rather than redefining capability models or long-term strategy.Estimated project duration: 4–6 months﻿ Overview and NeedEnglish will serve as the master language for the Academy. However, the solution must be designed for successful deployment across Europe, North America, and Latin America, ensuring that language does not become a barrier to understanding, adoption, or application.As a significant proportion of users are Spanish-speaking, it is important to accommodate local language requirements, particularly as many sales activities are conducted in local languages.A key principle is to use and adapt existing learning content wherever possible before creating new content. Learning journeys should provide meaningful progression and connect learning with practical application, manager coaching, and peer learning rather than simply aggregating courses.﻿ Responsibilities- Define the Academy structure, learner navigation, and curriculum, including governance, ownership, and maintenance.- Review existing learning content and map suitable assets to priority roles, skills, and proficiency levels.- Design coherent learning journeys with clear learning outcomes, logical sequencing, practical application activities, and reinforcement mechanisms.- Identify priority content gaps and selectively adapt or develop content where existing resources are insufficient.- Define a scalable language and localization strategy using English as the master language and local-language content where needed.- Prepare learning-path specifications, taxonomy structures, and metadata requirements for implementation in the Learning Experience Platform.- Deliver documentation, editable assets, and knowledge-transfer materials to support long-term ownership and maintenance by the organization.The consultant will work independently while collaborating closely with business stakeholders, SMEs, and learning teams.﻿ Required ExperienceThe ideal consultant has strong experience in corporate academy design, curriculum architecture, and role- or skill-based learning journeys, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable learning solutions.Relevant Experience- Designing corporate academies, curricula, and role-based learning journeys aligned with business capabilities and proficiency levels.- Assessing and curating large third-party learning libraries, selecting content based on relevance, quality, applicability, and business alignment.- Working with Cornerstone or comparable enterprise learning platforms and content ecosystems.- Applying a strong curate-before-create approach, maximizing existing content and minimizing unnecessary content development.- Developing learning solutions for sales and commercial functions.- Supporting learning initiatives across multiple countries and languages.- Establishing quality-assurance and maintenance processes for localized learning assets.- Integrating experiential learning, manager reinforcement, coaching, and practical application into learning journeys.- Collaborating effectively with subject-matter experts and business stakeholders.- Delivering implementation-ready outputs supported by structured documentation, handover, and knowledge transfer.﻿ Key Success FactorThe most important capability is the ability to translate existing frameworks and learning resources into practical, relevant, scalable, and maintainable learning journeys rather than creating large volumes of new content.This role requires fluency in English.This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is December 16th, 5 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg (Mölndal). Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: Medical oncologist for an oncology department in Sweden
description: Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!Are you a specialist in medical oncology looking for a role that combines professional development, multidisciplinary collaboration, and access to modern cancer treatments?We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established oncology department in Sweden that provides comprehensive cancer care across a broad spectrum of diagnoses. You will join an experienced and supportive team where collaboration, clinical excellence and continuous development are highly valued.This is an opportunity to work in a specialty that is constantly evolving, with access to modern therapies and the possibility to contribute to the ongoing development of cancer care while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.About the roleAs a specialist in oncology, you will be involved in:    Outpatient consultations and follow-up of oncology patients.    Systemic cancer treatments and individualized treatment planning.    Participation in multidisciplinary tumour conferences (MDTs).    Inpatient care as part of a rotating ward responsibility.    Collaboration with radiation oncology, palliative care and other specialties.    Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors.    Contributing to the continued development of clinical pathways and oncology services.Depending on your experience and professional interests, there are opportunities to further develop specific areas of expertise within the department.Why this opportunity?    Collaborative and supportive environment: Join an experienced oncology team known for its strong collegial atmosphere, close cooperation and willingness to support one another.    Modern oncology practice:Work in a department that continuously follows developments in cancer treatment and offers access to innovative therapies and evidence-based care.    Professional development:Benefit from ongoing opportunities for continuing medical education, subspecialization and participation in developing multidisciplinary tumour teams.    Varied clinical work:Combine outpatient care, inpatient responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and specialised oncology treatments within a broad clinical practice.    Long-term career opportunities:Become part of a stable department with low staff turnover and a strong commitment to quality improvement and professional growth.Life in central SwedenThe position is located in a scenic region of central Sweden, offering an excellent quality of life with forests, lakes and coastline within easy reach. The area combines a welcoming community atmosphere with modern infrastructure, short commuting times and access to outdoor activities throughout the year.Families appreciate the safe environment, excellent schools and generous work-life balance, while larger cities and international travel connections remain easily accessible.Requirements    EU-recognised specialist certification in Medical Oncology.    Solid clinical experience as a specialist in oncology.    Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team.    Interest in teaching, supervision and professional development.    Strong communication skills in English.    Motivation to learn Swedish through our language programme.Why Choose Dignus Medical?We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.What Dignus Medical offers you:    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required    Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family    Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/SkypeInterested in a career in Sweden?Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Daniel.McClaer@bladins.seWe look forward to welcoming a new colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.

title: IT-support, Treasury

title: Är du redo för nästa steg inom besöksnäringen?
description: Vi söker framtidens nyckelpersoner som vill arbete med en av Dalarnas största näring - besöksnäringen!Brinner du för att utveckla människor, skapa fantastiska gästupplevelser och driva verksamheter framåt? Är du en engagerad ledare eller specialist som trivs i en miljö där service, kvalitet och affärsmässighet går hand i hand? Då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig!På BOSS Business Partner samarbetar vi med många olika branscher och ser alltid framåt mot nästa spännande rekryterings- eller konsultuppdrag. Vi vill därför redan nu knyta kontakt med erfarna och drivna personer som är nyfikna på nya möjligheter.Vilka kompetenser söker vi?Vi är intresserade av att komma i kontakt med personer som har erfarenhet av ledarskap, drift, verksamhetsutveckling eller specialistkompetens inom besöksnäringen. Du kanske har jobbat i roller på skidanläggningar, hotell, restaurang, konferens och är nyfiken på nästa steg.Antingen finns du redan på plats i Dalarna eller så är du på väg att flytta hit permanent.Vem är du?Du kombinerar ett genuint intresse för människor och service med ett affärsmässigt tänkande. Du har förmågan att skapa engagemang, bygga och vara en del av välfungerande team samt bidrar till en verksamhet där både medarbetare och gäster stortrivs.Du är trygg i att möta olika typer av människor och trivs som bäst när det är mycket gäster och aktiviteter. När du har lovat något står du får det och ser till att det blir gjort och du är en person som ser möjligheter till utveckling och förbättring där andra kanske ser problem. Du trivs med att arbeta operativt och har förståelse för vikten av såväl den dagliga driften som långsiktiga mål.Kanske har du redan en specialistroll eller en ledande roll inom besöksnäringen och känner att det är dags för nästa utmaning? Eller så har du erfarenheter från en annan bransch som du vill ta med dig in i en ny miljö?Oavsett vilket är vi nyfikna på att höra mer om dig!Nya möjligheter börjar med ett samtalPå BOSS Business Partner tror vi på långsiktiga relationer och att rätt person på rätt plats gör verklig skillnad. Genom vårt breda nätverk och samarbeten som vi har med både stora och mindre företag får vi möjlighet att matcha kompetenta personer med spännande arbetsgivare och utvecklande roller.Vi vet också att ett karriärbyte inte alltid är något man aktivt söker efter. Ibland dyker rätt möjlighet upp när man minst anar det.Nyfiken på vad framtiden kan erbjuda?Välkommen att connecta med oss!Berätta gärna lite om din bakgrund, dina erfarenheter och vilken typ av roll eller utmaning du skulle vara intresserad av framöver.Det här är en intresseanmälan inför framtida rekryteringsuppdrag och inte en specifik ledig tjänst. När en möjlighet dyker upp som matchar din profil kan vi komma att kontakta dig.Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och kanske få vara en del av ditt nästa karriärsteg!BOSS Business Partner – vi hjälper människor och företag att utvecklas tillsammans.

title: Business Controller – R&D and Product
description: HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.What you’ll do Would you like to influence the financial success of innovative technology? As Business Controller, you’ll work at the intersection of finance, R&D and product development, helping turn ideas and investments into profitable products.You will be a financial business partner to R&D and Product Offering, supporting the teams in making informed financial and business decisions. You will provide insight into development costs, investments and product profitability, helping the business understand the financial impact of decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include:    Coordinate budgets and forecasts for R&D and Product Offering, analyzing spending and variances.    Follow development projects and investments, including business cases, and financial outcomes after product launch.    Analyze product profitability, standard costs and cost variances, identifying opportunities for cost improvements.    Maintain pricing data, support annual pricing process and implement approved price changes.    Develop reporting and use digital and AI tools to automate routine work and provide better business insight. Based in Halmstad, you will join INT Business Controlling and report to VP Business Controlling. You will be part of an experienced finance team, working closely with colleagues across the business. About you You are analytical, structured and curious about how the business works. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders and turning financial data into clear insights and decisions. We believe you have:     Experience in business controlling, financial analysis or a similar role.    A degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.    Strong Excel skills and good communication skills in English. Experience from a manufacturing environment, as well as familiarity with product or project controlling, cost accounting, Power BI or ERP systems, is an advantage. You do not need experience in every area of the role, we value curiosity, financial judgement and a collaborative approach. About us At HMS, we put Heart, Mind & Soul into everything we do. These core values not only make for a fitting abbreviation (HMS), but also describe how we work together and create success. Through our global presence, we combine the opportunities of an international organisation with the close-knit and entrepreneurial spirit that has characterised HMS since the beginning.
