title: Business Controller - Hedin Import Operations
description: Do you want to be part of an interesting growth journey?Hedin Mobility Group is an exciting workplace consisting of a bunch of wonderful and talented people. If you appreciate a varied everyday life and prefer to work in a changing environment, you will thrive here. Our employees are the foundation of Hedin Mobility Group's successful growth for many years. There are many development opportunities in the Group and we want individuals with the right potential to have the opportunity to grow with us!Hedin Business Center is looking for a Business ControllerHedin Business Center provides professional and devoted support to our Import Operations including Hedin US Motor, the exclusive importer and distributor of the Ford F-150 in Europe - Hedin Adventure Car - the official distributor of INEOS Grenadier across 11 markets in Europe, Hedin Premium Car - the importer of the prestigious brand Hongqi in 6 markets in Europe and Hedin Distribution AG/SK/CZ - the official distributor of XPENG in Switzerland, Slovakia and Czech Republic. Who are we looking for?We are now looking for a Business Controller to further accelerate our operations across Europe. You will play a critical role in supporting the financial health and strategic decision-making of the various brands within our portfolio. Furthermore, you will be responsible for analyzing financial data, monitoring performance, and providing insights to improve profitability and cost efficiency. You will be welcomed by a positive team in a forward-thinking and fast-growing company. The position will be located in our attractive new office space in Mölndal and you will report to our CFO & Head of Business Center.You have a Masters degree in economics, accounting, engineering or equivalent and several (5+) years of work experience in controlling, financial analysis or similar roles. To thrive in the role as Business Controller, it is important that you are comfortable with ownership and responsibility. You are structured, analytical and always deliver timely and accurately. Furthermore, you are a team player who is also used to work independently. We believe you are an outgoing person who finds it both exciting and stimulating to meet new people, have fun at work and enjoy working in an ever-changing environment with high demands.Your key areas of responsibility:    Business Performance Monitoring: Track and analyze business performance by evaluating financial data and key business metrics, ensuring that targets are met.    Financial Planning and Analysis: Prepare and manage annual Budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial planning. Analyze Budget deviations and provide actionable insights to improve financial outcomes.    Reporting: Deliver regular financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring accuracy and timeliness.    Cost Control: Monitor and evaluate operational expenses, identify areas for cost reduction, and recommend measures to enhance profitability.    Stakeholder Collaboration:    Support commercial decision-making through pricing analysis, campaign evaluation, and margin optimization    Support market initiatives, including business case development and performance tracking for new initiatives and channels    Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to financial processes, controls, and reporting systems to drive efficiency and enhance data integrity.Furthermore, you have:    Strong commercial acumen with the ability to drive profitability through pricing strategies, margin analysis, campaign follow-up, and business case evaluation across multiple brands or product lines.    Understanding of end-to-end value chains, including procurement, logistics, inventory management, and dealer/distribution networks, with the ability to identify risks and optimization opportunities.    Demonstrated ability to act as a strategic partner to senior stakeholders, influencing decision-making through data-driven insights and challenging the business constructively.    Advanced analytical capabilities and strong experience working with ERP and BI tools (e.g. SAP, Business Central, Power BI), with a focus on automation, data quality, and scalable reporting.    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English.    Experience in the automotive industry is a plus.Why work with usAs an employer, we are good at taking advantage of driven and committed employees. With us, there are many career paths to choose from – our attitude is that individuals with the right potential should be able to grow with us. We are responsible and ensure fair terms of employment, and all operations are covered by collective agreements. We care about our employees and see a long-term and sustainable working life as a strong competitive advantage. We offer a wide range of benefits such as advance vacation, extra parents' salary and a generous wellness allowance to protect our employees' health. Read more on our website www.hedinmobilitygroup.com

title: Fellowship in burn care
description: Verksamhetsområde plastik- och käkkirurgiVi är Akademiska sjukhuset – ett av Sveriges ledande universitetssjukhus. Som länssjukhus och leverantör av högspecialiserad vård erbjuder vi vård till två miljoner människor i Mellansverige. Här händer det ständigt något – ett nytt liv föds, en mormor opereras, en kollega hyllas som hjälte. Hos oss får du uppleva både hårda prövningar och fantastiska händelser, i en stark gemenskap med kollegor. Välkommen med din ansökan!The department of Plastic and Maxillofacial surgery offers 6- or 12-month fellowship in burn care. The period will be decided with the candidate that is offered the fellowship. The burn center is one of Sweden’s two national burn centers appointed by the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare, for the care of severe burns. Annually approximately 150 patients are admitted to the center and approximately 1400 patients are seen at outpatient visits. The patients are treated in the center from the acute phase via intensive-, intermediate-, and ward care until discharge and subsequent outpatient care including follow-ups, rehabilitation and reconstructive surgery. All ages and all aspects of burn care are handled in the center. The fellowship program is an academic clinical program.Clinical ExposureDuring Burn Care Fellowship there is very close interaction with staff. The fellow will be involved in all aspects of patient care including active participation in intensive-, intermediate-, and ward care, preoperative surgical planning, operative procedures, outpatient clinics, and follow-up, rehabilitation and surgical reconstructions, always under supervision of the medical staff.The fellow will work in a team of 1-2 junior doctors, 1-2 plastic surgery specialists and 1-2 intensive care physicians and will participate in all aspects of burn care from the acute phase to outpatient follow-ups and reconstructions.Education and TeachingA large number of journal clubs, department conferences and one-on-one instructional sessions are an integral part of the Burn Care Fellowship Program. The fellow will actively participate in several multidisciplinary conferences, seminars and rounds at the Uppsala University Hospital.Literature resources in the libraries of the department, hospital, and Uppsala University are available for the fellow.Research OpportunitiesThe fellow is expected to pursue at least one research project of personal interest within the field of burn care under supervision of one of the senior consultants and is encouraged to finalize at least one publication.SalaryCompetitive salary and possibility for accommodation in Uppsala.RequirementsThe candidate must be specialist in plastic surgery or senior resident in plastic surgery with ambition to pursue a career in burn care and be able to work in a team.How to applySubmit your CV and two letters of recommendation. Recruitment is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline, so dont wait with your application.ContactRecruiting manager, Fredrik Huss, fredrik.huss@akademiska.se Facklig kontaktperson nås via Upplands Allmänna Läkarförening, kansli 018-611 34 95Vill du jobba med oss?Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan.Läs om anställningsvillkor och lönesättning inom Region Uppsala här: Bli vår nya kollega (https://regionuppsala.se/jobb-och-utbildning/bli-var-nya-kollega/)Region Uppsala värdesätter de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och mångfald tillför verksamheten och ser gärna sökande av alla kön och med olika födelsebakgrund, funktionalitet och livserfarenhet.Region Uppsala krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Detta innebär för den enskilda medarbetaren inga förpliktelser i fredstid utan är enkom en planeringsåtgärd.Inför beslut om anställning, sker kontroll av misstanke- och belastningsregister avseende samtliga arbetssökanden som i den sökta anställningen kan komma att arbeta inom psykiatrisk sjukvård, habilitering, vård av barn och ungdom eller tvångsvård av missbrukare, områden som omfattas av fakultativa registerutdrag. Detta gäller således alla som kommer att arbeta patientnära, även om arbetsuppgifterna i nuläget inte är tänkta att huvudsakligen innehålla arbete med ovan nämnda patientgrupper.Denna rekrytering sker helt genom Region Uppsalas försorg och vi undanber oss telefonsamtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

title: Manager Software Development
description: CompanyFlygprestanda AB has thanks to its leading expertise in the aviation industry for 57 years become one of the leading suppliers of takeoff and landing calculations for airlines worldwide. We are also in the forefront of developing new products and services in the aerospace industry.We are specialists in software and software related services to the airline's operational departments, where our software services are used by pilots to make takeoff and landing calculations prior to each flight. Since our customers use our services prior to each flight, they expect both high quality and flexible solutions.In fresh premises with an attractive location next to “Stortorget” in central Malmö we can offer a stimulating and challenging position as Manager Software DevelopmentProfileWe are looking for someone with comprehensive technical expertise from the Software Development Lifecycle, preferably back-end oriented, to enter the position as Manager for our Software Project Department. We believe that you are a dedicated problem solving individual, with a team-effort mind-set and a professional personality. You are thorough in your work and believe in organizing your day in a productive manner. You are also expected to have good skills in planning, project management and documentation.Work descriptionThis position reports to the Managing Director and is also member of the Management group.The area of responsibility includes planning of software development activities and team management. Working on and planning multiple projects is also part of the daily tasks and includes liaising with team members of different departments, such as Engineers, other Software Developers and Sales & Marketing Manager.The product portfolio consist of a variety of aircraft performance and flight planning related services and applications, aimed for pilots and dispatch centers.The Software Development teamWe are a small but dedicated team consisting of: Software Developers, Tester,Graphic Designer. A solution oriented mindset is a valuable asset in our daily work.You will be resonsible for (amongst responsibilities)- Responsible for hiring of personnel within the department.- Strategic service/product planning together with Management.- Plan and follow up on the software development Lifecycle overall.- Plan and follow up on the daily software development process (scrum).- Provide technical in-house expertise related to the software solutions developed.- Handle Software Development statistics.- DocumentationRequired skills- Fluent in English on a professional level. Also in writing.- Knowledge in project management.Favorable experience- Knowledge in aircraft performance and flight planning- Degree in Software Development.- Experience of Java, Javascript or other relevant programming languages.- Good knowledge in the Swedish language.ApplicationSend your CV and a personal letter to careers@flygp.se, not later than 17/12-2026.Note: This position may be appointed prior to above stated deadline.

title: Sales Support Representative
description: Sales Support RepresentativeHönö | Berg PropulsionSince 1912, Berg Propulsion has been developing technology that drives the global maritime industry forward. From our origins as a Swedish shipyard, we have grown into an international leader in marine propulsion systems, delivering propellers, thrusters, control systems, and hybrid-electric solutions to customers around the world.At our headquarters in Hönö, you'll find a very collaborative and welcoming work environment with short decision-making paths, high engagement, and a strong team spirit! Here, cutting-edge technology is combined with the genuine Berg culture—where collaboration, accountability, and continuous development are at the heart of everything we do.Are you our next Sales Support Representative?We are currently looking for a new colleague to join our Sales Support team. This is a fixed-term position with the possibility of a permanent contract after the first six months.As part of our team, you will play a key role in supporting the operational backbone of our aftermarket business. This position is ideal if you enjoy coordinating multiple tasks, thrive in a structured environment, and are energized by collaborating with others to ensure a smooth and efficient order process.We are a highly skilled and committed team who is known for its positive attitude and strong sense of collaboration. We support one another, share knowledge, and work together to find solutions—even when the pace is high!The RoleAs a Sales Support Representative, you will be responsible for ensuring that customer orders are handled efficiently and with a high level of quality—from handover by the Sales team through delivery and invoicing.You will act as a central point of coordination between several internal departments, ensuring that accurate information is maintained in our systems, deliveries are monitored, and any deviations are managed in a structured manner. The role is primarily an internal support function with many cross-functional contacts throughout the organization.We are also in an exciting phase of development, implementing new ways of working and improving our processes. Therefore, we are looking for someone who enjoys contributing ideas and sees continuous improvement as a natural part of everyday work.Key ResponsabilitiesIn this role, you will be responsible for:    Ensuring an efficient order flow from handover through delivery and invoicing.    Registering and administering customer orders in the ERP system.    Managing price adjustments and updating item master data.    Monitoring deliveries and handling deviations.    Coordinating daily activities with Production, Purchasing, Logistics, and other internal departments.    Managing returns and warranty claims.    Ensuring that information and documentation in our systems is accurate and up to date.You will have the authority to prioritize and reschedule orders, manage price updates, determine lead times in collaboration with the business, and independently handle standardized warranty and claims processes.QualificationsRequired    Upper secondary school diploma or equivalent.Preferred    Post-secondary education in Engineering, Logistics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.Experience & SkillsWe believe you have:    Experience in Sales Support, After Sales, Order Management, or a similar coordination role.    Experience working with ERP systems and other business administration systems.    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written. Preferred    Experience working in a B2B environment.    Knowledge of spare parts, service processes, or technical products. Personal QualitiesWe place great emphasis on your personal qualities and believe you recognize yourself in the following:    Communicative – You build strong relationships, communicate clearly, and establish trust.    Structured and Detail-Oriented – You work methodically, stay organized, and maintain a high level of quality.    Service-Minded – You naturally enjoy supporting others and delivering excellent service.    Solution-Oriented – You focus on opportunities and find effective solutions to challenges.    Responsible and Proactive – You take ownership of your work, drive tasks forward, and actively contribute to improvements.Why join Berg Propulsion?At Berg Propulsion, you'll become part of a company where people enjoy their work and have the opportunity to grow. We offer a workplace by the sea, short decision-making paths, and a culture built on collaboration, support, and shared success.You will have a manager who leads with trust, encourages initiative, and supports your professional development as you grow in your role.To give you the best possible start, we provide a well-structured onboarding program. You will begin by learning about our products in our production environment before gradually being introduced to our systems, processes, and ways of working.We look forward to receiving your application!We will review all applications and contact selected candidates as soon as the recruitment process resumes.Thank you for your patience and we look forward reading your application!ContactAzaro Dominguez✉ azaro.dominguez@bergpropulsion.com

title: Data Engineer
description: JobbeskrivningWe’re looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain data pipelines, develop scalable backend APIs, and improve the data solutions used across the team. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of trust, where you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work and drive improvements.The role requires working on-site at our client’s office in Malmö three days per week. BaskunskaperWhat you’ll do    Build and maintain data pipelines using Spark and Flink.    Develop and improve data solutions used across the team.    Build scalable backend APIs that make data accessible.    Provide technical support to colleagues on data engineering topics.    Drive initiatives and contribute to technical improvements.Who you areWe place great emphasis on personal qualities. You enjoy taking responsibility for your work and are comfortable working independently. You also enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, and supporting your colleagues.You approach challenges with curiosity and creativity, use your analytical skills to find solutions, and communicate your reasoning clearly and confidently when discussing technical decisions.What you bring    Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.    Strong programming skills, including Python and either Java or Scala.    Solid backend development experience, for example with Scala Play or an equivalent framework.    A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. A master’s degree is a strong advantage.    Excellent written and spoken English. Personliga färdigheter, egenskaper, erfarenhetIt’s an advantage if you have    Experience with Spark, Flink, or other big data tools.    Exposure to Iceberg, microservices running on Kubernetes, Snowflake, Kafka, or Akka.    Experience with visualization tools such as Grafana.    An interest in or hands-on experience with machine learning.

title: Project Controls Performance and Reporting Lead
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you’ll doAs the Project Controls Performance and Reporting Lead for Green Steel, you’ll bring together project information from Planning, Cost, Contracts, the EPCM contractor and other area teams. You’ll analyse this information to show how the project is performing, highlight trends and deviations, and provide clear reporting and recommendations to support decision-making.    Coordinate the collection, validation and integration of cost, contract, schedule, progress, quantity and resource information.    Analyse performance data to identify trends, variances, risks, opportunities and issues requiring action.    Prepare consolidated reports, dashboards and management summaries for the area.    Work with project teams and the EPCM contractor to align inputs and resolve gaps or discrepancies in reporting.    Follow up significant differences between reported progress and site execution, escalating issues where needed.    Support consistent project controls processes and reporting standards within the area.    Identify practical improvements to reporting, data quality and analysis, including opportunities to use automation and Power BI.    Provide technical guidance on integrated reporting and performance analysis, and support project reviews and assurance activities.What you’ll bringYou’re analytical and comfortable working across different project disciplines. You can bring complex project information together, identify what it means for performance, and explain your findings clearly to different stakeholders.    Relevant experience in project controls, cost control, contract or commercial controls, or project performance reporting in a complex project environment.    Experience consolidating and analysing information across areas such as cost, schedule, progress, contracts, quantities or resources.    Experience working with EPCM contractors and multidisciplinary project teams.    Strong skills in trend and variance analysis, forecasting, progress measurement, and identifying risks and opportunities.    Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI and relevant project controls systems.    Knowledge of project controls governance and practices such as AACE or PMI.    Ability to turn complex data into clear reports, insights and recommendations.    Professional written and verbal communication skills in English.    A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. A project controls or cost management certification is an advantage.Benefits at StegraAt Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

title: Cyber Security Engineer  Vulnerability & Architecture (OT/IT)
description: Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come. Do you want to secure critical industrial operations where cyber security directly impacts safety, production, and sustainability?As a Cyber Security Engineer at Boliden, you will design and implement robust security solutions, reduce vulnerabilities, and safeguard both IT and OT environments. You will help ensure that production-critical systems are resilient, reliable, and built for the future.We look forward to receiving your application!Your opportunityIn this role, you will lead engineering- and architecture-driven risk reduction across complex IT and OT environments, with ownership of the vulnerability management capability and its evolution across tools, processes, and architecture.You will translate threat and vulnerability insights into architectural patterns, hardening strategies, and risk-based remediation roadmaps. Working closely with IT, OT, and business stakeholders, you will influence decisions and ensure security is embedded by design across initiatives and projects.As a key partner in cross-functional delivery, you will help steer initiatives from a security engineering perspective—balancing technical depth, pragmatism, and scalability—while collaborating with adjacent functions such as incident response, SOC, and threat intelligence.Who you will work withYou will report to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and play a key role within Boliden’s Group-wide security function, contributing to safeguarding our operations, people, and sustainable future through robust IT and information security.The position is preferably based in Stockholm or in Boliden but can also be located at any of our operational sites. Regular travel to sites will be required, along with occasional visits to other Boliden locations.What you will do    Own and continuously develop the organization’s vulnerability management capability, including tools, processes, and architecture.    Identify, assess, and manage vulnerabilities across IT and OT environments, driving risk-based and sustainable remediation.    Define and guide secure architectures, standards, and security-by-design principles across solutions and projects.    Provide hands-on technical support and act as a trusted advisor in security design, configuration, and issue resolution.    Lead and coordinate patching and remediation efforts, ensuring compliance and reducing long-term risk exposure.    Track, report, and improve security posture through KPIs, risk insights, and continuous maturity development.What you bring    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across IT, OT, and business functions.    Strong engineering mindset, with the ability to design scalable, secure, and practical solutions.    Solid understanding of IT/OT architectures, security controls, and modern attack methodologies.    Ability to translate risk into clear technical decisions and architectural improvements.    Analytical and solution-oriented, with a structured approach and strong problem-solving capability.    Continuous learning mindset, with a proactive approach to emerging threats and technologies    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.    Fluent English, both written and spoken; Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, or Portuguese is an advantage.    A valid EU Category B driving licence, as the role involves regular travel to our sites.Why work with usAt Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager, David Govier, David.govier@boliden.com.Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, Pernilla Åkerblom, Pernilla.Akerblom@boliden.com, +46 73-023 69 61.For union information, please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70-541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910-77 40 09. We welcome your application no later than November 27, 2026As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, background checks will be included in the recruitment process. If you are a representative of a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.

title: Teacher, Substitute
employer: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
description: IES Enskede söker timvikarierVi söker nu lärarvikarier för undervisning i åk. 4-9. Du kommer att rycka in och täcka upp för lektioner i enlighet med den lektionsplanering som finns. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

title: Internship in Project and Production Engineering
description: Company DescriptionWelcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". Job DescriptionYour contribution to something bigAs a full-time intern in the TEF4 department, you actively contribute to develop and create the conditions for a more efficient production setup to optimize manufacturing.    In this role you will be supporting the local Production Engineering department with daily project management tasks    You will have the opportunity to plan and execute your own production related projects    Evaluating data and creating statistics will allow you to follow up on KPIs of the production    Design parts and create drawings in CAD    Administrative tasks to support the local Production Engineering manager will also be part of your duties    You will be actively participating in the department’s improvement and development, e.g., by moderating workshopsDuration of the internship: 6 months preferably starting in February 2027Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, SwedenQualificationsWhat distinguishes you    Currently studying Industrial Engineering or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science)    Previous production-related experience desirable    Good analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and technical thinking    You thrive in a dynamic work environment – identifying problems, finding solutions and executing them by actively driving your own ideas    Working knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (especially Excel, PowerPoint, Word); experience in other tools (CAD) is a plus    Knowledge in topics like IoT and Industry 4.0 could also be a plus    Open and communicative, ability to approach people easily and to work in a team environment    Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English, Swedish is an advantageAdditional InformationWhat we offer you    Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship    We can offer free accommodation in Tranås    To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services    We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you    You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connectionsWelcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in SwedenTranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description: TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com  Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Role Summary This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the way of handling new vehicle related legislation. We are responsible for overviewing and handling new legislation, coordinating the Technical Lobbyist network and making valid legislation available in the VW database Getex and also in the product structure OAS. We are part of the Domain Product Compliance within Modular Solutions.As a member of the Regulatory Affairs section, you will play a key role in handling new vehicle legislation from a global perspective. Working across areas such as Active Safety & ADAS, Digital Product Compliance, Electrification and Circularity, you will coordinate legislation activities across regions and collaborate with stakeholders from R&D, Public Affairs, Product Planning and external organizations.The role combines leading Regulatory Clusters, evaluating the impact of future legislation on products, supporting technical lobbying activities, and participating in international industry working groups related to vehicle legislation and compliance.You will be active in some suitable external working groups preferably in the field of Active Safety. Most of our external working group participation is in the global vehicle industry association OICA. This is also very much depending on your back ground and experience. Other working group participation could be discussed depending on your background.Job Responsibilities·      Lead (Pilot) the Regulatory Cluster working group for Active Safety & ADAS and provide input to the legal roadmap within these areas.·      Coordinate legislation-related activities with colleagues across Europe, Brazil, the US and China, including technical lobbyists, type approval engineers and subject matter experts.·      Drive process development and ensure Regulatory Affairs responsibilities are integrated into TRATON One PDP and Regulatory Affairs processes.·      Summarize Technical Lobbying Criticality and communicate relevant topics to TRATON Public Affairs when needed.·      Participate in external technical lobbying working groups, particularly within OICA GEVA and ACEA, focusing on automated, autonomous and connected vehicle regulations, CSMS/SUMS and related legislative developments.·      Monitor Active Safety and ADAS related regulations across Regulatory Clusters and working groups.·      Stay informed about company strategy, technology developments and legislative trends to proactively support stakeholders.Who You Are We believe you have:·      Experience in regulatory affairs topics and participation in external technical lobbying forums.·      Experience working within a product development process, with strong understanding of requirements management and Type Approval.·      Ability to transform improvement ideas into practical implementation.·      Experience evaluating and interpreting vehicle-related legislation.·      A relevant Engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.·      A structured way of working combined with high integrity and professionalism.·      Strong written and spoken English communication skills. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us. This Is Us We are a collaborative and skilled Regulatory Affairs section responsible for building the roadmap of upcoming legislation, identifying legal gaps, supporting efficient technical lobbying activities and ensuring vehicle-related legislation is available and accessible throughout TRATON R&D.We work closely with TRATON Group R&D, our brands, TRATON Public Affairs and TRATON Product Planning. Our mission is to identify legal gaps early, enable proactive product development activities and contribute to the establishment of effective, data-driven vehicle legislation. Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. TRATON Offers With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje. Application We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-06. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Magnus Jalkesten, Head of Regulatory Affairs, magnus.jalkesten@scania.com We look forward to your application! This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D

title: Internship in Production and Process Engineering
description: Company DescriptionWelcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". Job DescriptionYour contribution to something big    You will support the Technical Engineering Functions Department TEF4.    Your tasks contain improving existing and developing new production systems.    You will gain insights into assembly planning, and line balancing, including the workplace design of assembly stations, as well as the assembly steps and the required tools, materials and fixtures.    Working with health and safety, as well as supporting the implementation of lean production systems like 5S, will also be part of the job.    During this internship you can also work independently on smaller engineering projects.    Design parts and create drawings in CAD    The data analysis and presentation of production data will be part of your tasks as well.    You get to expand your interdisciplinary skills by collaborating with the purchasing, engineering, quality, and logistics departments.    It will also be possible to dive deeper into automation technology, pneumatics and electric circuits as well as the calibration of testing systems and rapid prototyping by 3D-printing.Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in January 2027Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, SwedenQualificationsWhat distinguishes you    Currently studying engineering (e.g. mechanical, industrial, electrical, mechatronics, …) or similar    A genuine interest in production systems, process improvement, and industrial engineering topics    Initial experience in production-related environments    Good analytical skills and the ability to quickly understand and work with new topics    Ability to work independently and together across departments    A good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and CAD-SoftwareExcellent communication skills in English. Swedish and/or German as an advantageAdditional InformationWhat we offer you    Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship    We can offer free accommodation in Tranås    To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services    We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you    You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connectionsWelcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in SwedenTranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

title: Field Project Manager, Sweden
description: ROXON specializes in demanding bulk material handling solutions. We design and deliver conveyor systems, modernizations, maintenance services, and spare parts for material handling equipment. Our comprehensive solutions and world-class lifecycle support serve industries including mining, energy, pulp and paper, and process manufacturing. At ROXON, decades of engineering expertise meet innovation. Our success is built on the passion, dedication, and professional excellence of our people. Trust, technical expertise, and the capability to take on even the most challenging projects are the core values that drive our project business.We are now looking for a Field Project Manager to join our team in Malmfälten.As a Field Project Manager, you are responsible for ensuring successful project delivery from planning & designing through completion. Your role includes managing schedules, budgets, customer communication, and on-site activities while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and to the highest quality standards.You will lead equipment delivery and modernization projects, coordinate installation work and subcontractors, and act as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project life cycle. The role requires close cooperation with sales, service, engineering, purchasing, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution and excellent customer experience. You will support site operations when needed and promote a proactive, customer-focused, and solution-oriented way of working.Based in Gällivare, this position offers a hands-on opportunity to work with industrial and material handling projects in a dynamic mining environment, where strong leadership, practical problem-solving skills, and a "get things done" mindset are highly valued!Qualifications:- Technical understanding of mechanical systems, industrial equipment, conveyor technology, or material handling solutions /equipment- Strong leadership and coordination skills.- Ability to read and understand technical drawings.- Self-driven and capable of working independently while taking ownership of project activities, customer relationships, and business development initiatives.- Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in both Swedish and English.- Willingness to travel frequently within Sweden; a valid driver's license is required.The ideal candidate is passionate about building long-term customer relationships, developing successful partner networks, and driving product performance and market growth. You thrive in a hands-on environment where you can combine strategic thinking with active customer engagement. The role can be tailored to match your skills, experience, and strengths.What We Offer:- A key role in growing a cutting-edge conveyor products in local markets.- The opportunity to take ownership of projects for a strategically important market area.- An international working environment within a strong global industrial group (NEPEAN).- Support from an experienced organization.Why join us?You'll become part of a growing team where attitude matters as much as experience. We offer training, responsibility, and the opportunity to make a real impact on customer success across Northern Sweden and Norway.Interested?Please submit your application in English by December 7, 2026, [via this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/field-project-manager-sweden/ZlE0qd).Please note that we review applications and interview candidates throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.For further information about the position, please contact our recruitment partner: Liena Silen p. +358 40 482 6770 or liena.silen@eezy.fi and Saara Saalo +358 40 183 6260 or saara.saalo@eezy.fiROXON Sweden ABAt ROXON, we are committed to delivering solutions that are truly optimal for our customers' operations. We believe that honesty and transparency create something far more valuable than a few percentage points: trust.Rather than offering standard, one-size-fits-all solutions, we provide tailored systems built on strong process expertise and a deep understanding of each customer's unique needs. It is built on continuous dialogue, close collaboration, and shared problem-solving with our customers.Phone: +358 40 482 6770 Location: Gällivare

title: Power Up at Volvo Group
description: Company description:power up AT VOLVO GROUP -  A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY TO EMPOWER YOUR FUTURE WITH VOLVO GROUP  “To be part of something bigger than just a summer work and actually keep the collaboration running for a longer period of time. I truly felt like part of the team and look forward to returning. To also be part of the program and meet the other students is fun. It is not a summer job in isolation – I’m part of something bigger.”  - Student from Power Up at Volvo Group 24-25 Job description: Who are you? Are you a first-year Master Student at Chalmers? GREAT! That means you have the unique possibility to join us within our initiative Power Up at Volvo Group. This student program is a fantastic opportunity to get to know Volvo Group and at the same time be part of developing the future of transport solutions together with us. What is in it for you? This program will provide you with a combination of experiences and insights to Volvo Group – both in a home organization and with the program and fellow Power Up-students. In the home organization you will be able to have summer work and master thesis. You will also have a skilled professional as mentor. As a program we will have sessions throughout the program for the full team of Power Up students. These joint sessions make it possible to share even more of the wide variety of opportunities and insights at Volvo Group. This is a unique opportunity to get real life industrial experience alongside with your studies. You will be able to see what the skills you are learning at Chalmers are used for in the Volvo Group. At the same time, you will get valuable insights into our company and the challenges we are facing when it comes to creating sustainable transport solutions on a global scale. You will experience how it is to work with cutting edge technology and customer offers on a global scale together with us at Volvo Group.   Sounds interesting? Keep on reading! The program will start during the spring semester of 2027 and continue all the way to graduation in June 2028. For each position, a selection is made based on the master programs that are prioritized by the home organization. This ensures that your education is relevant to the home organization that you will work together with. The program consists of four different elements: (1) program sessions and study visits, (2) individual mentorship with a Volvo team member, (3) your contribution to our deliveries by a summer work position and, (4) Master Thesis in collaboration with your designated home organization. Who are we? Take the opportunity to learn about how to develop and create transport solutions together with us. Everything from second life of batteries or internal parts in our transmissions, the logistics of supply chain to the cyber security of our plants. Descriptions from some of the home organizations that will participate are described below. “Supporting the organization with Service design, UX design and UI design in initiatives spanning onboard truck environment and offboard application contexts. Working towards cohesive experiences across physical and digital for the Volvo Trucks brand.” “Our team works with purchasing related to the powertrain scope. We cover supplier relationships, contract negotiations and longterm strategic planning of purchasing activities.” “We work within Volvo's Cell Research Center, developing next generation battery cells for Volvo's products. Our team is mostly working in a laboratory environment, working on battery cell R&D, developing and producing prototypes of the next generation battery cells. We are a truly diverse team coming from all around the world with backgrounds in chemistry, materials science, process/manufacturing engineering.”  “Planning and Forecasting future demand in the Volvo Group Service Market supply chain and securing availability of spare parts in our Distribution centers around the world.” Are we a perfect match? The only requirement when you apply is that you have started the first year in a master program at Chalmers. Make sure your application clearly states which master’s programme you are studying. Want to join the team? The program is run in within Volvo Group Trucks Technology and Industrial Division (Volvo Group TTI). The home organizations are spread out in all three domains of TTI – product development, industrial operations and purchasing.  A few examples of home organizations:       Dealer Inventory Planning & Operations Planning      Trucks UX Platform      Cell Process Engineering       Vehicle Software Deployment      Leaf suspensions and non-driven axles      Data analytics & AI      Hydrogen Solutions Purchasing      Vehicle Motion and Thermal Management      Vehicle Efficiency & Productivity       Indirect Purchasing      Automation, SW & Compliance      Base Engine Purchasing   We look forward to receiving your application. Given the high number of applicants last year, please note that the ad will remain open until November 30th. You can expect to hear back about your application by the end of January at the latest.We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

title: Validation Engineer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity: Are you an experienced IC Validation Engineer ready to make an impact? Join our dedicated IC validation team within the PEU Silicon. You will play a key role based in Lund Sweden in validating and verifying state-of-art ASIC’s that are shaping the future. This opportunity involves the entire process: from developing IC validation frameworks and executing electrical measurements to support product integration. We’re looking for a collaborative, solution-oriented team player who’s also self-motivated and ready to mentor others. You approach challenges with an innovative mindset, always open to new ideas and improvements. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of IC validation and thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment, this role is for you!   What you will do:      Validate high-quality and high-performance IC products to meet rigorous standards, as well as customer expectations.     Customize test scripts and test programs, specify test boards requirements, and create validation plans for new devices.     Contribute to bring-up activities for new ICs, including initial manual debugging and investigations.     Perform core electrical and functional validation measurements over PVT, perform power correlation exercises, and performance testing.     Troubleshoot technical issues and provide expert customer support when needed.     Drive continuous improvements in processes, product quality, and validation methods.     Coordinate the collaborations within global ASIC validation team  The skills you bring:      Extensive experience with at least 6+ years in electrical validation and component-level functional verification, with strong hands-on expertise in lab setups and equipment.     Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer or Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field.     Proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Matlab, and knowledge of programming languages like C and C++. Experience in code repository management Git.     Deep knowledge of ASICs, FPGAs, and hardware test setups, with proven ability to design and troubleshoot complex validation processes.     Technical expertise in the technical areas, like SERDES, Ethernet, PCIe, CPRI, DDR, Power, Clock, I3C, etc.     Strong analytical skills, capable of interpreting validation data, diagnosing issues, and deriving actionable insights to enhance product quality and performance.     Clear communication skills in both written and spoken English, with an ability to document technical findings effectively and collaborate across teams.    Strong plus      Knowledge of Ericsson ASIC architecture, functionalities     Experience of design, verification and validation of Ericsson ASIC     Experience with Ericsson Radio or RAN-Compute HW/SW product development and validation

title: Development Engineer within R&D to Olink
description: Would you like to work hands-on with laboratory development and contribute to the next generation of Life Science products? At Olink, you will have the opportunity to be part of developing innovative protein biomarker panels that help researchers worldwide better understand complex diseases and advance the field of precision medicine. As a Development Engineer, you will combine practical laboratory work with method development, experimental evaluation, and the optimization of advanced workflows. We are looking for someone with experience in laboratory work within areas such as molecular biology, biotechnology, or assay development, who enjoys working hands-on in a laboratory environment and is motivated by turning scientific concepts into products that can make a real difference to human health. We look forward to receiving your application!About the roleOlink – Part of Thermo Fisher Scientific has experienced tremendous growth in recent years and has quickly made a global impact. Its groundbreaking products are used by leading research institutes and pharmaceutical companies to drive the next major breakthroughs in medicine. With headquarters and service laboratories in both Uppsala and Boston, Olink is a truly global Life Science company. Its technology is developed and used to provide new insights into complex diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular diseases, and neurological disorders – research that has the potential to genuinely change people's lives.Olink is now looking for a Development Engineer to join its R&D team, Reveal Development, which is responsible for developing a specific product line within low-plex solutions. The team focuses on developing and evaluating new protein panels, assessing their performance, and optimizing the laboratory processes used in product development. In this role, you will contribute to hands-on development activities, conducting experiments and laboratory testing to help ensure that new panels and methods meet established requirements.The role is primarily hands-on and laboratory-based. Your responsibilities will include conducting experiments, performing pipetting, operating laboratory instruments, and working with automated processes. An important part of the role will also involve evaluating and documenting test results and identifying opportunities to improve existing methods and workflows. You will work according to project plans and maintain close communication with project leads regarding the planning, prioritization, and execution of different tests.You will join a team of approximately 10 people, consisting of Development Engineers and Scientists. The team has a relatively new structure and is still evolving, but already offers a positive working environment where colleagues support one another and share knowledge. You will work closely with your team members while also collaborating with other functions across the organization. Your onboarding will include practical training, a structured onboarding checklist, and a dedicated mentor to support you during your initial period.This is a consultant assignment, meaning you will be employed by Academic Work and work on-site at Olink. The assignment will initially run for six months, with the possibility of an extension. The planned start date is February or March 2027. The role is primarily based on-site in the laboratory in Uppsala, with some flexibility to work remotely when the tasks allow.You are offered    The opportunity to work with innovative proteomics technology at an international Life Science company    A hands-on and rewarding role where you will contribute to the development of next-generation protein biomarker panels    The opportunity to combine laboratory work with method development, optimization, and automated processes    An important role within an R&D team, where your work directly contributes to the development of new products    A collaborative team of Development Engineers and Scientists, where knowledge sharing and mutual support are part of everyday work    A structured onboarding process, including a dedicated mentor and practical training    A workplace that our current consultants describe as fantasticWork tasksIn this role, you will primarily work hands-on in the laboratory with the experimental development and evaluation of new protein biomarker panels. You will collaborate closely with project leads and other team members to plan, conduct, and follow up on experiments. Your responsibilities will include:    Planning and conducting laboratory experiments in accordance with project plans and established timelines    Performing laboratory work, including pipetting and other molecular biology techniques    Evaluating the performance of assays and new protein biomarker panels using established analytical tools and quality criteria    Analyzing, documenting, and communicating experimental results in accordance with established procedures    Working with automated laboratory processes, including operating and setting up laboratory instruments    Contributing to the optimization and further development of laboratory methods and workflows    Collaborating with project leads on the planning, prioritization, and execution of project activities    Participating in technical discussions, troubleshooting activities, and scientific reviews    Collaborating cross-functionally with other R&D teams to support product development milestonesWe are looking for someone who    Holds a university degree in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or another relevant scientific discipline    Has experience in laboratory work within areas such as assay development, product development, or research-based laboratory environments    Has hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques such as PCR, qPCR, NGS library preparation, and/or immunoassays    Has experience analyzing and interpreting experimental data and drawing scientifically sound conclusions    Has strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to document and communicate results effectively    Has good knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPointIt is considered an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have    Experience with multiplex protein detection technologies or molecular diagnostics platforms    Experience working with laboratory automation systems and high-throughput workflows    Experience with LIMS and structured experimental doc

title: Production Line Manager - Night Shift
description: Aimpoint AB is the company that invented and developed the red dot sight, for which we are today the world-leading provider. Aimpoint sights are used in the civilian hunting and shooting markets, as well as by police and military forces. The company has over 570 employees and a turnover of approximately 2,3 billion SEK. Sales in the United States are managed through our American subsidiary, Aimpoint Inc.Our headquarters are located in Malmö, with production facilities in Malmö and Gällivare.Aimpoint is part of the Sandberg Development group. For more information about the company, please visit www.aimpoint.com/seProduction Line Manager - Night ShiftAbout the roleAt Aimpoint, quality and safety always come first. We are now looking for Production Line Managers to strengthen our production organization in Malmö.This is a permanent night-shift leadership role where you will be responsible for leading a team of approximately 50-60 operators and Shift Leaders in a manufacturing environment that combines manual assembly with automated production processes. title: Docking and Project Superintendent
description: Join our team as a Docking and Project Superintendent, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth planning and execution of dry-docking operations for Stena Line’s vessels! In this role, you will utilize your maritime expertise to provide guidance to our Fleet Groups, ensuring adherence to docking policies and procedures while prioritizing quality, time efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also coordinate fleet and group projects under the direction of Senior Management, while also ensuring vessel accreditation to meet international safety and pollution prevention standards. If you're driven by excellence and adept at optimizing operations, apply now to be part of our team! Some of your key responsibilities: - Manage and coordinate dry-docking processes. - Review and standardize docking and repair specifications. - Coordinate refit budgeting and cost analysis with Fleet Group. - Manage pre-docking planning and reporting. - Act as Project Manager for technical projects. - Monitor project risks and key milestones. - Negotiate terms with ship repair yards. - Ensure efficient vessel management during refits. - Maintain vessel standards and appearance. - Provide expertise to Fleet Group and Company management. - Assist with warranty claims and post-project evaluations. - Ensure compliance with contractual and commercial agreements. - Liaise with departments supporting vessels. - Travel as required. What you will experience As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you an additional benefits package consisting of travel discounts, health allowance, well-being activities, access to a benefits portal, and much more. Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of colleagues. Who are you? At Stena Line, your personal qualities matter just as much as your skills and expertise. Regardless of the role, being welcoming, caring, and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face. We believe you are a team-player who thrives in a collaborative environment. You share your knowledge and pay attention to the details in everything you do. We also believe you welcome new challenges with an open, and positive attitude. Qualifications: - Unlimited Chief Engineer or Master certification. Alternatively, a degree in nautical science-related fields. - Practical experience either onboard with exposure to onboard management teams or a minimum of 1+ year experience ashore in technical/project roles within a shipping company's operations. - Keen knowledge of vessel operations, and technical and safety requirements for RoPax-type vessels. - Dry-dock planning and planned maintenance systems. - Financial knowledge of budgets and cost control to ensure effective project management whilst maintaining company standards of safety and quality. - Strong understanding of the key concepts of Health and Safety   - Knowledge of ISM and ISO standards and codes Interested? This is a full-time, permanent position based in Gothenburg within our Fleet Operations department. To apply, please register your profile and send in your application in English as soon as possible but no later than 1 December, 2026. We are having an ongoing selection, so do not wait with your application. To ensure the secure and structured processing of your personal data, we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system. We have collective bargaining agreements with Unionen, among others, who you can contact for more information. Please note that we kindly decline any offers from recruitment or staffing agencies regarding this recruitment. We may conduct background checks as part of our efforts to ensure the quality of our recruitment process. If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Hans Corneliusson, Group Head of Fleet Support, hans.corneliusson@stenaline.com or about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact Hedwig Blixt, Talent Acquisition Partner, hedwig.blixt@stenaline.com. About Stena Line As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe’s most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK and the Baltics, making a contribution to our company. Working at Stena Line means having a safe and stable workplace and a great work-life balance. We embrace equality, diversity and inclusion – and welcome all applicants.

Vous êtes responsable de la bonne organisation et du bon fonctionnement de la cuisine et veillez au bon déroulement du service en salle. De plus vous participez activement aux manifestations de  l’établissement, aux projets d’accompagnement des Personnes en collaboration avec l’équipe interdisciplinaire et à l’intégration des nouveaux·lles professionnel·le·s, apprentis et stagiaires du service restauration.VOTRE PARCOURS \- VOS QUALITÉS ET COMPÉTENCES :* Vous êtes au bénéfice d’un CFC de cuisinier et avez une expériencce avérée dans le domaine social.  * On vous reconnait un sens des responsabilités et de l’organisation ainsi qu’une capacité à prioriser.  * L’esprit d’équipe, la remise en question et la communication font partie de vos qualités.  * La maitrise du français (oral \+ écrit) et une utilisation courante des outils informatiques sont des acquis pour vous.  NOUS VOUS OFFRONS* La possibilité de travailler dans un environnement riche de contacts.  * L’occasion de participer à des projets institutionnels novateurs.  * Des conditions de travail et salariales selon la CCT SAN (convention collective de travail du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois). title: Responsable de salle
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable de salle --- Responsable de salle ==================== ### Introduction LES GALERIES 27 Holding SA crée des expériences inoubliables autour des plaisirs épicuriens, du bien\\-être et de l'art de vivre. Réparties sur six étages, nos activités offrent à nos clients un environnement où la qualité de l'accueil et du service occupe une place centrale. Nous recherchons un·e Responsable de salle pour coordonner le service et contribuer à une expérience client remarquable. ### Responsabilités Vous assurez le bon déroulement du service en salle et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes afin de maintenir un accueil fluide, attentif et professionnel. \* Organiser l'ouverture, la mise en place et la fermeture de la salle afin de garantir un espace prêt à accueillir les clients. \* Accueillir les clients, les accompagner et suivre leur expérience afin de répondre à leurs attentes avec attention. \* Coordonner le service en salle avec les équipes de cuisine et les autres interlocuteurs afin d'assurer une exécution efficace des prestations. \* Répartir les tâches et soutenir les collaborateurs pendant le service afin de maintenir la qualité et le rythme des opérations. \* Veiller au respect des standards de service, d'hygiène et de présentation afin de préserver une expérience cohérente et soignée. \* Gérer les demandes, remarques et situations imprévues des clients afin d'apporter des solutions rapides et adaptées. \* Transmettre les informations utiles à l'équipe et à la hiérarchie afin de faciliter la coordination et l'amélioration continue du service. ### Qualifications Nous recherchons une personne de terrain, attentive aux détails et capable de prendre des responsabilités dans un environnement orienté vers l'accueil et l'expérience client. \* Expérience dans la restauration, l'hôtellerie ou le service à la clientèle, avec une bonne compréhension des opérations de salle. \* Capacité à organiser les priorités, la mise en place et le déroulement d'un service. \* Aptitude à coordonner une équipe, à répartir les tâches et à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs. \* Maîtrise des techniques d'accueil, de prise en charge des clients et de gestion des réclamations. \* Sens du service, présentation soignée et attention constante portée à la qualité de l'expérience client. \* Résistance au stress, réactivité et capacité à prendre des décisions dans les situations imprévues. \* Communication claire, esprit d'équipe et attitude professionnelle. ### Application Nous vous invitons à poser votre candidature directement via cette annonce. !\[LES GALERIES 27 Holding SA\]( ) \* LES GALERIES 27 Holding SA Grand Rue 27 1530 Payerne \* \[ \](\< \>) jpida1f2cf5jm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Conseiller(ère) en prévoyance &amp; planification financière--- Conseiller(ère) en prévoyance \& planification financière============================================================Vous êtes passionné(e) par le conseil financier, animé(e) par l'esprit entrepreneurial et convaincu(e) que la qualité d'une relation client fait toute la différence ?Vous souhaitez évoluer dans une structure indépendante, dynamique et ambitieuse, où votre expertise est reconnue et où vous disposez des moyens nécessaires pour développer votre activité ?**Bienvenue chez DiLife \& co SA !**Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) **Conseiller(ère) en prévoyance \& planification financière** souhaitant s'investir durablement dans une aventure professionnelle et humaine.Qui sommes\-nous ?------------------de plus de 15 ans d'expérience dans le conseil et la planification financière, **DiLife \& co SA** accompagne ses clients dans la construction, l'optimisation et la sécurisation de leur avenir financier.Notre conviction est simple : un conseil de qualité repose sur l'expertise, l'écoute, la confiance et une vision à long terme.Aujourd'hui, DiLife \& co SA s'inscrit dans la dynamique d'**ARCADE PARTNERS**, un écosystème entrepreneurial réunissant plusieurs Monteur lignes aériennes
=========================

Multinet Communication Romandie SA est une entreprise active ans le domaine des infrastructures de télécommunication, en forte croissance en Suisse romande.

Rejoins notre équipe et participe à la construction, à l'entretien et au développement de réseaux de télécommunication aériens. Tu interviens sur le terrain pour le montage, l'installation et la maintenance des lignes, en veillant au respect des normes de sécurité et de qualité. Un poste varié et technique pour une personne motivée, habile de ses mains et appréciant le travail en extérieur et en hauteur.

**🚩 Tes missions :**

* Localisation et réparation de pannes sur les lignes aériennes en cuivre.
* Réparation des câbles, des manchons et des points de distribution endommagés.
* Montage, démontage et remise en état des réseaux aériens.
* Intervention sur les poteaux, les façades et les systèmes de support.
* Mesures et des contrôles techniques sur les lignes en cuivre.


 

**🔎 Profil recherché :** 

* Expérience dans la construction ou la maintenance de lignes aériennes en cuivre.
* Expérience dans la technologie du cuivre (par exemple xDSL et contrôle des lignes).
* Expérience dans le dépannage est un atout.
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, fiable et orientée vers les solutions.
* Disponibilité pour le service de piquet et les interventions en dehors des horaires habituels.
* Bonnes connaissances du français écrit et oral.
* Permis de conduire catégorie B.


 

**🚀 Ce que nous t’offrons :** 

* Une fonction au sein d'une entreprise TU Swisscom en pleine environnement jeune, dynamique, humain et stimulant.
* Des responsabilités variées et de réelles perspectives d'évolution.
* Des conditions d'emploi attractives et 7 semaines de vacances par an.


⚡Envie de prendre de la hauteur et de participer concrètement au développement de nos réseaux de télécommunication ?

description: **Depuis plus de 60 ans, la Fondation Claire Magnin prend soin de celles et ceux qui en ont besoin.** Au sein de ses 7 établissements (EMS et EPSM), 400 collaboratrices et collaborateurs s’engagent chaque jour avec exigence et sincérité auprès de personnes en situation de vulnérabilité.Ici, on questionne, on expérimente et on ose faire évoluer les pratiques pour s’améliorer en permanence. EMS.* Vous assurez la gestion des remplacements du personnel absent, notamment par le recours à du personnel intérimaire, en fonction des besoins des services.* Vous assurez le suivi de la Chaque jour, nous donnons le meilleur de nous\-mêmes avec un maximum d'enthousiasme pour la Suisse, la politique et l'administration fédérale. Notre office veille à ce que les 43 000 employés de la Confédération puissent accomplir leurs tâches.
