Reporting to senior leadership, you will oversee operational performance, guest satisfaction, organizational effectiveness, and service excellence while driving continuous improvement across the fleet.If you are a strategic hospitality professional who combines operational expertise with strong leadership capabilities, we invite you to become part of our journey.**About Avalon Waterways****Avalon Waterways** is an award\-winning global river cruise company recognized for redefining the river cruising experience. Operating throughout Europe's most iconic waterways, Avalon is known for innovative ship design, exceptional guest service, outstanding culinary experiences, and consistently high guest satisfaction ratings.At Avalon Europe AG, we are committed to delivering memorable journeys through operational excellence, empowered teams, and a culture of continuous improvement. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and we strive to set the benchmark for service and innovation within the river cruise industry.**The Opportunity**As **Director of Hotel Operations**, you will provide strategic leadership and oversight for all hotel operations across the fleet. You will work closely with Corporate Hotel Managers and senior stakeholders to strengthen operational performance, ensure consistency of service delivery, and build organizational capability for future growth.The role combines commercial acumen, hospitality expertise, and people leadership to ensure exceptional guest experiences while maintaining operational efficiency and financial discipline.**Your Responsibilities****Operational Leadership*** Own and drive fleet\-wide hotel operations performance.* Ensure compliance with brand standards, health \& safety requirements, and operational procedures.* Develop governance structures, operational standards, and sustainable processes.* Monitor operational KPIs and coordinate corrective actions where needed.* Maintain a consistent framework for operational execution across the fleet.**Guest Experience \& Continuous Improvement*** Analyze guest feedback, cruise reports, audits, and operational reviews.* Identify opportunities to enhance service delivery and operational effectiveness.* Lead the development and implementation of new hotel concepts, processes, and best practices.* Support innovation initiatives that elevate the overall guest experience.**Leadership \& Organizational Development*** Lead and develop Corporate Hotel Managers.* Foster accountability, collaboration, and professional growth throughout the organization.* Strengthen leadership capabilities through talent development and succession planning.* Promote transparent communication and strong partnerships between shipboard and shore\-side teams.**Financial Performance*** Contribute to hotel operations budgets and resource planning.* Monitor performance against financial targets and operational objectives.* Identify risks, opportunities, and efficiency improvements.* Support sustainable and commercially sound decision\-making across the fleet.**Supplier \& Stakeholder Management*** Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and service partners.* Ensure suppliers meet quality, reliability, and performance expectations.* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align operational strategies with broader business objectives.**What You Bring****Experience*** Minimum 5 years of senior leadership experience within river cruising, ocean cruising, hospitality, hotel operations, or comparable service industries.* Proven success managing multi\-site operational environments.* Experience leading diverse, international teams.* Strong understanding of operational excellence, guest satisfaction, and organizational performance.* Strong ability to influence without direct authority, particularly across senior and cross\-functional stakeholdersj4id10482427jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

résultats. \* Vous possédez un excellent relationnel et savez instaurer des relations de confiance. \* Vous êtes curieux(se), impliqué(e) et animé(e) par l'envie de progresser. \* Vous appréciez le ------------------------ \*\*Un environnement professionnel qui vous donne les moyens de réussir.\*\* \* \*\*Une structure indépendante et ambitieuse\*\*, dans laquelle vos idées, votre implication et description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Chef·fe de projet structures---Chef·fe de projet structures=============================Chef·fe de projet structuresChef·fe de projet structures=============================Nous recrutons, pour le compte de notre client, un·e Chef·fe de Projet Structures, afin de renforcer une équipe d'ingénieurs reconnue pour son expertise dans la conception et la réalisation de projets complexes.Notre client est un bureau d'ingénieurs établi en Suisse, intervenant sur des projets variés dans les domaines du bâtiment, des infrastructures et des ouvrages techniques. Son développement constant repose sur une approche alliant excellence technique, proximité avec les clients et capacité à proposer des solutions pragmatiques et innovantes. **Votre rôle**En tant que Chef·fe de Projet, vous prenez la responsabilité de mandats de structures depuis les premières phases d'étude jusqu'à la réalisation des ouvrages.Vous intervenez comme interlocuteur privilégié des maîtres d'ouvrage, architectes et partenaires du projet. À ce titre, vous coordonnez les différents intervenants, assurez le suivi technique et financier des affaires et veillez au respect des objectifs de qualité, de coûts et de délais.Votre expertise vous permet d'apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée dans les choix techniques et les orientations constructives, tout en garantissant la faisabilité et la cohérence globale des projets. **Vos responsabilités**Vous pilotez les études de conception et participez activement au développement des solutions techniques les plus adaptées aux contraintes des projets.Vous coordonnez les équipes de projet, assurez le suivi des prestations et veillez à la bonne circulation des informations entre les différents intervenants.Vous supervisez les calculs, les modélisations et la production des documents techniques nécessaires à l'exécution des ouvrages.Vous accompagnez les clients et partenaires tout au long du projet, en leur apportant des conseils techniques pertinents et une vision claire des enjeux.Vous participez aux séances de coordination et assurez le suivi des travaux afin de garantir la conformité des réalisations aux exigences définies.Enfin, vous contribuez au développement du bureau par la qualité de vos réalisations et la confiance que vous instaurez avec vos interlocuteurs. **Ce que vous rejoignez*** Un bureau d'ingénieurs reconnu pour la qualité de ses réalisations  * Des projets variés et techniquement stimulants  * Une structure à taille humaine favorisant l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative  * Une collaboration étroite avec des architectes, maîtres d'ouvrage et partenaires de premier plan  * Des conditions de travail attractives : semaine de 4,5 jours, télétravail, flexibilité horaire et 6 semaines de vacances  * Ferrucci*** Ferrucci**jidf335187jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Responsable Gérance et Center Management
description: La Société coopérative Migros Vaud compte près de 3’200 collaborateurs et exploite aujourd’hui un réseau d’une soixantaine de magasins dans le canton. Son département Immobilier assure la gestion, la valorisation et le développement d’un patrimoine diversifié comprenant notamment des centres commerciaux, des surfaces commerciales et des immeubles de rendement. À la suite du départ du titulaire du poste, Migros Vaud souhaite confier la responsabilité de son service Gérance immobilière et Center Management à une nouvelle personne. L’enjeu sera à la fois d’en assurer la continuité, de reprendre la responsabilité de l'équipe et de la faire évoluer et d’accompagner un département appelé à jouer un rôle central au regard des ambitions de développement de la coopérative. Afin de relever ces défis, nous recherchons un·eResponsable Gérance et Center ManagementPiloter, valoriser et développer un parc immobilier au cœur de l'activité commercialeVos responsabilitésEn qualité de Responsable de service, vous pilotez la Gérance immobilière et le Center Management de Migros Vaud. À la tête d’une petite équipe, vous fixez les priorités, organisez l’activité et développez l’autonomie de vos collaborateurs. Une part importante de votre fonction concerne les surfaces commerciales : vous entretenez les relations avec les enseignes et partenaires, conduisez les négociations locatives, contribuez à la recherche de nouveaux locataires et accompagnez les évolutions du parc. Vous supervisez parallèlement le reste du portefeuille immobilier, notamment les immeubles de rendement, en vous appuyant sur les compétences de votre équipe. Vous suivez les principaux indicateurs financiers et opérationnels, la rentabilité des actifs et la qualité des prestations, tout en faisant évoluer les pratiques, l’organisation et la performance du service.Votre profilManager de proximité, vous savez fédérer, responsabiliser et faire progresser une équipe tout en restant proche du terrain et en vous impliquant directement dans les dossiers lorsque nécessaire. Pragmatique, orienté·e résultats et doté·e d’un excellent sens relationnel, vous conjuguez exigence, sens du service et capacité à décider. Votre sens commercial et votre connaissance du marché vous permettent d’identifier les bons interlocuteurs, de construire des relations durables et de défendre les intérêts de l’organisation. Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée dans l’immobilier commercial, le retail ou le center management et maîtrisez les enjeux liés à la commercialisation de surfaces et aux baux commerciaux. À l’aise dans la négociation, vous disposez idéalement d’un réseau établi auprès des acteurs du marché romand. Une expérience complémentaire de la gérance immobilière résidentielle constitue un atout.j4id10481360jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

title: Collaborateur-trice scientifique
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Collaborateur-trice scientifique---Collaborateur\-trice scientifique=================================Vous aimeriez contribuer au développement du canton de Fribourg, avez l'esprit du service public, et cherchez un poste varié qui fait sens ? A l'Etat de Fribourg vous travaillerez pour le plus grand employeur du canton. A l'écoute, dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, l'administration cantonale, et ses établissements, sont au service de la population fribourgeoise.Collaborateur\-trice scientifique================================= **Qui sommes\-nous?**Enseignement, recherche, emplois, événements: l'Université de Fribourg est un espace d'innovations et un moteur important pour la vie économique et culturelle de la région. Elle attire des étudiant\-e\-s et des chercheur\-euse\-s en provenance de toute la Suisse et du monde entier, elle marque le quotidien de la cité bilingue de Fribourg, depuis sa fondation en 1889\.The Knowledge and Technology Transfer Service of the University of Fribourg supports researchers in industry collaborations, the protection and commercialization of research results, and the creation of spin\-offs. **Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**Nous misons sur la complémentarité des compétences et la variété des perspectives car c'est la diversité des parcours et des profils qui fait la force de l'Etat de Fribourg. Nous favorisons la conciliation vie professionnelle et vie privée et les conditions de travail flexibles. Pour en savoir plus, suivez ce . **Vos missions**The position covers responsibilities currently associated with intellectual property and licensing, particularly for chemistry, physics and the humanities.* Evaluate inventions for patent protection and commercialization* Advise researchers on IP protection strategies* Conduct prior\-art searches and patentability analyses* Assess novelty, inventive step and patentable subject matter* Identify the essential technical features of inventions and contribute to initial patent claims* Coordinate patent applications with researchers and external patent attorneys* Identify licensing and valorization partners* Negotiate and manage license, research and collaboration agreements* Manage intellectual property and support early\-stage spin\-offs* Provide guidance and training to researchers on IP, commercialization, and industry engagement.* Build and maintain relationships with industry partners, innovation ecosystem stakeholders, and investors.  **What we offer**A varied and international working environment at the intersection of science, intellectual property and business. Flexible working hours, possibility of remote work, continuing education and good work\-life balance.Two\-year fixed\-term contract, renewable. **Profil souhaité*** You have a PhD in natural sciences, engineering or related discipline, in\-depth practical understanding of intellectual property, including prior\-art searches and patentability analyses, drafting initial patent claims and further development in collaboration with patent attorneys* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in technology evaluation, licensing and technology transfer in academia, industry, a startup company or a patent law firm* You are proactive, analytical, independent and comfortable working with researchers, companies and legal specialists. Strong organizational and project management abilities are your strengths* You have excellent communication stakeholder management skills and a professional command of English and either French or **Coordonnées des personnes de contact**Dr. Mozzetti Rohrseitz  Head of Knowledge and Technology Transfer     * Rue \- 13 1701 Fribourg*** Rue \- 13 1701 Fribourg**jid2af0f7djm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Banking Sector Coordinator & Key Account Manager - FS Markets
description: Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets===============================================================**Discover KPMG – Become part of our team**  With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose\-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets===============================================================**Location:** Zurich  **Workload:** 100%  **Start Date:** As soon as possible* Sector \& Account Support: Support the Banking Sector Executive and priority account teams in delivering sector and account priorities, coordinating activities and ensuring effective follow\-through.* Pipeline \& Performance: Maintain an overview of Banking pipeline, revenue and key opportunities, prepare regular reporting and highlight relevant insights and developments.* Go\-to\-Market Content \& Enablement: Support the development of Banking propositions, materials and sector content, helping account teams translate priority topics into relevant client conversations.* Go\-to\-Market Execution: Coordinate Banking campaigns, events and market initiatives, working closely with business, Marketing and Markets teams to ensure focused execution.* Market \& Client Insights: Monitor Banking market developments, regulatory topics and client trends, translating these into relevant insights for sector and account teams.* Knowledge \& Community: Support communication and knowledge sharing across the Banking community, ensuring relevant sector, market and account information is easily accessible.* Account Management: Provide hands\-on account management for selected priority Banking accounts, supporting account planning, client meeting preparation and follow\-up, internal coordination and go\-to\-market activities.* Client Analysis \& Relationship Mapping: Prepare client and relationship analyses to help account teams understand existing relationships, identify gaps and prioritize areas for further development.**Your contribution to KPMG****This is what makes you successful*** University degree in business or a comparable field of study; fluent in English, and/or French would be a strong advantage* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience in Financial Services or Banking, with a background in Markets, account management, business development support, consulting, or a similar role.* understanding of the Banking sector and an interest in market, regulatory and client developments.* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the confidence to coordinate effectively with senior stakeholders, account teams and multidisciplinary teams.* Proactive and hands\-on, taking ownership of activities and driving them through to completion.* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work with pipeline, revenue and account data and translate information into clear insights and high quality presentation materials* Interest in AI and practical knowledge of using AI tools to support research, analysis and day\-to\-day work.* Comfortably operating in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities and a high level of interaction across the organization.**Your benefits**  **Unlock Your Potential**  We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future\-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open\-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.  **Mentoring and Networking**  At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.  From programs such as WoMentoring for early\-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.**Flexible Working**  With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.  **Additional Benefits**  Successful employees need top\-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility\-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half\-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.**Generous Parental Leave**  We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.  To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.**Inspired by Innovation**  At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies\-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting\-edge tools and state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.**An inclusive culture**  Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW , Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like\-minded colleagues.  **Questions? We're here for you**    Experienced Hire Recruiter  ![KPMG]()jidf40cd67jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Portfolio Manager
employer: Brevan Howard Investment Products Limited, Saint-Hélier (Jersey), succursale de Genève
description: The Portfolio Manager is allocated a defined amount of Master Fund trading capital and is individually accountable for the profit and loss generated on it. The role holder owns the complete investment process, from research and idea generation through portfolio construction, execution, risk management and performance attribution. The specific markets and style vary by individual; the expectations below apply to every Portfolio Manager in the Master Fund. It is a principal risk\-taking position, not an analytical, advisory or support function: the Portfolio Manager makes the final investment decisions and bears direct responsibility for their outcome.**Investment Management*** Generate profits for the clients of the Brevan Howard Master Fund by trading the allocated capital on their behalf, within the pre\-agreed trading mandate.* Originate, research and develop macro investment ideas, building each thesis on fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, with particular attention to central bank policy, growth and inflation dynamics and their transmission into global rates, FX, inflation, volatility and equity index markets.* Construct a portfolio sized to conviction, liquidity and correlation, selecting the instruments and structures (cash securities, futures, swaps, options and other OTC derivatives) that give the most asymmetric expression of each view.* Deploy capital through directional and relative value expressions as the market regime warrants, including balance\-sheet\-intensive trades where the opportunity justifies it. Flexibility of style and the ability to scale risk into a strong theme are expected of a Master Fund Portfolio Manager.* Regularly reassess that the portfolio reflects the intended market view, and restructure or exit positions when a thesis is invalidated.* Take hands\-on responsibility for execution, counterparty relationships and liquidity sourcing, and ensure that any execution delegated to a trade analyst or execution trader is correctly implemented.**Risk Management*** Operate at all times within the risk framework agreed with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management: capital allocation, VaR and stress limits, leverage and balance\-sheet limits, concentration and liquidity constraints, and the fund’s drawdown limits.* Manage live portfolio risk daily and intraday, for the role holder’s own book and for any allocation run by team members, actively managing drawdowns and demonstrating strict discipline in loss management.* Liaise with the risk management team who deliver risk reports, articulating positions, rationale and sensitivities clearly and responding to challenge.* Liaise with Treasury to ensure positions are properly funded and that collateral is placed effectively.* Improve and scale risk\-taking over time as the investment process is proven, in agreement with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management.**Performance, Monitoring and Reporting*** Monitor, attribute and explain daily, monthly and annual P\&L and risk, and articulate performance drivers clearly to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and senior management.* Deliver a return commensurate with the capital allocated, at a quality of returns (information ratio, drawdown profile, consistency across market regimes) consistent with the Master Fund’s expectations.* Prepare periodic performance reports on a timely basis, monitor adherence to exchange and counterparty limits, ensure that all trading activity is appropriately allocated and accounted for, and maintain accurate records of the investment rationale for positions and decisions.**Contribution to the Fund and the Firm*** Contribute to the Master Fund’s investment dialogue, sharing views, data and expertise with the Chief Investment Officer, other Portfolio Managers and senior management in a collaborative manner.* Where leading a team, take full responsibility for the hiring, development, output and conduct of analysts, traders and sub\-portfolio managers, and maintain an ongoing commitment to their development.* Present periodically to the investment management committee and, where required, support the Client Partnership Group with current and prospective investors.**Governance, Compliance and Conduct**Operate at all times within the firm’s compliance policies, applicable regulatory requirements (including market abuse, conflicts of interest, best execution and personal account dealing rules) and the firm’s Code of Conduct; hold any regulatory certification title: Global Account Senior Manager 100%
description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100%
**Start Date:** As soon as possible

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Understanding both the client's business agenda and KPMG services to enable leveraging the global KPMG network to connect our clients to the right people, ensuring that client needs are correctly identified, and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating global activities and knowledge transfer to ensure client needs are correctly identified and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating a global team of professionals and supporting their client interaction
* Closely collaborate with Global Client operations in Switzerland, US, UK, and APAC, ensuring that locations are actively engaged
* Guiding internal teams during the proposal, engagement contracting and onboarding process
* Managing selected client relationships with stakeholders (procurement, contracting, staff vetting, client resource needs, etc.)
* Manage KPMG Risk Management activities related to client and engagement acceptance
* Responsible for client and ad-hoc reporting, Annual Global account planning, Client service team planning and preparing for client meetings
* Ensuring regular reporting and marketing activities tailored to the needs of the relevant client stakeholders and keeping all internal key stakeholders updated with developments
* Organize client insights program / client-service reviews
* Influence without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership



**This is what makes you successful**



* University degree at Bachelor's or Master's level in business administration, finance, economics or a related discipline.
* At least 6--8 years of relevant experience, including a minimum of three years in global account management, business development or complex programme management within Financial Services or professional services.
* Demonstrated experience managing a large, complex international client account, coordinating stakeholders and client-service teams across multiple countries, service lines and seniority levels.
* Proven track record supporting the full opportunity lifecycle, including account planning, pipeline management, proposal coordination, commercial development, contracting and client onboarding.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Services sector and the ability to translate a client's strategic priorities into concrete opportunities across a broad professional-services portfolio.
* Credibility and confidence working directly with senior executives, partners, procurement and risk stakeholders, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
* Exceptional programme-management discipline, with evidence of independently managing multiple concurrent workstreams, deadlines, governance requirements and executive-level deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal English, including the ability to prepare high-quality executive presentations and client communications; Proficient German is an advantage
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

Contract Manufacturing Site Managers work closely with contract manufacturers (CMOs) worldwide, Procurement, Clinical Planning, Quality and other operations functions to develop and negotiate supply contracts and ensure product delivery from external manufacturing partners with optimal cost, quality and speed. CMO Site Managers also drive the evolution and implementation of new systems and efficient internal and external processes, in support of CMO production and the Pharma Vision to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden between 2020 and 2029\.**Tasks \& Responsibilities:*** You serve as the primary communication bridge between internal clinical stakeholders (such as study managers, clinical planning, and quality) and ’s global network of external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).* You monitor external clinical drug labeling, packaging, and device assembly production to ensure everything runs according to plan, while staying flexible and reactive enough to rapidly liaise with CMOs, secure extra capacity, and scale up supply when unexpected events occur—such as sudden spikes in patient enrollment or extended quality deviations.* You create, revise, and oversee Purchase Orders (POs), work orders, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Statements of Work (SOWs). description: ---base:  meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width,  title: GESTIONNAIRE DE FORTUNE - SENIOR RELATIONSHIP MANAGER / PRIVATE BANKER (H/F)--- GESTIONNAIRE DE FORTUNE \- SENIOR RELATIONSHIP MANAGER / PRIVATE BANKER (H/F)=============================================================================SENIOR RELATIONSHIP MANAGER / PRIVATE BANKER (H/F)--------------------------------------------------### Gestion de fortune privée \| Genève \| Rémunération jusqu'à 75 % de la production**ATHÉNÉE INVESTMENT SA – GENÈVE****Développez votre clientèle. Préservez votre indépendance. Bénéficiez directement de la valeur que vous créez.**### QUI SOMMES\-NOUS ?Athénée Investment SA est une maison suisse indépendante de gestion de fortune, établie à Genève et soumise à la surveillance prudentielle applicable aux gestionnaires de fortune autorisés par la FINMA.Nous accompagnons une clientèle privée exigeante, composée d'entrepreneurs, de familles fortunées, de dirigeants et d'investisseurs internationaux, dans la préservation, la gestion et le développement de leur patrimoine.Notre positionnement associe les valeurs traditionnelles d'une maison de gestion privée — proximité, confidentialité, indépendance et excellence du conseil — à l'accès à des compétences et solutions d'investissement sophistiquées, inspirées des pratiques institutionnelles.Nous privilégions une architecture ouverte, une approche patrimoniale globale et une relation durable avec nos clients, sans logique de distribution imposée de produits propriétaires.Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons plusieurs **Senior Relationship Managers / Private Bankers** souhaitant exercer leur métier dans un environnement indépendant, agile et entrepreneurial.### UNE OPPORTUNITÉ POUR LES BANQUIERS PRIVÉS ENTREPRENEURSVous êtes un professionnel expérimenté de la banque privée ou de la gestion de fortune.Vous avez développé un réseau solide, construit des relations de confiance avec une clientèle fortunée et démontré votre capacité à générer des actifs et des revenus.Vous souhaitez désormais bénéficier d'une plus grande autonomie, d'une organisation plus souple et d'une participation significative aux revenus que vous générez.**Athénée Investment vous offre la possibilité de développer votre activité au sein d'une maison indépendante, avec deux modèles de collaboration adaptés à votre profil et à vos ambitions.**### MODÈLE 1 – RELATIONSHIP MANAGER SALARIÉVous rejoignez Athénée Investment en qualité de collaborateur salarié, dans le cadre d'un contrat de travail suisse.Vous bénéficiez notamment :* D'une intégration complète à notre organisation.* D'une rémunération fixe et/ou variable structurée selon votre expérience, votre contribution et les conditions contractuelles.* D'un environnement réglementaire et opérationnel établi.* De l'appui des équipes de gestion, de conformité et d'administration.* D'une grande autonomie commerciale et d'une relation directe avec la direction.* D'un mécanisme de participation à la production pouvant être particulièrement attractif.La rémunération globale est déterminée individuellement, en tenant compte des coûts employeur, des charges sociales, des responsabilités exercées et de la rentabilité de l'activité.### MODÈLE 2 – RELATIONSHIP MANAGER INDÉPENDANT / PARTENAIREVous souhaitez conserver une véritable dimension entrepreneuriale et développer votre propre activité en vous appuyant sur une plateforme professionnelle reconnue.Athénée Investment propose, sous réserve de validation juridique et réglementaire, un modèle de partenariat permettant de bénéficier :* D'une importante autonomie dans le développement de votre clientèle.* D'un accès à notre infrastructure de gestion et à nos partenaires bancaires.* De l'appui de nos compétences en investissement et en ingénierie patrimoniale.* D'un environnement professionnel structuré et de procédures de conformité adaptées.* D'une rémunération directement liée à votre production.* De modalités de collaboration négociées individuellement.**Dans ce cadre, la participation du partenaire pourra atteindre 75 % de sa production éligible**, selon les revenus effectivement encaissés, les services fournis, les coûts supportés et les conditions de l'accord conclu.Ce modèle s'adresse particulièrement aux professionnels disposant d'une clientèle établie ou d'un fort potentiel de développement, souhaitant conjuguer autonomie entrepreneuriale et qualité d'une infrastructure de gestion de fortune.Les responsabilités réglementaires, les conditions d'exercice et le statut du partenaire seront expressément définis avant toute entrée en activité.### VOS MISSIONS**Développer une clientèle privée de qualité*** Prospecter et acquérir de nouvelles relations HNWI et UHNWI.* Développer les actifs sous gestion et les apports nets de capitaux.* Valoriser votre réseau professionnel auprès d'entrepreneurs, dirigeants, familles fortunées et investisseurs internationaux.* Accompagner les clients souhaitant établir une relation avec Athénée Investment, dans le respect des obligations contractuelles, de confidentialité et des règles applicables.* Construire des relations pérennes fondées sur la confiance, la transparence et la qualité du service.**Proposer un accompagnement patrimonial et financier de premier ordre*** Identifier les objectifs financiers, patrimoniaux et successoraux des clients.* Définir, avec les équipes compétentes, des stratégies d'investissement adaptées.* Proposer des solutions de gestion discrétionnaire et de conseil en investissement, selon le cadre applicable.* Mobiliser une large gamme d'instruments : actions, obligations, fonds, produits structurés, dette privée et investissements alternatifs, en fonction de l'adéquation et de l'éligibilité de chaque client.* Coordonner les besoins spécifiques avec nos banques dépositaires et partenaires spécialisés, notamment pour les financements lombards et hypothécaires.**Garantir l'excellence du suivi*** Assurer une relation de proximité et une grande disponibilité.* Veiller à la qualité du suivi des portefeuilles et des risques.* Respecter les exigences légales et réglementaires applicables, notamment en matière de LSFin, LEFin, LBA et de connaissance du client.* Contribuer à la réputation et au développement à long terme d'Athénée Investment.### LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONSNous privilégions des professionnels expérimentés, autonomes et reconnus pour leur capacité à développer une clientèle privée.**Expérience et compétences*** Expérience significative, idéalement supérieure à 7 ans, en banque privée, gestion de fortune indépendante ou family office.* Réseau actif auprès d'une clientèle HNWI/UHNWI.* Capacité démontrée à développer des actifs sous gestion et à générer des revenus récurrents.* Bonne connaissance des produits financiers, de l'allocation d'actifs et des besoins patrimoniaux d'une clientèle sophistiquée.* Compréhension des exigences réglementaires suisses et, le cas échéant, des marchés transfrontaliers couverts.**Qualités personnelles*** Tempérament entrepreneurial et sens du développement commercial.* Excellente capacité à établir et entretenir des relations de confiance.* Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités.* Discrétion, loyauté et intégrité.* Volonté de s'inscrire dans une collaboration durable.**Formation et langues*** Formation supérieure en finance, économie ou gestion, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.* Certifications CFA, CAIA, CWMA ou similaires appréciées.* Excellente maîtrise du français et/ou de l'anglais.* Autres langues et expertise de marchés internationaux appréciées.Nous étudierons les candidatures de professionnels présentant un potentiel commercial significatif, même si leur parcours ne répond pas à l'intégralité de ces critères.### UNE RÉMUNÉRATION À LA HAUTEUR DE VOTRE CONTRIBUTION**Jusqu'à 75 % de votre production éligible.**Notre philosophie est simple : les professionnels qui contribuent directement au développement d'Athénée Investment doivent pouvoir bénéficier significativement de la valeur économique qu'ils créent.Nous proposons des conditions de rémunération compétitives et individualisées, selon :* Le modèle de collaboration retenu : salarié ou partenaire indépendant.* Les actifs sous gestion développés.* La nature, le niveau et la récurrence des revenus générés.* Les ressources et services mis à disposition.* Les charges et responsabilités supportées par chacune des parties.La production éligible, les modalités de partage, les éventuelles déductions, les frais et les conditions de versement seront définis contractuellement, de manière transparente.Le taux maximal de 75 % n'est ni automatique ni garanti et dépend du modèle de collaboration retenu.### POURQUOI ATHÉNÉE INVESTMENT ?**L'indépendance d'une maison de gestion privée**Une des circuits de décision courts et une relation directe avec les dirigeants.**Des solutions d'investissement différenciantes**L'accès à des expertises financières et à des stratégies d'investissement traditionnelles et sophistiquées.**Une infrastructure professionnelle**Un cadre structuré permettant de se consacrer prioritairement au développement commercial, à la relation client et à la création de valeur.**Une rémunération attractive et transparente**Une participation directe à la performance économique de votre activité, pouvant atteindre 75 % de la production éligible selon le modèle convenu.**Une ambition commune**Construire ensemble une maison de gestion de fortune privée de référence pour les entrepreneurs, les familles et les grandes fortunes.### REJOIGNEZ\-NOUSVous êtes un title: Chief Medical Officer
description: SJP Biotec GmbH is a clinical-stage precision oncology company pioneering a first-in-class Selective Translation Regulatory Inhibitor (STRI) platform powered to overcome treatment resistance in refractory cancers. Founded in 2024, SJP targets RAS-driven, hormone-receptor-positive, and immune-refractory tumors with a novel pipeline of small molecules developed in our lab and ready to proceed with regulatory-grade trials.Backed by a Scientific Advisory Board that includes world-leading authorities in RAS and breast cancer biology, and immuno-oncology, SJP has established clinical partnerships with leading medical centers world-wide including UCSF, NCI, MD Anderson, Baylor College of Medicine, MSKCC, and McGill, to name a few.The OpportunityThis is a stimulating and unique opportunity to join a scientifically exceptional, capital-efficient biotech company doing groundbreaking work at a pivotal inflection point. The CMO/SVP of Clinical Development will serve as the company's most senior clinical leader, responsible for designing and executing a multi-indication clinical development strategy across one of the most compelling areas in the current oncology drug development field - RAS/eIF4A/translation-pathway inhibition.Key Responsibilities    • Translate and deliver key directives from the board and senior management, and serve as the clinical face of the company.    • Lead and manage all clinical development activities across the SJP portfolio    • Design Phase 2 and 3 clinical protocols and oversee CTA/IND submissions to BfArM, FDA, and EMA    • Develop and implement biomarker-driven patient selection strategies     • Build and manage relationships with leading academic and clinical sites across Germany, the EU, and the US    • Oversee Investigator Initiated Trials and partnerships, providing scientific leadership and interactions as required    • Lead regulatory strategy, developing approaches for Fast Track Designation, Breakthrough Therapy Designation, and accelerated approval pathways as applicable    • Support pharmaceutical partnering activities - prepare clinical data packages and respond to due diligence for potential licensing and out-licensing transactions    • Build out of the clinical development and operations function, including recruitment of CRAs, medical monitors, and data management staff    • Present clinical data at major oncology congresses and to key opinion leaders    • Interact with potential investors and financial institutions to raise capital when needed.Candidate ProfileEssential Qualifications    • MD, with specialization in medical oncology and hematology    • 10+ years of experience in oncology clinical development within pharma, biotech, or CRO settings with hands-on clinical trial leadership    • Demonstrated track record of successful IND/CTA submissions    • Leadership of interactions with FDA and/or EMA    • Experience with biomarker-driven trial design and companion diagnostic development    • Expertise in breast cancer, NSCLC, and KRAS-mutant tumor biology    • Strong understanding of the competitive treatment landscape in clinical oncology    • Proven ability to manage investigator-initiated trials and academic site partnerships    • Strong scientific publication and/or congress presentation record in clinical oncology    • Excellent presentation skills     • Emphasizing teamwork and leading a team of experts in their fieldsHighly Desired (But not required)    • Experience with RAS/KRAS biology, MAPK pathway inhibitors, or translation-pathway therapeutics    • PhD in an associated area of cancer biology    • Experience with basket trial design and multi-cohort oncology studies    • Background in immuno-oncology combinations, particularly in checkpoint inhibitor resistance settings    • Prior involvement in pharma partnering or licensing due diligence from the biotech side    • Working knowledge of German regulatory frameworks alongside international GCP/ICH guidelines    • Established professional network at leading cancer centres

title: Global Account Senior Manager 100%
description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100%
**Start Date:** As soon as possible

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Understanding both the client's business agenda and KPMG services to enable leveraging the global KPMG network to connect our clients to the right people, ensuring that client needs are correctly identified, and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating global activities and knowledge transfer to ensure client needs are correctly identified and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating a global team of professionals and supporting their client interaction
* Closely collaborate with Global Client operations in Switzerland, US, UK, and APAC, ensuring that locations are actively engaged
* Guiding internal teams during the proposal, engagement contracting and onboarding process
* Managing selected client relationships with stakeholders (procurement, contracting, staff vetting, client resource needs, etc.)
* Manage KPMG Risk Management activities related to client and engagement acceptance
* Responsible for client and ad-hoc reporting, Annual Global account planning, Client service team planning and preparing for client meetings
* Ensuring regular reporting and marketing activities tailored to the needs of the relevant client stakeholders and keeping all internal key stakeholders updated with developments
* Organize client insights program / client-service reviews
* Influence without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership



**This is what makes you successful**



* University degree at Bachelor's or Master's level in business administration, finance, economics or a related discipline.
* At least 6--8 years of relevant experience, including a minimum of three years in global account management, business development or complex programme management within Financial Services or professional services.
* Demonstrated experience managing a large, complex international client account, coordinating stakeholders and client-service teams across multiple countries, service lines and seniority levels.
* Proven track record supporting the full opportunity lifecycle, including account planning, pipeline management, proposal coordination, commercial development, contracting and client onboarding.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Services sector and the ability to translate a client's strategic priorities into concrete opportunities across a broad professional-services portfolio.
* Credibility and confidence working directly with senior executives, partners, procurement and risk stakeholders, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
* Exceptional programme-management discipline, with evidence of independently managing multiple concurrent workstreams, deadlines, governance requirements and executive-level deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal English, including the ability to prepare high-quality executive presentations and client communications; Proficient German is an advantage
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

title: RF & Photonics Packaging Engineer 100%
description: Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of photonic integrated circuit (PIC) technology? Lightium, a leading-edge photonics foundry, is looking for an experienced Packaging Engineer to spearhead its RF and optical packaging activities and be the point of contact and manage the relationships with Lightium Packaging Partners. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the next generation of photonics packaging solutions for Lightium’s proprietary high-speed TFLN technology by defining novel assembly concepts, identifying external supplier and packaging houses and define the assembly flow together with internal and external stakeholders. Position Summary As an RF & Photonics Packaging Engineer, you will be responsible for developing Lightium’s Packaging technologies, chip assemblies, as well as supply chain management. You will have the opportunity to leverage your theoretical knowledge and your prior experience in the field of RF and photonics packaging by managing Lightium’s packaging activities and to interface to Lightium’s internal and external customers. You will be responsible for ensuring Lightium’s TFLN chips can be packaged according to our customer’s specification and will drive the implementation of novel packaging concepts with Lightium’s suppliers. You will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge packaging technologies, such as flip chip bonding, ribbon bonding, microtransfer printing, etc. Key Responsibilities Packaging concepts: You will be actively working with the different internal R&D groups including design, PDK, process development, characterization and test teams to ensure "design for packaging" and "design for testing" is followed in our whole organization. You will identify and implement different packaging concepts compatible with our TFLN technology (e.g., , laser integration, drivers and TIA integration, wire bonding, fiber attachment, etc.) while meeting our customer’s needs. You’ll actively work on ultra-high-speed RF package solutions and simulate the relevant packaging concepts in state-of-the-art electromagnetic simulation tools (such as COMSOL, HFSS, ADS, etc). You’ll also work on fiber-to-chip coupling solutions, spot size converters, and attachment of fiber array units (FAUs).  Supplier identification and management: Lightium and its customers value a multi sourcing strategy. You are responsible that all identified packaging concepts can be sourced from multiple vendors. This includes electrical attach (wire bonding, flip chip bumping and optical fiber and bumping) as well as optical fiber attach. You will drive the diversification of our supply chain including Western, European and Asian suppliers.  Assembly project management: You will drive the day-to-day project management of internal R&D projects, public funded projects and customer assembly projects with external partners, such as assembly houses and OSATs. You will be the point of contact and managing the relationship with packaging houses and OSTAs. You will drive the day-to-day meetings and provide regular updates to Lightum's management. You will define the packaging specs, budget, and timeline for the subcontractors. You will make sure that the assemblies are delivered on time, in spec and in budget to our customers while matching our demanding RF and optical requirements. You will coordinate with Lightium’s R&D team for any package-level testing, characterization, and qualification. Customer engagement: Based on customer requirements, you will identify and implement the matching assembly technologies and concepts. You will track the requirements with a keen eye to detail and make sure all specifications are met and traceable. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to work with leading transceiver manufacturers and OSATs. Reliability and Quality: You will define the qualification plans and qualification procedures for our packaging concepts. You will work with internal and external stakeholders to run the qualifications, such as environmental reliability or electrical stress tests. In the case of RMA events, you will support the team inassembly-related aspects and embrace customer satisfaction. Collaboration: Work closely with the R&D teams from design to optical testing and characterization, contributing to cross-functional projects to advance our packaging platforms. Occasional travel to Lightium’s assembly partners and OSATs. Participating in public funded projects (HorizonEurope, InnoSuisse, European Chips Act etc.) to develop new packaging concepts and hybrid integration solutions. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain thorough documentation and report findings, as well as establishing standard-operating procedures and training new colleagues. Innovation: Stay up to date on the latest advancements in photonics, incorporating new techniques and technologies into our R&D landscape. Identification of packaging IP and contributing to Lightium’s IP portfolio.  What you’ll bring Educational Background: An advanced degree in Electrical Engineer, Physics, Electro-Optical or Wireless Communications, Integrated Photonics, Chemistry, Material Science or a related field. Experience Level: At least 3 years' work experience (post-graduation) in the field of electronics, photonics, electronic packaging, PCB manufacturing, material science or RF design. Track record of moving electro-optical assemblies from concept over prototyping into production.  Technical Skills: Prior experience with photonic packaging concepts, fiber attach, electronic re-distributing layers (RDLs), under-bump metallization (UBM), bumping, copper pillars or anisotropic conductive glue (ACF) is a plus. Experience in the field of RF simulations (COMSOL, Keysight ADS, Ansys, HFSS and CST) is a clear advantage. Experience with intermetallic phases and SEM-EDX is advantageous. Organization & Documentation: Strong organizational skills with excellent project management skills and a keen eye for details. Experience handling and documenting RMA processes, in outward-facing communication with suppliers and subcontractors at international level. Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively in a multidisciplinary team and with international customers. Cultural awareness and tailoring of communication style to US, European and Asian partners. Experience with vendor and supplier management at an international level. Adaptability: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in the face of change. Willingness to travel internationally up to 20%. Language Skills: Fluency in English is required; knowledge of German or any Asian language is an advantage.  What We Offer A unique opportunity to lead a cutting-edge manufacturing initiative in the rapidly growing field of photonics. Competitive compensation and benefits package, including employee stock option plan (ESOP), reflective of your experience and expertise. Become a key player in an early-phase startup and be part of a young, motivated, and energetic team. You will have the unique opportunity to create, grow, and develop your professional skills at a fast pace. We'd love to hear from you if you're passionate about building new tech from the ground up and thrive in a collaborative and innovative environment. Lightium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Product / System Quality & Verification Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Product / System Quality \& Verification Engineer to help establish and drive product quality from our first rideable prototypes through development and toward production.This is a hands\-on, cross\-functional individual contributor role at the intersection of product quality, systems integration, verification and reliability.You will work across mechanical, electrical, embedded software, connectivity and system interfaces. You are not expected to be the deepest technical expert in every domain—that responsibility remains with the respective Engineering teams. Instead, you will provide the independent quality perspective that connects these domains and ensures that the complete product is adequately verified, integrated, and ready for release.You will work closely with Mechanical Engineering, System Engineering, Embedded Software / Electronics, Product Management, suppliers and eventually Manufacturing and Service teams.**Key responsibilities**Plan, coordinate, and review verification and validation activities for components, subsystems, and complete e\-bike systems.Define and govern Minimum Test Requirements (MTRs) together with Engineering and suppliers, including appropriate test methods, conditions, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria.Review Supplier validation plans and test evidence, and challenge whether the proposed verification provides sufficient evidence that product requirements are met.Drive and coordinate system integration and end\-to\-end testing to ensure hardware, software, connectivity, and mobile app functions work reliably together.Own and maintain the FRACAS process, leading investigations into complex mechanical, electrical, software, and system\-level issues through root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, verification, and continuous learning.Define and coordinate reliability, durability, environmental, and field\-testing programs to identify risks and improve product robustness before launch.Coordinate homologation and certification testing, and release readiness reviews, ensuring compliance requirements are met and product quality is maintained throughout development.**What success looks like**Success in this role means that, as we move from prototypes toward production, we can confidently answer key questions about product readiness: What are the critical requirements? How are they being verified? Are the tests sufficiently rigorous? What issues have been found, and have the fixes been proven effective?You will ensure that verification activities, test results, product configurations, and compliance evidence are well structured, traceable, and visible, enabling informed decisions on product readiness, certification status, and release milestones.Success also means establishing a robust FRACAS and problem\-solving culture where issues are identified early, investigated systematically, resolved through verified corrective actions, and used to drive continuous improvement across products and processes.Ultimately, you will help build confidence that the complete e\-bike and it’s system is reliable, compliant, and ready for launch, not just at the component level but as an integrated product.Engineering teams will see Quality as a trusted partner that helps identify risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and support successful product releases.**What you bring**5\+ years of experience in product quality, verification \& validation, reliability engineering, systems engineering, or a related discipline.Experience with complex mechatronic products such as e\-bikes, automotive systems, motorcycles, robotics, or consumer electronics.Strong understanding of verification, validation, reliability engineering, and structured problem\-solving methodologies such as FRACAS, 8D, or equivalent.A systems\-thinking mindset with the ability to work across mechanical, electrical, software, and connectivity domains, and understand how they interact in a complete product.Experience coordinating suppliers, validation activities, and complex system integration across multiple engineering disciplines.Ability to review and challenge test plans, Minimum Test Requirements, validation strategies, and technical evidence without needing to be the deepest subject matter expert in every domain.Comfortable working hands\-on with prototypes, test equipment, diagnostic tools, test data, and failure investigations.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, suppliers, and external test partners.Fluent English; German or Swiss German an advantage given the Switzerland base.j4id10481085jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

description: **What you will do**We are seeking a seasoned Leader of AI & Data Science to lead our enterprise AI portfolio spanning four specialized operations: Generative AI & Agentic Platforms, AI Operations, Statistical & ML Modeling, and Data Center AI for our HVAC business. This leader will own the end-to-end AI strategy — from experimentation to production — ensuring AI initiatives deliver measurable business value, operate reliably at scale, and align with the company's broader digital transformation goals.The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with strong people leadership, and can operate comfortably across cutting-edge GenAI innovation, disciplined ML engineering, and domain-specific applications in energy, HVAC, and data center environments.**How you will do it**Strategic Leadership- Define and execute the multi-year AI/ML roadmap across all four operations, aligned with business priorities and P&L impact.- Act as the senior AI voice for the organization — advising executive leadership on emerging technologies (LLMs, agentic AI, edge AI) and their business applications.- Establish governance frameworks covering responsible AI, model risk management, data privacy, and regulatory compliance.- Manage vendor relationships (cloud providers, LLM providers, tooling), and build-vs-buy decisions.GenAI & Agentic Platform- Lead the design and scaling of an enterprise agentic AI platform (LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, guardrails, and evaluation frameworks).- Drive adoption of GenAI copilots and autonomous agents across internal and customer-facing use cases.- Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving GenAI ecosystem (foundation models, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, agent frameworks) and set platform standards.AI Operations- Own the operational backbone for all AI/ML workloads: CI/CD for models, model monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines, observability, and incident response.- Establish SLAs/SLOs for production models and GenAI services; drive reliability, latency, and cost optimization (including LLM inference cost management).- Standardize the ML platform stack (feature stores, model registries, experiment tracking, deployment patterns) across the organization.Statistical & ML Models for Business- Oversee development of statistical, forecasting, and machine learning models supporting core business functions (e.g., demand forecasting, pricing, churn, service optimization, predictive maintenance).- Ensure rigor in model development — experimental design, validation, explainability, and measurable business KPIs.- Partner with business unit leaders to prioritize a portfolio of high-ROI analytics use cases.Data Center AI for HVAC Business- Lead AI/ML initiatives focused on data center development and operations — thermal management, cooling optimization, energy efficiency, capacity planning, and predictive insights for HVAC systems.- Work closely with HVAC product, engineering, and field teams to translate sensor/telemetry data (BMS, IoT, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units) into actionable intelligence and product features.- Develop digital twin, anomaly detection, and optimization models that improve PUE, uptime, and equipment lifecycle for data center customers.People & Organizational Leadership- Hire, mentor, and grow POD leads and a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, GenAI engineers, and MLOps engineers.- Foster a culture of experimentation, engineering excellence, and business accountability.- Define career paths, performance standards, and knowledge-sharing practices across PODs.**What we look for**Required- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field (PhD a plus).- 12+ years of experience in data science / machine learning, with 5+ years in senior leadership managing multiple teams or PODs.- Domain experience in HVAC, data centers, energy management, building automation, or industrial IoT.- Proven track record of delivering production-grade AI/ML systems at enterprise scale.- Hands-on familiarity with the modern GenAI stack: LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source), RAG, vector databases, agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), and evaluation/guardrail tooling.- Strong grounding in MLOps/AIOps practices and cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP), containerization, and CI/CD for ML.- Solid foundation in classical statistics and ML (regression, time series, classification, optimization) and their application to business problems.- Demonstrated ability to partner with business stakeholders, translate ambiguous problems into AI solutions, and communicate impact to executives.- Experience managing budgets, vendors, and cross-functional programs.Preferred - Familiarity with time-series/telemetry data at scale, digital twins, physics-informed ML, or reinforcement learning for control/optimization (e.g., cooling optimization).- Experience with edge AI deployment and BMS/SCADA integration.- Knowledge of responsible AI frameworks, model governance, and relevant regulations.- Publications, patents, or recognized contributions in AI/ML.Key Competencies- Strategic thinking with hands-on technical depth.- Multi-team leadership and talent development.- Executive communication and stakeholder management.- Bias for action and outcome-driven delivery.- Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-evolving AI landscape.**About Us **Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

title: Business Analyst International Strategy & Growth
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Business Analyst International Strategy &amp; Growth--- Business Analyst International Strategy \& Growth=================================================You work 100% primarily in Zug, with the possibility of working remotely up to one day per weekBusiness Analyst International Strategy \& Growth=================================================**V\-ZUG International Commercial Strategy \& Growth**Our International Commercial Strategy \& Growth team drives international commercial strategy, supports business planning and enables growth across V\-ZUG's international markets. We provide strategic and analytical decision support, identify new market opportunities and help translate commercial priorities into actionable initiatives. Working closely with international markets and HQ functions, we contribute to sustainable and profitable growth. We are looking for a Business Analyst and Developer who combines strong analytical capabilities, structured problem\-solving and hands\-on execution. You will work directly with the Head of Commercial Strategy \& Growth, supporting strategic decisions, coordinating key planning processes and contributing to selected growth and transformation projects.**What this position offers you*** You develop commercial analyses, financial models and business cases. You assess markets, sales channels and business models, evaluate scenarios and turn complex information into clear insights and recommendations* You prepare presentations and decision materials for senior management. You turn complex analyses into compelling narratives, structured options and actionable recommendations* You research international markets, competitors, customer segments and industry trends. You bring together internal and external information to build a reliable fact base for strategic decisions* You support the assessment of new geographic markets, strategic partnerships and business models. You analyse market attractiveness, competitive dynamics, go\-to\-market options and financial potential* You coordinate the annual market business\-planning process. You develop templates and guidelines, support markets throughout the cycle, consolidate submissions and prepare analytical reviews. You monitor deadlines, track follow\-up actions and support budget and medium\-term planning* You structure and analyse commercial and financial data, prepare recurring KPI reports and Business Review materials, investigate performance deviations and identify opportunities for improvement. You also help develop more efficient, data\-driven reporting and analysis processes* You independently coordinate delegated strategic projects and cross\-functional workstreams. You manage milestones, deliverables, dependencies and risks, engage stakeholders, monitor progress and ensure timely follow\-up and escalation when needed* You contribute to selected growth opportunities through initial assessments, business cases, partner research, pipeline tracking and the preparation of commercial decision materials**What you can bring to this position*** You ideally have 3 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, business analysis, commercial strategy, financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), or a comparable analytical role. You are comfortable working on complex business questions and independently delivering high\-quality results* You are highly proficient in Excel and use it to structure data, build financial models, analyse scenarios and develop business cases. You can turn large volumes of information into meaningful commercial insights* You have advanced PowerPoint skills and experience preparing presentations for senior management. You can build a compelling storyline, explain complex findings clearly and formulate concise recommendations* You confidently use modern AI\-powered tools to support research, data analysis, information structuring and presentation development. You explore new technologies to improve productivity and analytical quality while critically validating their outputs. Experience with Power BI or comparable data visualisation tools is an advantage* You approach unfamiliar business challenges with curiosity, analytical rigour and sound judgement. You can independently structure problems, challenge assumptions and develop practical solutions* You have experience coordinating projects or workstreams, managing timelines and deliverables, and collaborating across functions. You are organised, reliable and proactive in following through on commitments* You take ownership of your responsibilities, manage multiple priorities and deliver with limited supervision. You combine a hands\-on approach with attention to detail and know when to involve stakeholders or escalate issues* You are interested in international markets, commercial strategy and business development, and enjoy working with colleagues from different countries and functions* You have a degree in business administration, economics, finance, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience* You communicate confidently in English and . You can prepare analyses and decision materials and collaborate with internal and external partners in both languages**Not yet convinced? V\-ZUG offers you more than just a job**As part of the V\-ZUG family, you will benefit from modern employment conditions, a wide range of development opportunities, a suitable infrastructure and numerous offers and services for your personal wellbeing.**What are you waiting for?**We look forward to receiving your application!  We cannot consider applications submitted by recruitment agencies for this position.
